Hey everyone,while HDMI dominates consumer electronics,DisplayPort is often the preferred standard for computer monitors,especially in professional and gaming environments.

DisplayPort was designed with PC display needs in mind and it includes features that matter in office setups,multi-monitor desks and high refresh gaming.

On the A Plus exam,DisplayPort questions often test feature differences,adapter direction and why a monitor might support more capabilities on DisplayPort than on HDMI.

DisplayPort was developed by Visa,the Video Electronics Standards Association,and it uses packet-based transmission that fits well with computer architectures.

A practical physical feature is that many full-size DisplayPort connectors include a latch that clicks into place which reduces accidental disconnection compared to HDMI's friction fit.

That locking behavior is a real-world support advantage when users bump cables behind a desk and the display randomly goes black.

DisplayPort versions are tied to bandwidth capability.

DisplayPort 1.2 is commonly associated with 4KF60.

DisplayPort 1.4 increases capability further and is often used for high refresh 4K and HDR workflows depending on hardware.

DisplayPort 2.0 takes a major jump and targets extremely high bandwidth scenarios.

For A Plus,you don't need to memorize every edge case,but you should understand that DisplayPort tends to offer strong bandwidth for PC monitors and the version on both the GPU and the monitor determines what you can actually run.

DisplayPort natively supports adaptive sync features that reduce tearing and stutter by matching refresh behavior to frame output.

This is why DisplayPort is commonly recommended for variable refresh rate gaming displays.

If a user has a high refresh monitor with VR features and complains that VRR isn't working,confirming that they are connected via DisplayPort and using the correct settings is a common troubleshooting step.

One signature DisplayPort feature is MST,multi-stream transport,which enables daisy chaining.

This means a single DisplayPort output can feed a first monitor,then the first monitor can feed a second monitor and so on if the monitors support MST.This can reduce cable clutter and reduce how many video ports the PC needs.

In support work,MST can also create confusion,so you verify that the monitor chain and MST settings are correct when a second monitor isn't detected.

DisplayPort appears in multiple connector forms.Full-size DisplayPort is common on desktops and monitors.

Mini DisplayPort is smaller and was common on older laptops and some legacy systems.DisplayPort can also run over USB-C using DisplayPort Alternate Mode,which is extremely common on modern laptops.

The key exam point is that USB-C is a connector shape and DisplayPort Alt mode is the capability that allows video output through it.

DisplayPort is often preferred for PC monitors because it commonly supports higher refresh rates,VR features and MST daisy chaining.

Many high-end monitors expose more features on DisplayPort than on HDMI depending on the monitor's internal design and firmware.

HDMI is still excellent and widely compatible,but DisplayPort is often the PC first choice especially for gaming monitors and multi-monitor desks.

Like HDMI,DisplayPort has practical cable length limits for full bandwidth operation and longer runs can cause stability issues.

If a user is pushing high resolution and high refresh and sees flicker or random black screens,cable quality and length matter.

Active DisplayPort cables and optical extenders exist for longer distances,but in many desk setups simply using a shorter,higher quality cable solves the issue quickly.

DisplayPort to HDMI conversion is usually easy because many DisplayPort outputs support dual mode behavior allowing simple passive adapters to work for connecting a DisplayPort computer to an HDMI display.

The reverse direction HDMI to DisplayPort is not the same and often requires an active adapter with conversion electronics.

This is a very common real world issue when someone buys a cheap adapter and expects it to work both ways.

For the exam,remember that adapter direction matters.

DisplayPort is a PC focused display standard developed by Visa,often offering strong bandwidth,locking connectors,adaptive sync support and MST daisy chaining.

It is commonly preferred for high refresh gaming monitors and multi-monitor setups.

DisplayPort can also output through USB-C using DisplayPort Alt mode.

Cable quality and length still matter and adapter direction is a key troubleshooting point,especially for DisplayPort to HDMI versus HDMI to DisplayPort.

Next,we'll cover DVI and VGA which are older display connections you still encounter in legacy monitors and projectors.

127. DVI 与 VGA 线缆

大家好！

尽管高清多媒体接口和显示端口在现代系统中占据主导地位，但在实际工作中，你仍然会遇到数字视频接口和视频图形阵列。

会议室、学校、旧式投影仪、遗留显示器和工业系统通常依赖这些连接。

对于A Plus支持工作，目标是了解哪一种是模拟信号，哪一种是数字信号，哪些适配器是无源的而有源的是哪些，以及为什么显示器在某些分辨率下看起来模糊或无法同步。

视频图形阵列是经典的模拟视频连接器，通常被识别为带有三排针脚的蓝色十五针D型接口。

由于视频图形阵列是模拟信号，信号质量在很大程度上取决于线缆质量、线缆长度和干扰情况。

随着线缆长度增加，用户可能会看到模糊、重影或色边，因为模拟信号会衰减。

在某些情况下，视频图形阵列可以工作在较高分辨率下，但当你提高分辨率和距离时，质量通常会变得无法接受。

视频图形阵列对电磁干扰很敏感，因此将视频图形阵列线缆靠近电源线或嘈杂的电气设备会产生可见的伪影。

松动的视频图形阵列螺丝也会导致间歇性信号丢失或颜色通道问题，因为该连接器依赖于物理针脚接触。

如果用户抱怨在同一台显示器上，图像看起来比使用高清多媒体接口时柔和，那通常仅仅是因为视频图形阵列的模拟特性。

支持工作的思路是：视频图形阵列虽然可用但并不理想，应尽可能将其替换为数字连接。

视频图形阵列在旧式投影仪和教室设备上仍然常见，也可能出现在旧款台式机、旧款显示器和某些键盘视频鼠标切换器设置中。

你也可以在一些多年前设计且从未升级的销售点系统和工业设备中看到它。

这就是为什么技术人员仍然携带视频图形阵列适配器，因为当投影仪只有视频图形阵列接口时，你需要一种可靠的方式来连接现代笔记本电脑。

数字视频接口（DVI）被设计为从模拟视频图形阵列到数字平板显示器的过渡桥梁。

它是一个拥有许多针脚的大型连接器，最常见于旧款台式机显卡和显示器上。

数字视频接口相对于视频图形阵列的最大优势在于数字信号传输，这避免了模拟信号的柔和感和干扰伪影。

最大的局限性是数字视频接口通常只传输视频，不传输音频，因此它不像高清多媒体接口那样是音视频单线缆解决方案。

数字视频接口有几种重要的类型。

DVI-D仅支持数字信号。

DVI-I是集成式的，意味着它可以同时传输数字和模拟信号，这就是为什么一些数字视频接口端口可以使用简单的视频图形阵列适配器。

DVI-A仅支持模拟信号，比较罕见。

另一个实用的概念是单链路对双链路。

单链路通常支持高达每秒六十赫兹的一九二零乘一二零零分辨率，而双链路支持更高的分辨率，例如二五六零乘一六零零。

对于考试，关键是认识到数字视频接口是唯一支持被动转换为视频图形阵列的接口。

避免错误的最简单方法是将端口类型与线缆类型相匹配。

DVI-I拥有支持模拟信号的额外针脚组，而DVI-D缺少这些模拟针脚。

如果你试图强行插入错误的连接器，它将无法完全贴合，这是一个提示你使用了错误线缆的线索。

在故障排查中，如果用户使用数字视频接口转高清多媒体接口适配器获得了视频但没有声音，这是预期的，因为数字视频接口不传输音频。

数字视频接口到高清多媒体接口的视频转换通常很简单，因为数字视频信号是兼容的，但如果没有单独的音频连接，你仍然无法从数字视频接口获得音频。

视频图形阵列转高清多媒体接口或视频图形阵列转数字视频接口的转换则不同，因为它需要将模拟信号转换为数字信号，这需要带有电子元件的有源转换器，并且通常需要外部电源。

这是一个重要的考试要点。

模拟转数字通常需要主动转换，无源适配器不会神奇地转换信号类型。

视频图形阵列是一种较旧的模拟视频连接，会随着距离增加而衰减并对干扰敏感，但在遗留投影仪和设备上仍然常见。

数字视频接口是一种过渡标准，提供数字视频质量，其中DVI-D仅支持数字信号，而DVI-I同时支持数字和模拟信号以实现兼容性。

数字视频接口通常不传输音频，而将模拟视频图形阵列转换为数字高清多媒体接口或显示端口需要有源适配器。

接下来，我们将进入通用串行总线C型线缆的话题，这类线缆很常见，但常被误解，因为连接器形状并不能保证特定的速度、功率或视频能力。

英文原文

Hey everyone!

Even though HDMI and DisplayPort dominate modern systems,you will still run into DVI and VGA in the field.

Conference rooms,schools,older projectors,legacy monitors and industrial systems often rely on these connections.

For A-plus support,the goal is knowing which is analog,which is digital,what adapters are passive versus active and why a display might look blurry or fail to sync at certain resolutions.

VGA is the classic analog video connector,often recognized as a blue 15-pin D-sub with three rows of pins.

Because VGA is analog,signal quality depends heavily on cable quality,cable length and interference.

As cable length increases,users may see blur,ghosting or color fringing because the analog signal degrades.

VGA can work at higher resolutions in some cases,but quality often becomes unacceptable as you push resolution and distance.

VGA is sensitive to electromagnetic interference,so running a VGA cable near power cables or noisy electrical equipment can produce visible artifacts.

Loose VGA screws can also cause intermittent signal loss or color channel problems because the connector relies on physical pin contact.

If a user complains that the image looks soft compared to HDMI on the same monitor,that is often simply the analog nature of VGA.

The support mindset is that VGA is functional but not ideal and you replace it with a digital connection when possible.

VGA is still common on older projectors and classroom equipment and it can appear on older desktops,older monitors and certain KVM setups.

You also see it in some point of sale and industrial gear that was designed years ago and never upgraded.

This is why technicians still carry VGA adapters because when a projector only has VGA,you need a reliable way to connect modern laptops.

DVI digital visual interface was designed as a bridge from analog VGA into digital flat panel displays.

It is a large connector with many pins most commonly seen on older desktop GPUs and monitors.

The big advantage of DVI over VGA is digital signal delivery which avoids analog softness and interference artifacts.

The big limitation is that DVI typically carries video only,not audio,so it is not a single cable audio video solution like HTMI.

DVI comes in a few important types.

DVID is digital only.

DVII is integrated,meaning it can carry both digital and analog signals,which is why some DVI ports can use simple VGA adapters.

DVIA is analogue only and is rare.

Another practical concept is single link vs.dual link.

Single link commonly supports up to around 1920 by 1200 at 60Hz,while dual link supports higher resolutions such as 2560 by 1600.

For the exam,the key is recognizing that DVI is the one that can support passive conversion to VGA.

The easiest way to avoid mistakes is matching the port type to the cable type.

DVI1 has extra pin groups that support analog signals,while DVID lacks those analog pins.

If you try to force the wrong connector,it won't fit cleanly and that is a clue you are using the wrong cable.

In troubleshooting,if a user uses a DVI to HTMI adapter and gets video but no sound,that's expected because DVI does not carry audio.

DVI to HDMI conversion is usually simple for video because the digital video signaling is compatible,but you still won't get audio from DVI without a separate audio connection.

VGA to HTMI or VGA to DVI conversion is different because it requires converting an analog signal into digital which requires an active converter with electronics and often external power.

This is a major exam point.

Analog to digital generally requires active conversion and passive adapters will not magically convert signal types.

VGA is an older analog video connection that degrades with distance and is sensitive to interference but is still common on legacy projectors and equipment.

DVI is a transitional standard that provides digital video quality with DVID being digital only and DVI I supporting both digital and analog for compatibility.

DVI does not normally carry audio and analog VGA conversion to digital HDMI or display port requires active adapters.

Next we'll move into USB C cables which are common and often misunderstood because the connector shape does not guarantee specific speed,power or video capability.

128. USB-C 线缆

大家好，现在我们来聊聊通用串行总线C型接口，这种小巧的可逆连接器正迅速成为充电、数据传输甚至视频输出的通用标准。

通用串行总线C型接口正在取代旧式连接器，如通用串行总线A型接口、微型通用串行总线接口以及许多专有充电端口。

它还可以通过替代模式取代轻薄笔记本电脑上的显示端口。

在A Plus考试中，通用串行总线C型接口很重要，因为这种连接器虽然简单，但其功能却令人困惑，故障排查往往归结为理解特定端口和线缆实际支持的功能。

通用串行总线C型接口是可逆的，意味着插入时没有正反之分。

这听起来微不足道，但它消除了用户常见的挫败感，并减少了因反复尝试错误插入而造成的磨损。

通用串行总线C型接口在物理上也很紧凑，且两端形状相同，这有助于设备制造商在手机、平板电脑、笔记本电脑和配件上标准化端口。

这是最重要的考试规则。

通用串行总线C型接口描述的是连接器的形状，而非性能。

一个通用串行总线C型接口端口可能仅以每秒四百八十兆比特的速度运行通用串行总线二点零，也可能支持更快的通用串行总线数据模式。

或者它可能支持速率高达每秒四十吉比特的雷电技术。

它可能支持视频输出，也可能不支持。

它可能支持高瓦数充电，也可能仅支持低功率。

你无法仅凭连接器就假设其功能，这就是为什么通用串行总线C型接口在实际工作中引起如此多困惑的原因。

通用串行总线C型接口可以承载多种通用串行总线标准。

通过通用串行总线C型接口传输的通用串行总线二点零速度仍然是每秒四百八十兆比特。

通用串行总线三点零类别的速度包括每秒五吉比特、每秒十吉比特和每秒二十吉比特，具体取决于所支持的通用串行总线代际。

在支持的实现中，通用串行总线四点零的速度可达每秒四十吉比特。

实际的故障排查规则是：你的实际速度受限于最慢的组件，这意味着设备、端口和线缆都必须支持相同的性能等级。

通用串行总线C型接口支持通用串行总线电力输送，这使得其瓦数远高于旧式通用串行总线标准。

电力输送可扩展至笔记本电脑级别的充电，这就是为什么许多现代笔记本电脑通过通用串行总线C型接口充电，而不是使用专有充电器。

电力输送是在充电器和设备之间协商的，因此设备会请求其安全使用的功率。

这就是为什么手机可以使用笔记本电脑充电器充电，而笔记本电脑有时也可以使用更高瓦数的通用串行总线C型接口移动电源充电，只要配置文件匹配即可。

通用串行总线电力输送使用协商机制，因此设备可以选择不同的电压和电流组合。

常见的功率水平包括五伏三安、九伏三安、十五伏三安，以及用于高压充电的二十伏五安。

支持工作的要点是：并非每个通用串行总线C型接口充电器和线缆都支持高瓦数。

如果笔记本电脑充电缓慢或根本无法充电，问题可能是充电器瓦数太低，或者线缆无法承载所需的电流。

通用串行总线C型接口可以通过替代模式传输视频，其中显示端口替代模式最为常见。

这使得通用串行总线C型接口端口能够向显示器和扩展坞输出视频，这就是为什么许多轻薄笔记本电脑可以通过通用串行总线C型转高清多媒体接口或通用串行总线C型转显示端口适配器连接到外部显示器。

关键的故障排查点是：并非每个通用串行总线C型接口端口都支持视频输出。

如果用户插入通用串行总线C型显示适配器却没有任何反应，问题可能是该端口仅用于数据传输，不支持显示端口替代模式。

雷电技术三代和四代也使用通用串行总线C型接口连接器。

支持雷电技术的通用串行总线C型接口端口可以支持超高速数据、视频和扩展坞功能，包括对外部显卡的支持。

雷电技术端口通常标有闪电符号。

备考的关键概念是：雷电技术使用通用串行总线C型接口的形状，但提供超越基本通用串行总线的额外功能，你需要兼容的线缆和设备才能获得全部性能。

并非所有通用串行总线C型线缆都是相同的。

有些仅用于充电，有些支持数据传输但仅限于通用串行总线二点零速度，有些支持更高速的通用串行总线模式，还有些支持具备五安培能力的高瓦数充电。

许多用户购买了廉价的通用串行总线C型线缆，然后纳闷为什么外部固态硬盘速度慢，或者为什么笔记本电脑充电不稳定。

支持工作的习惯是使用已知良好的认证线缆，并使线缆的额定值与任务相匹配，尤其是对于高速数据和高瓦数充电。

优质线缆可能会标有数据速度评级或功率评级，但许多线缆的标签标识不清。

这就是为什么技术人员通常会保留一小套用于特定任务的已知良好线缆，例如已知良好的高瓦数充电线缆和已知良好的高速数据线缆。

在故障排查中，换用已知良好的线缆通常是隔离线缆是否为限制因素的最快方法。

通用串行总线C型接口现在广泛应用于手机、平板电脑、笔记本电脑、扩展坞、显示器、外部存储设备和许多配件。

它正成为默认连接器，因为它可以传输电力、数据和视频。

这种通用性很棒，但也意味着错误很常见，因为相同的端口形状在不同设备上的表现可能大相径庭。

对于A Plus考试，关键是将连接器形状与底层功能区分开来。

通用串行总线C型接口是一种可逆的连接器形状，可以支持广泛的数据速度、电力输送等级，甚至通过替代模式进行视频输出。

通用串行总线C型接口可以承载从通用串行总线二点零到通用串行总线四点零的任何内容，并且可以支持用于笔记本电脑充电的通用串行总线电力输送。

一些通用串行总线C型接口端口支持显示端口替代模式，一些支持雷电技术，但并非所有都支持。

线缆功能与端口功能同样重要，因此使用认证的已知良好线缆可以防止许多“能插进去但工作不正常”的问题。

英文原文

Hey everyone,now let's talk about USB-C,the small reversible connector that is quickly becoming the universal standard for charging,data and even video.

USB-C is replacing older connectors like USB-A,micro-USB and many proprietary charging ports.

It can also replace display ports on thin laptops through alternate modes.

On the A-plus exam,USB-C is important because the connector is easy but the capabilities are confusing and troubleshooting often comes down to understanding what a specific port and cable actually supports.

USB-C is reversible,meaning there is no wrong way to plug it in.

This sounds minor,but it eliminates a common user frustration and reduces wear from repeated incorrect insertion attempts.

USB-C is also physically compact and identical on both ends,which helps device manufacturers standardize ports across phones,tablets,laptops and accessories.

Here is the most important exam rule.

USB-C describes the connector shape,not the performance.

A USB-C port might only run USB 2.0 at 480Mbps or it might support much faster USB data modes.

Or it might support Thunderbolt at 40Gbps.

It might support video output or it might not.

It might support high watt charging or it might be low power only.

You cannot assume capabilities from the connector alone,which is why USB-C causes so much confusion in the field.

USB-C can carry multiple USB standards.

USB 2.0 over USB-C is still 480Mbps.

USB 3 class speeds include 5 Gbps,10 Gbps and 20Gbps depending on the USB generation supported.

USB 4 can reach up to 40 Gbps in supported implementations.

The practical troubleshooting rule is that your real speed is limited by the slowest component,meaning the device,the port and the cable all need to support the same performance tier.

USB-C supports USB power delivery which enables much higher wattage than older USB standards.

Power delivery can scale to laptop class charging which is why many modern laptops charge through USB-C instead of a proprietary charger.

Power delivery is negotiated between the charger and the device so the device requests what it can safely use.

This is why a phone can charge from a laptop charger and a laptop can sometimes charge from a higher watt USB-C power bank as long as the profiles match.

USB power delivery uses negotiation so devices can select different voltage and current combinations.

Common power levels include five volts at three amps,nine volts at three amps,fifteen volts at three amps,and twenty volts at five amps for high voltage charging.

The support takeaway is that not every USB-C charger and cable supports high wattage.

If a laptop charges slowly or not at all,the issue may be that the charger wattage is too low or the cable cannot carry the required current.

USB-C can carry video using alternate modes,with DisplayPort Alt mode being the most common.

This allows a USB-C port to output video to monitors and docks,which is why many thin laptops can connect to an external monitor with a USB-C to HDMI or USB-C to DisplayPort adapter.

The key troubleshooting point is that not every USB-C port supports video output.

If a user plugs in a USB-C display adapter and nothing happens,the issue may be that the port is data only and does not support DisplayPort Alt mode.

Thunderbolt 3 and 4 also use USB-C connectors.

A Thunderbolt capable USB-C port can support very high-speed data,video and docking features,including external GPU support.

Thunderbolt ports are typically marked with a lightning bolt symbol.

The exam ready idea is that Thunderbolt uses the USB-C shape but offers additional capabilities beyond basic USB and you need compatible cables and devices to get full performance.

Not all USB-C cables are equal.

Some are charge only,some are data capable but limited to USB 2 speeds,some support higher speed USB modes and some support high watt charging with 5 amp capability.

Many users buy a cheap USB-C cable and then wonder why an external SSD is slow or why a laptop charges inconsistently.

The support habit is to use known good certified cables and to match the cable's rating to the task,especially for high speed data and high watt charging.

Good cables may be marked with data speed ratings or power ratings,but many cables are poorly labeled.

This is why technicians often keep a small set of known good cables for specific jobs like a known good high watt charging cable and a known good high speed data cable.

In troubleshooting,swapping in a known good cable is often the fastest way to isolate whether the cable is the limiting factor.

USB-C is now common across phones,tablets,laptops,docks,monitors,external storage and many accessories.

It is becoming the default connector because it can carry power,data and video.

That universality is great,but it also means mistakes are common because the same port shape can behave very differently across devices.

For the A plus exam,the key is to separate connector shape from underlying capability.

USB C is a reversible connector shape that can support a wide range of data speeds,power delivery levels,and even video output through alternate modes.

USB-C can carry anything from USB 2.0 up through USB 4 and it can support USB power delivery for laptop charging.

Some USB-C ports support DisplayPort Alt mode and some support Thunderbolt,but not all do.

Cable capability matters just as much as port capability,so certified known good cables prevent many it fits but it doesn't work right problems.

129. SATA 与 eSATA 线缆

大家好，我们来聊聊串行高级技术附件，也就是SATA，这是用于内部硬盘驱动器和许多内部固态硬盘的标准连接。

SATA取代了旧式的并行高级技术附件排线，多年来已成为默认的内部存储接口。

了解SATA版本、线缆类型以及外部变体eSATA，有助于你正确安装驱动器，并排查驱动器未被检测到或速度缓慢的问题。

SATA的推出是为了取代并行高级技术附件（也称为集成驱动电子设备），后者使用宽大的排线，会阻碍气流，并且需要主从跳线等旧式配置规则。

SATA使用纤细的线缆，更易于布线，能改善气流并简化安装。

在许多实现中，SATA还支持热插拔，这意味着当控制器和系统配置支持时，可以在系统运行时连接和断开驱动器。

SATA有三个主要的速度代际。

SATA一代的运行速度为每秒一点五吉比特，约为每秒一百五十兆字节。

SATA二代的运行速度为每秒三吉比特，约为每秒三百兆字节。

SATA三代的运行速度为每秒六吉比特，约为每秒六百兆字节。

关键的考试规则是向后兼容性。

SATA三代驱动器可以在SATA二代端口上工作，但其运行速度为SATA二代的速度。

SATA数据线是一种细线缆，配有扁平狭窄的连接器，拥有七个针脚。

它采用L形防呆设计，防止插反。

这根线缆仅传输数据，它将驱动器连接到主板或SATA控制器卡。

在实际故障排查中，松动的SATA数据线是导致间歇性检测不到、随机断开或在负载下驱动器消失的经典原因。

SATA驱动器需要从电源单独连接电源线。

SATA电源连接器比数据连接器更宽，拥有十五个针脚，同样采用L形防呆设计。

它可以提供三点三伏、五伏和十二伏电压，尽管许多驱动器主要使用五伏和十二伏。

如果驱动器无法旋转或根本无法通电，验证SATA电源连接与验证数据线同样重要。

安装SATA驱动器很简单。

将驱动器安装在托架中，从电源连接SATA电源线，并从驱动器连接SATA数据线到主板SATA端口，这些端口通常标记为SATA零、SATA一等等。

与并行高级技术附件不同，SATA在典型的单驱动器连接中不需要主从跳线设置。

如果系统未检测到驱动器，A Plus的排查流程是检查基本输入输出系统或统一可扩展固件接口检测、验证两根线缆、尝试不同的SATA端口，并试用已知良好的线缆。

SATA仍然常用于三点五英寸硬盘和二点五英寸驱动器，尤其是在台式机和许多旧款笔记本电脑中。

许多SATA固态硬盘仍然存在，但高性能固态硬盘通常转而使用基于M点二接口的非易失性内存主机控制器接口规范，因为后者提供更高的吞吐量和更低的延迟。

一个常见的现实模式是：外部通用串行总线硬盘盒内部通常包含一个SATA驱动器，通过硬盘盒控制器将SATA转换为通用串行总线。

eSATA旨在将SATA扩展到计算机外部，使外部驱动器能以SATA速度运行。

它使用专为外部用途设计的更坚固的连接器，并支持相同的SATA速度代际。

主要的缺点是供电问题。

标准eSATA仅传输数据，因此外部驱动器需要自己的电源适配器或单独的电源连接。

这使得eSATA对普通用户来说不如通用串行总线方便。

eSATA从未成为主流，因为大多数计算机不包含eSATA端口，而且它无法通过同一根线缆供电。

一旦通用串行总线三点零以多吉比特速度和内置供电能力问世，通用串行总线就成了外部存储更简单的通用选择。

如今，eSATA很罕见，主要出现在旧系统或某些遗留的外部存储设备中。

一些系统使用了eSATA P，也称为eSATA供电，它试图在共享端口形式中将eSATA与电力结合，有时还兼具通用串行总线兼容性。

这减少了单独电源线的问题，但它仍然不常见，且现在基本上已过时。

对于考试，关键点在于识别。

如果你在旧硬件上看到eSATA P，它是一个遗留的便利功能，而非现代标准。

SATA是许多硬盘驱动器和SATA固态硬盘的标准内部存储连接，使用七针数据线和十五针电源线。

SATA一代为每秒一点五吉比特，SATA二代为每秒三吉比特，SATA三代为每秒六吉比特，它们向后兼容，速度降至最慢环节的水平。

eSATA将SATA速度带到了外部存储，但需要单独供电，并被通用串行总线三点零所取代。

接下来，我们将介绍线缆适配器，这是你在实际支持工作中解决“我的设备与我的端口不匹配”问题的方法。

英文原文

Hey everyone,let's talk about SATA which stands for Serial ATA,the standard connection used for internal hard drives and many internal SSDs.

SATA replaced the old parallel ATA ribbon cables and became the default internal storage interface for years.

Understanding SATA versions,cable types and the external variant eSATA helps you install drives correctly and troubleshoot drive not detected or slow drive complaints.

SATA was introduced to replace PATA,also called IDE,which used wide ribbon cables that blocked airflow and required older configuration rules like master and slave jumpers.

SATA uses thin cables that are easier to route,improve airflow and simplify installation.

SATA also supports hot swapping in many implementations,meaning drives can be connected and disconnected while the system is running when the controller and system configuration support it.

SATA has three major speed generations.

SATA 1 runs at 1.5 Gbps which is about 150MB per second.

SATA 2 runs at 3 Gbps,about 300MB per second.

SATA 3 runs at 6 Gbps,about 600MB per second.

The key exam rule is backward compatibility.

A SATA 3 drive works in a SATA 2 port but it operates at SATA 2 speed.

The SATA data cable is a thin cable with a flat narrow connector that has 7 pins.

It uses an L-shaped key which prevents plugging it in the wrong way.

This cable carries data only and it connects the drive to the motherboard or to a SATA controller card.

In real troubleshooting,a loose SATA data cable is a classic cause of intermittent detection,random disconnects or a drive disappearing under load.

SATA drives require a separate power connection from the power supply.

The SATA power connector is wider than the data connector and has 15 pins also keyed with an L shape.

It can provide 3.3 volts,5 volts and 12 volts though many drives primarily use 5 and 12.

If a drive is not spinning up or not powering on at all,verifying the SATA power connection is just as important as verifying the data cable.

Installing a SATA drive is straightforward.

Mount the drive in its bay,connect SATA power from the power supply and connect a SATA data cable from the drive to a motherboard SATA port,often labeled SATA 0,SATA 1 and so on.

Unlike PATA,SATA does not require master and slave jumper settings for typical single drive connections.

If the system does not detect the drive,the A plus workflow is to check BIOS or UEFI detection,verify both cables,try a different SATA port and try a known good cable.

SATA is still common for 3.5 inch hard drives and 2.5 inch drives especially in desktops and many older laptops.

Many SATA SSDs still exist but high performance SSDs often use NVME over M.2 instead because NVMe provides much higher throughput and lower latency.

A common real world pattern is that external USB drive enclosures often contain an internal SATA drive inside,converting SATA to USB through the enclosure controller.

eSATA was designed to extend SATA outside the computer so external drives could run at SATA speeds.

It uses a more robust connector designed for external use and supports the same SATA speed generations.

The major drawback is power.

Standard eSATA carries data only,so external drives need their own power adapter or separate power connection.

This made eSATA less convenient than USB for typical users.

eSATA never became mainstream because most computers did not include eSATA ports and because it could not deliver power through the same cable.

Once USB 3 arrived with multi-gigabit speeds and built-in power delivery,USB became the simpler universal option for external storage.

Today,eSATA is rare and mostly shows up in older systems or certain legacy external storage equipment.

Some systems used eSATA P,also called Power over ESATA,which attempted to combine eSATA and power,sometimes alongside USB compatibility,in a shared port form.

This reduced the separate power cable problem,but it remained uncommon and is largely obsolete now.

For the exam,the key point is recognition.

If you see eSATA P on older hardware,it is a legacy convenience feature rather than a modern standard.

SATA is the standard internal storage connection for many hard drives and SATA SSDs using a 7 pin data cable and a 15 pin power cable.

SATA 1 is 1.5 Gbps,SATA 2 is 3 Gbps and SATA 3 is 6Gbps and they are backward compatible with speed falling to the slowest link.

ESATA brought SATA speeds to external storage but required separate power and was overtaken by USB 3.

Next we'll cover cable adapters which are how you solve my device doesn't match my port problems in real support work.

130. 线缆适配器

大家好，在实际的IT工作中，你很少能恰好拥有与所需端口完美匹配的线缆。

你可能有一台配备通用串行总线C型接口的笔记本电脑和一台配备高清多媒体接口接口的投影仪，或者是一台配备显示端口的台式机和一台配备高清多媒体接口接口的显示器，亦或是一台仍在使用视频图形阵列接口的遗留系统。

线缆适配器的存在就是为了弥合这些差距，但A Plus考试期望你了解哪些适配器是简单的，哪些需要电子元件来转换信号。

关键概念是：适配器可以改变连接器的形状，但它们无法神奇地改变源设备能够输出的内容。

适配器分为两类：无源和有源。

无源适配器基本上只是针脚重映射，意味着它们只改变物理连接器，而不改变底层信号。

它们便宜且可靠，但仅在信号类型兼容时才有效。

有源适配器包含转换电子元件，能将一种信号类型转换为另一种，并且通常需要供电。

它们成本更高，可能会引入兼容性问题，但在你需要在根本不同的信号格式之间进行转换时，它们是必不可少的。

通用串行总线适配器极为常见，因为许多系统仍然混合使用通用串行总线A型接口和通用串行总线C型接口。

这些适配器通常是无源的，因为它们只是改变连接器形状。

与考试相关的规则是速度回退。

使用适配器不会提高速度，连接将以设备、线缆和端口三者中支持的最慢速度运行。

如果用户将通用串行总线二点零设备插入通用串行总线C型接口端口，即使该端口支持更快的速度，它仍将以通用串行总线二点零的速度运行。

从显示端口到高清多媒体接口是最有用的适配器场景之一，因为它通常是无源的，并且在实际生活中效果很好，尤其适用于演示文稿。

许多显示端口输出支持双模式功能，可以输出兼容高清多媒体接口的视频，因此简单的适配器无需有源转换即可工作。

支持工作的思路是：从显示端口到高清多媒体接口通常很容易，而反向操作往往并非如此。

从高清多媒体接口到显示端口通常是有源转换场景，意味着你需要一个带有电子元件的适配器，因为高清多媒体接口源通常无法直接输出显示端口信号。

这些适配器可能更昂贵，并且可能需要外部电源。

如果有人购买了廉价的高清多媒体接口转显示端口线缆却无法工作，可能的原因是他们需要一个有源转换器，而该线缆并未进行真正的信号转换。

从DVI-D到高清多媒体接口的视频转换通常是无源的，因为数字视频信号是兼容的，但数字视频接口通常不传输音频。

这意味着数字视频接口转高清多媒体接口适配器可以为你提供视频但没有声音，这是一个常见的现实意外。

如果用户报告图像正常但没有音频，快速排查的方法是确认源是否为数字视频接口，因为解决方案通常是添加单独的音频线缆，或者改用高清多媒体接口或显示端口输出。

视频图形阵列是模拟信号，而高清多媒体接口和显示端口是数字信号。

因此，从视频图形阵列到高清多媒体接口或从视频图形阵列到显示端口通常需要一个执行模数转换的有源转换器。

这些转换器通常从通用串行总线获取电力。

考试技能在于认识到模数转换不能是无源的。

此外，将视频图形阵列转换为数字信号很少能提高质量，因为你仍然受限于视频图形阵列提供的模拟信号质量。

通用串行总线转以太网适配器很常见，因为许多轻薄笔记本电脑缺乏RJ四十五端口，而这些适配器能为故障排查提供可靠的有线网络连接。

通用串行总线二点零以太网适配器的速度上限通常为每秒一百兆比特，而通用串行总线三点零以太网适配器支持千兆比特速度。

通用串行总线转串行适配器对于访问网络设备和遗留设备的控制台也至关重要。

它们在操作系统中创建COM端口，且质量至关重要，因为驱动程序支持是一个常见的故障点。

有些转换根本无法通过廉价的无源适配器实现。

高清多媒体接口转视频图形阵列需要有源转换，使用廉价产品时经常会失败。

通用串行总线适配器无法将慢速设备升级为快速设备，因此通用串行总线二点零设备仍然是通用串行总线二点零。

在链路中进行多次转换，例如从通用串行总线C型接口到高清多媒体接口再到视频图形阵列，也是不可靠的，应尽可能避免。

考试的思维模式始终是：首选原生连接路径，其次是单个正确的适配器，最后才考虑复杂的转换。

线缆适配器解决了连接器不匹配的问题，但适配器的类型很重要。

无源适配器重映射兼容的信号，简单且可靠；而有源适配器转换不兼容的信号，可能需要供电。

从显示端口到高清多媒体接口以及从DVI-D到高清多媒体接口的视频转换通常是无源的，而从视频图形阵列到高清多媒体接口以及从高清多媒体接口到显示端口通常需要有源转换。

通用串行总线转以太网和通用串行总线转串行是故障排查中经常使用的常见有源适配器。

接下来，我们将以连接器类型概述结束本节，以便你能快速识别A Plus考试中最重要的连接器。

英文原文

Hey everyone,in real IT work,you rarely get a perfect match between the cable you have and the port you need.

You might have a laptop with USB-C and a projector with HDMI,or a desktop with DisplayPort and a monitor with HDMI,or a legacy system that still uses VGA.

Cable adapters exist to bridge those gaps,but the A-plus exam expects you to know which adapters are simple and which require electronics to convert the signal.

The key idea is that adapters can change connector shapes,but they cannot magically change what the source device is capable of outputting.

Adapters fall into two categories,passive and active.

Passive adapters are basically pin remaps,meaning they change the physical connector but do not change the underlying signal.

They are cheap and reliable,but they only work when the signal types are compatible.

Active adapters contain conversion electronics that translate one signal type into another and they often require power.

They cost more and can introduce compatibility issues,but they are necessary when you are converting between fundamentally different signal formats.

USP adapters are extremely common because many systems are still mixed between USB-A and USB-C.

These adapters are typically passive because they are just changing connector shape.

The exam relevant rule is speed fallback.

Using an adapter does not increase speed and the connection runs at the slowest supported speed between the device,cable and port.

If a user plugs a USB 2 device into a USB-C port,it will still run at USB 2 speed even if the port supports much more.

DisplayPort to HDMI is one of the most useful adapter scenarios because it is often passive and works well in real life,especially for presentations.

Many DisplayPort outputs support a dual mode capability that can output HDMI compatible video,so a simple adapter can work without active conversion.

The support mindset is that DisplayPort to HDMI is usually easy,while the reverse direction often is not.

HDMI to DisplayPort is often an active conversion scenario,meaning you need an adapter with electronics because HDMI sources typically cannot output display port signaling directly.

These adapters can be more expensive and may require external power.

If someone buys a cheap HDMI to DisplayPort cable and it doesn't work,the likely cause is that they needed an active converter and the cable is not doing real signal conversion.

DVID to HDMI conversion is often passive for video because the digital video signals are compatible but DVI typically does not carry audio.

That means a D VI to HTMI adapter can give you video but no sound,which is a common real-world surprise.

If a user reports picture works but no audio,verifying whether the source is DVI is a fast fix because the solution is usually adding a separate audio cable or switching to HDMI or DisplayPort output instead.

VGA is analog and HDMI and DisplayPort are digital.

So VGA to HDMI or VGA to DisplayPort usually requires an active converter that performs analog to digital conversion.

These converters often draw power from USP.

The exam skill is recognizing that analog to digital conversion cannot be passive.

Also,converting VGA to digital rarely improves quality because you are still limited by the analog signal quality VGA provides.

USB to Ethernet adapters are common because many thin laptops lack RJ45 ports and these adapters provide reliable wired networking for troubleshooting.

USB 2 Ethernet adapters often top out at 100 megabit speeds while USB 3 Ethernet adapters support gigabit speeds.

USB to serial adapters are also critical for console access to network equipment and legacy devices.

They create a COM port in the operating system and quality matters because driver support is a common failure point.

Some conversions simply do not work with cheap passive adapters.

HDMI to VGA requires active conversion and often fails with cheap products.

USB adapters cannot upgrade a slow device into a fast one so a USB 2 device stays USB 2.

Converting multiple times in a chain like USB C to HDMI to VGA is also unreliable and should be avoided when possible.

The exam mindset is always to prefer a native connection path first,then a single correct adapter and only then consider complex conversions.

Cable adapters solve connector mismatch problems but the type of adapter matters.

Passive adapters remap compatible signals and are simple and reliable while active adapters convert incompatible signals and may require power.

DisplayPort to HDMI and DVID to HDMI are often passive for video while VGA to HDMI and HDMI to display port usually require active conversion.

USP to Ethernet and USB to serial are common active adapters used constantly in troubleshooting.

Next we'll wrap up this section with a connector types overview so you can quickly recognize the most important connectors on the A Plus exam.

131. 连接器类型概述

大家好，为了结束第十四节，我们来做一个连接器概述，因为快速故障排查的最有效方法之一就是识别你眼前看到的是什么。

如果你能迅速区分RJ四十五与RJ十一、高清多媒体接口与显示端口、或者串行高级技术附件电源线与数据线，你就能减少错误并更快地解决问题。

A Plus考试很喜欢考查识别题，而实际工作也回报同样的技能，因为它能防止浪费时间和使用错误的适配器。

RJ十一是一种较小的模块化连接器，用于电话风格的连接。

它看起来像RJ四十五但更窄，通常使用的导线更少，尽管插头可能有多个位置。

你可以在电话、旧式传真机、一些调制解调器和某些数字用户线路设置中看到RJ十一。

一个快速识别的技巧是宽度。

如果它明显比以太网接口窄，那很可能是RJ十一。

RJ四十五是标准的以太网连接器，比RJ十一宽，设计用于八根导线。

它用于超五类、六类和六类增强型双绞线电缆，连接个人电脑、交换机、路由器、配线架、墙壁插座以及许多互联网服务提供商设备，如有线调制解调器和网关。

在实际工作中，RJ四十五是你接触最多的连接器之一，而卡扣断裂和连接松动等问题是常见的物理故障点。

F型连接器是一种螺纹同轴连接器，用于有线电视、有线互联网和许多卫星连接。

中心导体成为中心针脚，螺纹collar旋入端口。

你可以在有线调制解调器、机顶盒、分配器和墙壁同轴插座上找到F型连接器。

螺旋式设计有助于保持信号完整性，但连接器松动和过多的分配器是信号问题的常见来源。光纤连接器有几种常见类型。

LC是一种小型现代连接器，看起来像一个微型网络插头，通常成对出现（双工），用于发送和接收。

SC更大且呈方形，使用推拉式卡扣，在许多环境和旧式安装中很常见。

ST较旧，使用旋转锁定卡口机制。

考试的要点是识别和上下文。

光纤连接器用于基于光的链路，常用于上行链路、骨干网和长距离传输。

通用串行总线A型是经典的矩形连接器，见于电脑和充电器上，只能单向插入。

通用串行总线B型是较方的连接器，见于打印机和一些较大的外围设备上。

微型通用串行总线是在通用串行总线C型出现之前主导旧款智能手机和配件的小型连接器。

通用串行总线C型是可逆的椭圆形连接器，现在广泛应用于手机、平板电脑、笔记本电脑和扩展坞。

考试陷阱在于：通用串行总线C型只是一种形状，并不保证速度或功能。

高清多媒体接口是一种常见的扁平连接器，广泛用于电视、显示器和投影仪，同时传输音频和视频。

显示端口常见于个人电脑和显示器，全尺寸连接器上通常带有卡扣。

数字视频接口是一种大型多针连接器，主要用于旧式计算机设备，通常仅传输视频。

视频图形阵列是较旧的蓝色模拟连接器，拥有三排共十五个针脚，常见于遗留投影仪和旧款显示器。

快速识别这些连接器有助于你选择正确的适配器，并避免模数转换带来的意外。

串行高级技术附件数据连接器小巧、狭窄且有七个针脚，它们将驱动器连接到主板以传输数据。

串行高级技术附件电源连接器更宽，有十五个针脚，来自电源供应器。

两者都使用L形防呆设计，但尺寸不同，不能互相替代。

对于故障排查，如果未检测到驱动器，你需要检查数据路径和电源路径，因为任何一条都可能是故障点。

DB九是串行连接器，用于RS二百三十二风格的连接，常见于网络设备的控制台访问和遗留设备。

你可能还会在一些台式机上看到旧式电源连接器，如Molex，用于遗留驱动器和配件。

考试的角度是能够在混合环境中识别这些连接器，并了解它们的典型用途。

第十四节专注于线缆和连接器基础知识，而连接器识别是提高故障排查速度的最快方法之一。

RJ四十五是以太网，RJ十一是电话风格，F型是同轴，LC、SC和ST是光纤，通用串行总线有多种形状，其中通用串行总线C型是现代可逆连接器。

视频连接器包括作为现代标准的高清多媒体接口和显示端口，以及作为遗留标准的数字视频接口和视频图形阵列。

串行高级技术附件使用独立的数据和电源连接器。

如果你能识别连接器，通常就能预测信号类型，选择正确的线缆或适配器，并更有效地进行故障排查。

英文原文

Hey everyone,to finish section 14,let's do a connector overview because one of the fastest ways to troubleshoot is recognizing what you're looking at.

If you can quickly identify RJ45 vs RJ11 or HDMI vs DisplayPort or SATA power vs SATA data,you make fewer mistakes and you solve problems faster.

The A plus exam loves identification questions and real work rewards the same skill because it prevents wasted time and wrong adapters.

RJ11 is the smaller modular connector used for telephone style connections.

It looks like RJ45 but narrower and it typically uses fewer conductors even though the plug may have multiple positions.

You see RJ11 on phones,older fax machines,some modems and certain DSL setups.

A quick recognition trick is width.

If it is visibly narrower than Ethernet,it is likely RJ11.

RJ45 is the standard Ethernet connector,wider than RJ11 and designed for eight conductors.

It is used on CAT5E,CAT6 and CAT6A twisted pair cable and connects PCs,switches,routers,patch panels,wall jacks and many ISP devices like cable modems and gateways.

In the field,RJ45 is one of the most common connectors you touch and problems like broken latch tabs and loose connections are common physical failure points.

F-type connectors are threaded quacks connectors used for cable TV,cable internet and many satellite connections.

The center conductor becomes the center pin and the threaded collar screws onto the port.

You find F-type connectors on cable modems,set-top boxes,splitters and wall quax jacks.

The screw-on design helps maintain signal integrity but loose connectors and excessive splitters are common sources of signal problems.Fiber connectors come in several common types.

LC is the small modern connector that often looks like a tiny network plug and commonly comes as a duplex pair for transmit and receive.

SC is larger and square using a push-pull latch and is common in many environments and older installs.

ST is older and uses a twist lock bayonet mechanism.

The exam idea is recognition and context.

Fiber connectors are for light based links often used for uplinks,backbones and long distance runs.

USB A is the classic rectangular connector found on computers and chargers and it inserts only one way.

USBB is the squarer connector found on printers and some larger peripherals.

Micro USB is the small connector that dominated older smartphones and accessories before USB-C.

USB C is the reversible oval connector that is now common across phones,tablets,laptops and docks.

The exam trap is that USB-C is a shape,not a guarantee of speed or capability.

HTMI is a common flat connector used widely in TVs,monitors,and projectors and carries audio and video together.

DisplayPort is common on PCs and monitors and often includes a latch on full size connectors.

DVI is a large multi-pin connector used mostly on older computer gear and typically carries video only.

VGA is the older blue analog connector with fifteen pins in three rows common in legacy projectors and older monitors.

Recognizing these quickly helps you choose correct adapters and avoid analog to digital conversion surprises.

SATA data connectors are small,narrow and seven pin and they connect drives to the motherboard for data.

SATA power connectors are wider,fifteen pin and come from the power supply.

Both use an L shaped key but they are different sizes and cannot substitute for each other.

For troubleshooting if a drive is not detected you check both the data path and the power path because either one can be the failure point.

DB nine is the serial connector used for RS two hundred thirty two style connections common for network equipment console access and legacy devices.

You may also see older power connectors like Molex in some desktops for legacy drives and accessories.

The exam angle is being able to identify these connectors in a mixed environment and knowing what they are typically used for.

Section fourteen has focused on cable and connector fundamentals and connector recognition is one of the fastest ways to improve troubleshooting speed.

RJ forty five is Ethernet,RJ eleven is phone style,F Type is coax,L C,S C and S T are fiber,USB has multiple shapes with USB C being the modern reversible connector.

Video connectors include HTMI and DisplayPort as modern standards and DVI and VGA as legacy.

SATA uses separate data and power connectors.

If you can recognize the connector,you can usually predict the signal type,choose the correct cable or adapter and troubleshoot more effectively.

132. RAM 外形规格

大家好，欢迎回到这个新章节，我们将深入探讨随机存取存储器，也就是RAM，这是计算机用于运行活动程序和处理数据的临时工作存储。

今天我们从RAM外形规格开始，也就是RAM模块的物理形状和尺寸。

了解双列直插式内存模块与小外形双列直插式内存模块之间的区别对于升级和故障排查至关重要，因为即使动态随机存取存储器代际正确，外形规格错误也无法物理安装。

外形规格指的是内存模块的物理尺寸、形状和设计，包括其长度、针脚数量以及缺口的位置。

由于空间和布局的限制，不同的设备需要不同的外形规格。

台式机机箱有空间容纳全尺寸模块，而笔记本电脑和迷你电脑则需要紧凑的模块。

外形规格还会影响安装方式，例如台式机中的垂直向下安装与笔记本电脑中的倾斜插入。

双列直插式内存模块是用于台式电脑、工作站和许多服务器的标准全尺寸内存模块。

双列直插式内存模块长度约为五点五英寸，每个模块提供六十四位数据路径。

术语“双列”指的是模块两侧的触点是电气隔离的，这与旧式的单列直插式内存设计不同。

较大的尺寸支持更高容量的模块，并使主板提供多个内存插槽成为可能。

双列直插式内存模块在触点边缘有一个缺口，用于防呆，确保只能朝一个方向安装。

针脚数量和缺口位置因动态随机存取存储器代际而异，这防止了混合安装不兼容的内存类型。

第三代双倍数据速率双列直插式内存模块拥有二百四十个针脚。

第四代双倍数据速率双列直插式内存模块拥有二百八十八个针脚。

第五代双倍数据速率双列直插式内存模块也拥有二百八十八个针脚，但缺口位置和电气特性不同，这防止了将第五代内存安装到第四代插槽中。

台式机主板通常有两个、四个或八个双列直插式内存插槽。

你对齐缺口，用均匀的力垂直向下按压模块，当完全就位时，固定夹会卡入到位。

安装不当是升级后启动失败的常见原因，因此你务必确认两端都已完全锁定。

另一个与考试相关的细节是插槽填充顺序，因为许多主板要求首先在特定插槽中安装，以正确启用双通道。

小外形双列直插式内存模块是为笔记本电脑和小型系统设计的紧凑外形规格。其长度约为全尺寸双列直插式内存模块的一半，大约在二点五到二点七英寸之间，具体取决于确切的代际和设计。

较小的尺寸使得内存能够装入轻薄笔记本电脑、一体机、迷你电脑和紧凑设备中。

性能通常与相同动态随机存取存储器代际和速度的双列直插式内存模块相当，但物理布局针对空间进行了优化。

因此，小外形双列直插式内存模块的针脚数量与台式机双列直插式内存模块不同。第三代双倍数据速率小外形双列直插式内存模块拥有二百零四个针脚。

第四代和第五代双倍数据速率小外形双列直插式内存模块通常拥有二百六十个针脚，其缺口位置可防止混合不同代际。

A Plus考试的关键要点是：即使标签上写着第四代双倍数据速率，你仍必须匹配动态随机存取存储器代际和正确的外形规格，因为第四代双倍数据速率双列直插式内存模块和第四代双倍数据速率小外形双列直插式内存模块不可互换。

因此，小外形双列直插式内存模块的安装方式与双列直插式内存模块不同。你将模块以大约三十度角插入插槽，将其完全滑入连接器，然后向下按压，直到侧面夹子将其锁定平贴在主板上。

拆卸过程则相反。

你拨开夹子，模块会以一定角度弹起，以便滑出。

许多故障排查案例源于模块在向下按压之前未完全插入，这可能导致连接不完全，从而引起无法启动或随机内存错误。

双列直插式内存模块用于台式个人电脑、全尺寸工作站和许多塔式服务器。

小外形双列直插式内存模块用于笔记本电脑、紧凑的迷你电脑和许多一体机系统。一些现代笔记本电脑使用板载焊接内存而不是可拆卸的小外形双列直插式内存模块，这意味着购买后无法升级内存。

对于考试和实际支持工作，首要步骤之一是确认系统是否实际上拥有可升级的内存插槽，或者内存是否已板载。

一般来说，当在使用具有可比内存控制器的系统中时，频率为三千二百兆赫的第四代双倍数据速率小外形双列直插式内存模块的表现与同规格的台式机模块相当。

主要差异往往在于极高速度的可用性、每个模块的最大容量以及平台支持，而非外形规格本身的原始性能。

对于典型的升级，你的选择基于什么能装得进去，而不是因为哪一种inherently更快。

台式机通常比笔记本电脑拥有更多的内存插槽，从而实现更高的总容量。

台式机可能有四个双列直插式内存插槽，而笔记本电脑通常有两个小外形双列直插式内存插槽，或者如果内存是焊接的，有时只有一个甚至没有。

在工作站和服务器级环境中，双列直插式内存模块通常也能达到每个模块更高的容量。

实际的要点是：台式机通常拥有更多的升级余地，而笔记本电脑的限制往往更严格。

RAM外形规格是模块的物理设计，决定了它适合哪些设备。

双列直插式内存模块是全尺寸的台式机模块，垂直向下安装并配有侧面夹子，而小外形双列直插式内存模块是紧凑的笔记本电脑模块，以一定角度安装并点击向下锁定。

针脚数量和缺口位置因动态随机存取存储器代际而异，防止了不兼容的安装。

当动态随机存取存储器代际和速度匹配时，性能通常相当，但基于台式机双列直插式内存的系统在容量和升级灵活性方面往往更高。

接下来，我们将进入动态随机存取存储器代际部分，这将决定兼容性、速度和电压。

Hello and welcome back in this new section where we are diving into RAM,random access memory,the temporary working storage your computer uses for active programs and data.

Today we are starting with RAM form factors,meaning the physical shapes and sizes of RAM modules.

Knowing the difference between DIMM and SODIM is essential for upgrades and troubleshooting because the wrong form factor will not physically fit even if it is the correct DDR generation.

Form factor refers to the physical size,shape and design of the memory module including how long it is,how many pins it has and where the notch is located.

Different devices require different form factors because of space and layout constraints.

A desktop case has room for full size modules while laptops and mini PCs need compact modules.

Form factor also impacts installation style such as straight down seating in desktops versus angled insertion in laptops.

DIM is the standard full size memory module used in desktop computers,workstations and many servers.

DIMMs are roughly 5.5 inches long and provide a 64-bit data path per module.

The term dual inline refers to the fact that the contacts on each side of the module are electrically separate,unlike older SIM designs.

The larger size supports higher capacity modules and makes it practical for motherboards to offer multiple memory slots.

DIMS have a notch in the contact edge that keys the module so it can only install in one direction.

The pin count and notch position vary by DDR generation which prevents mixing incompatible RAM types.

DDR3 DIMMs have 240 pins.

DDR4 DIMMs have 288 pins.

DDR5 DIMMs also have 288 pins but with a different notch position and different electrical characteristics which prevents installing DDR5 into DDR4 slots.

Desktop motherboards commonly have two,four or eight DIMM slots.

You align the notch,press the module straight down with even pressure and the retention clips snap into place when it is fully seated.

Improper seating is a common cause of boot failures after upgrades so you always confirm both ends are fully locked.

Another exam relevant detail is slot population order because many boards require installing in specific slots first to enable dual channel correctly.

SODIM is the compact form factor designed for laptops and small systems.It is roughly half the length of a full size DIMM,around 2.5 to 2.7 inches long,depending on the exact generation and design.

The smaller size allows memory to fit into thin laptops,all-in-once,mini PCs and compact devices.

Performance is generally equivalent to a DIMM of the same DDR generation and speed,but the physical layout is optimized for space.

So,DIMMs have different pin counts than desktop DIMMs.DDR3 SO DIMS have 204 pins.

DDR4 and DDR5 SODIMS commonly have 260 pins with notch locations that prevent mixing generations.

The key A plus takeaway is that even if the label says DDR4,you still must match both the DDR generation and the correct form factor because a DDR4 DIMM and a DDR4 SO DIM are not interchangeable.

So DIMMs install differently than DIMMs.You insert the module into the slot at about a 30 degree angle,slide it fully into the connector,then press it down until the side clips lock it flat against the board.

Removal is the reverse.

You spread the clips and the module pops up at an angle so it can slide out.

Many troubleshooting cases come from a module not being fully inserted before being pressed down,which can leave it partially connected and cause no boot or random memory errors.

DIMMs are used in desktop PCs,full-size workstations and many tower servers.

SO DIMMS are used in laptops,compact mini PCs and many all-in-one systems.Some modern laptops have soldered RAM instead of removable SO DIMMS,which means you cannot upgrade memory after purchase.

For the exam and real support,one of the first steps is confirming whether the system actually has upgradable memory slots or whether the RAM is on board.

In general,a DDR43200 SO DIM performs like a DDR43200 DIM when used in systems with comparable memory controllers.

The main differences tend to be availability at extreme speeds,maximum capacity per module,and platform support rather than raw performance of the form factor itself.

For typical upgrades,you choose based on what fits,not because one is inherently faster.

Desktops often have more memory slots than laptops,which allows higher total capacity.

A desktop might have four DIM slots,while a laptop commonly has two SO DIMM slots or sometimes only one or none if memory is soldered.

DIMMs also often reach higher capacities per module in workstation and server class environments.

The practical takeaway is that desktops usually have more upgrade headroom while laptops often have tighter limits.

RAM form factor is the physical design of the module and determines what devices it fits.

DIMMs are full-size desktop modules that install straight down with side clips,while SO DIMMS are compact laptop modules that install at an angle and click down.

Pin counts and notch positions vary by DDR generation,preventing incompatible installs.

Performance is generally equivalent when DDR generation and speed match,but capacity and upgrade flexibility tend to be higher in desktop DIMM based systems.

Next,we'll move into DDR generations which determine compatibility,speed and voltage.

大家好，既然我们已经了解了RAM外形规格，现在来谈谈双倍数据速率代际，也就是现代RAM技术的不同版本。

双倍数据速率简称DDR，你最常见的代际是第三代、第四代和第五代双倍数据速率内存。

每一代都在速度、效率和容量上有所提升，但最重要的考试概念是：这些代际不可互换。

双倍数据速率意味着内存在时钟信号的上升沿和下降沿每个时钟周期传输两次数据。

与单数据速率内存相比，这有效地使传输速率翻倍。

这就是为什么RAM的传输速率描述数值往往看起来比实际时钟速度更高。

例如，第三代双倍数据速率一千六百的运行时钟为八百兆赫，但数据传输速率为每秒一千六百万次传输。

第三代双倍数据速率广泛用于大约二千年代末到二千年代中期的系统中。

典型的第三代双倍数据速率电压为一点五伏，低压版本约为一点三五伏。

常见的速度等级范围从第三代双倍数据速率八百到第三代双倍数据速率二千一百三十三不等，具体取决于平台。

第三代双倍数据速率台式机双列直插式内存模块拥有二百四十个针脚，你仍会在旧款台式机、旧款笔记本电脑和遗留商业系统中遇到它。第三代双倍数据速率可以使用两种常见的命名方式进行标识。

第三代双倍数据速率减一千六百指的是以每秒百万次传输为单位的传输速率。

PC3减一万两千八百指的是以每秒兆字节为单位的理论峰值带宽。

这些通常用不同的术语描述同一个模块，这就是为什么标签会让人困惑。

对于A Plus考试，最安全的做法通常是关注双倍数据速率代际和“第三代双倍数据速率减数字”的标识，因为这是升级过程中最常讨论的标签。

第四代双倍数据速率在二千年代中期成为主流，并且至今仍然非常普遍。

第四代双倍数据速率将电压降低到约一点二伏，从而减少了发热量和功耗。

第四代双倍数据速率还支持更高的标准速度和更高密度的模块。

第四代双倍数据速率台式机双列直插式内存模块拥有二百八十八个针脚，且缺口位置与第三代不同，防止了意外插入第三代插槽。

常见的第四代双倍数据速率速度包括二千一百三十三、二千四百、二千六百六十六和三千二百，更高速度通常通过配置文件在发烧友系统中使用。

考试的要点是：更快的内存有助于提升性能，但实际运行速度取决于主板和中央处理器内存控制器的兼容性。

如果你安装的内存速度快于主板支持的速度，它通常会以系统支持的最高速度运行，而不是贴纸上标称的最大速度。

第五代双倍数据速率是用于现代平台的新一代内存。其起始基准速度较高，例如四千八百，并根据平台不同可达更高速度。

电压再次下降到约一点一伏以提高效率，并且第五代引入了架构变更以改善带宽和扩展性。

第五代双倍数据速率台式机双列直插式内存模块仍然拥有二百八十八个针脚，但缺口位置与第四代不同，因此你不能混合使用它们。

第五代双倍数据速率增加了模块上的电源管理和内部通道变更，从而改善了带宽行为和效率。

一个适合考试的理解方式是：第五代双倍数据速率提高了平台在更高速度下高效移动数据的能力，但也需要兼容的主板和中央处理器。

尽管乍一看它与第四代相似，但其信号和电气设计是不同的。

双倍数据速率各代之间不向后兼容。

第三代无法插入第四代插槽。

第四代无法插入第五代插槽。

缺口位置阻止了插入，且电气特性不兼容。

考试经常直接考查这一点，因为强行安装错误的内存是用户常见的错误。

正确的故障排查步骤始终是在购买或安装内存之前，验证主板支持的确切双倍数据速率代际。

要确定你需要什么内存，请使用主板文档、系统规格或报告内存类型的系统信息工具。

你也可以读取现有模块上的标签，其中通常包含双倍数据速率代际和速度。

针脚数量在识别旧的第三代时会有所帮助，因为二百四十个针脚是一个强烈的线索，但对于区分第四代和第五代，你更多要依赖平台规格和缺口位置。

最安全的方法是首先匹配系统支持的双倍数据速率代际，然后在该支持范围内选择容量和速度。

升级内存时，首要任务是正确的代际、正确的外形规格以及符合系统插槽数量和限制的correct容量。

如果系统无法运行，速度就是次要的。

对于故障排查，不匹配或不支持的内存可能导致无法启动、内存训练失败、随机崩溃或不稳定。

如果系统在内存升级后无法启动，首要检查项是安装就位情况、兼容性，以及一次只使用一个已知良好的模块进行测试。

双倍数据速率意味着双倍数据速率，即每个时钟周期传输两次数据。

第三代使用较低的速度和较高的电压，常见于旧系统。

第四代是长期运行的主流标准，拥有二百八十八针的双列直插式内存模块，而第五代是新一代高速内存，具有改进的效率和架构。

各代不可互换，缺口位置和电气不兼容性防止了混合使用。

购买内存前务必验证主板和中央处理器的支持情况。

接下来，我们将介绍纠错码内存与非纠错码内存，这影响专业环境和服务器环境中的可靠性。

英文原文

Hey everyone,now that we understand RAM form factors,let's talk about DDR generations,meaning the different versions of modern RAM technology.

DDR stands for double data rate and the most common generations you'll see are DDR3,DDR4 and DDR5.

Each generation improves speed,efficiency and capacity,but the most important exam concept is that generations are not interchangeable.

Double data rate means the memory transfers data twice per clock cycle on the rising edge and the falling edge of the clock signal.

This effectively doubles the transfer rate compared to single data rate memory.

That's why RAM is often described with transfer rates that look higher than the actual clock speed.

For example,DDR3 1600 runs at an 800 MHz clock but transfers data at 1600 megatransfers per second.

DDR3 was widely used in systems from roughly the late 2000s into the mid 20 teens.

Typical DDR3 voltage is 1.5 volts with low voltage variance around 1.35.

Common speed ratings range from DDR3 800 up through DDR3 2133 depending on the platform.

DDR3 desktop DIMS have 240 pins and you'll still encounter DDR3 in older desktops,older laptops and legacy business systems.DDR3 can be labeled using two common naming approaches.

DDR3-1600 refers to transfer rate in megatransfers per second.

PC3-12800 refers to theoretical peak bandwidth in megabytes per second.

These often describe the same module in different terms,which is why labeling can confuse people.

For A plus,it is usually safest to focus on DDR generation and the DDR3-number because that is the most commonly discussed label during upgrades.

DDR4 became mainstream in the mid-20 teens and is still extremely common today.

DDR4 lowered voltage to about 1.2 volts which reduces heat and power usage.

DDR4 also supports higher standard speeds and higher density modules.

DDR4 desktop DIMS have 288 pins and the notch location is different from DDR3 preventing accidental insertion into a DDR3 slot.

Common DDR4 speeds include DDR4 2133,DDR4 2400,DDR4 2666 and DDR4 3200 with higher speeds often used in enthusiast systems through profiles.

The exam takeaway is that faster memory can help performance,but compatibility with the motherboard and CPU memory controller determines what you actually run.

If you install faster RAM than a motherboard supports,it typically runs at the highest speed the system supports,not at the advertised maximum on the sticker.

DDR5 is the newer generation used in modern platforms.It starts at higher baseline speeds such as DDR54800 and goes higher depending on platform.

Voltage drops again to about 1.1 volts for improved efficiency and DDR5 introduces architectural changes to improve bandwidth and scaling.

DDR5 desktop DIMMs still have 288 pins but the notch position is different from DDR4 so you cannot mix them.

DDR5 adds on module power management and internal channel changes that improve bandwidth behavior and efficiency.

One exam-friendly way to think about it is that DDR5 increases the platform's ability to move data efficiently at higher speeds but it also requires a DDR5 compatible motherboard and CPU.

Even though it looks similar to DDR4 at a glance,the signaling and electrical design are different.

DDR generations are not backward compatible.

DDR3 does not fit in DDR4 slots.

DDR4 does not fit in DDR5 slots.

The notch position prevents insertion and the electrical characteristics are incompatible.

The exam often tests this directly because forcing the wrong RAM is a common user mistake.

The right troubleshooting step is always verifying the exact DDR generation supported by the motherboard before purchasing or installing RAM.

To identify what RAM you need,use the motherboard documentation,system specifications or system information tools that report memory type.

You can also read the label on an existing module which usually includes DDR generation and speed.

Pin count can help when you are identifying older DDR3 because 240 pins is a strong clue but for DDR4 versus DDR5 you rely more on platform specs and notch position.

The safest method is matching the system's supported DDR generation first,then choosing capacity and speed within that supported range.

When upgrading RAM the top priorities are correct generation,correct form factor and correct capacity for the system's slot count and limits.

Speed is secondary if the system will not run it.

For troubleshooting,mismatched or unsupported RAM can cause no boot,memory training failures,random crashes or instability.

If a system fails to boot after a RAM upgrade,the first checks are seating,compatibility,and using only one known good module at a time.

DDR means double data rate,transferring data twice per clock cycle.

DDR3 uses lower speeds and higher voltage and is common in older systems.

DDR4 is the long-running mainstream standard with 288 pin DIMMs and DDR5 is the newer high speed generation with improved efficiency and architecture.

The generations are not interchangeable and notch position plus electrical incompatibility prevents mixing.

Always verify motherboard and CPU support before buying RAM.

134. ECC 与非 ECC RAM 对比

大家好，现在我们来谈谈纠错码内存与非纠错码内存。

纠错码简称ECC，旨在自动检测并纠正某些内存错误。

大多数消费级计算机使用非纠错码内存，因为它更便宜且速度略快；而许多服务器和专业系统使用纠错码内存，因为数据完整性比微小的性能差异更重要。

当某个位意外翻转时会发生内存错误，这可能是由电气噪声、热量、硬件老化甚至宇宙辐射引起的。

大多数时候你根本注意不到，但当错误发生在关键位置时，可能导致数据损坏、应用程序崩溃或系统不稳定。

在拥有大量机器持续运行的大型环境中，错误发生的频率足以让你需要一种系统级的策略来检测和纠正它们，而不是指望它们永远不会发生。

非纠错码内存不提供错误检测或纠正功能。

如果发生位翻转，中央处理器可能会读取损坏的数据并将其当作正确数据使用。

在许多家庭场景中，影响可能微乎其微，比如偶尔的崩溃或小故障，这就是为什么非纠错码仍然是消费级台式机和笔记本电脑的标准。

缺点是非纠错码无法区分正确数据和损坏数据，因此在极少数情况下可能发生静默损坏。

纠错码内存在每个内存字中添加了额外的位，以便内存控制器能够检测并纠正某些错误。

一种常见的描述方式是：纠错码存储了额外的奇偶校验信息，因此它可以自动纠正单比特错误并检测许多多比特错误。

当系统检测并纠正错误时，它可以记录该事件，以便管理员监控双列直插式内存模块是否开始出现故障。

关键概念是：纠错码降低了静默数据损坏的可能性。

与非纠错码模块相比，纠错码模块通常多出一个额外的内存芯片，因为它们需要存储额外的纠正位。

一个常见的视觉模式是：非纠错码内存条可能有八个或十六个芯片，而纠错码根据模块布局可能显示为九个或十八个芯片。

然而，最可靠的方法是阅读模块标签和主板规格，因为芯片布局可能会有所不同。

对于A Plus考试，高收益规则是：平台必须明确支持纠错码。

纠错码通常会有轻微的性能开销，因为内存控制器正在生成和检查错误纠正数据。

一个常见的估算值是与同等非纠错码内存相比有百分之二到百分之三的影响。

对于大多数用户来说，这是察觉不到的。

在数据完整性至关重要的环境中，这点微小的代价是值得的。

在注重性能的消费级游戏设置中，用户通常更喜欢非纠错码，因为可靠性已经足够好，且成本很重要。

你不能仅仅在任何系统中安装纠错码内存就期望纠错功能生效。

你需要支持纠错码的内存、支持纠错码的主板以及支持纠错码的中央处理器内存控制器。

许多消费级平台不支持纠错码，而服务器和工作站平台通常支持。

对于故障排查和升级来说，这一点至关重要。

即使纠错码内存在物理上能插入，系统也可能将其视为非纠错码，或者根据兼容性情况无法启动。

纠错码常用于运行数据库、虚拟化主机、文件服务器的服务器，以及那些崩溃或损坏会造成严重后果的系统。它在科学计算、金融系统和重视正确性的专业工作负载中也很重要。

A Plus考试的推理是：选择纠错码是为了稳定性和数据完整性，而不是为了游戏性能。

非纠错码是家庭台式机、游戏系统和普通消费级笔记本电脑的典型配置。

大多数日常任务并不证明纠错码的额外成本和平台要求是合理的。

如果偶尔的错误导致很久才发生一次的崩溃，在消费级使用中，这种影响通常是可接受的。

考试技能是将正确的内存类型与场景相匹配，而不是假设纠错码总是更好。

纠错码内存通常比非纠错码更贵，这往往是由于额外的组件和较小的市场需求。

在典型的零售店中也更难找到它。

这进一步印证了这样一个观点：纠错码主要是一项专业功能，仅在可靠性和正常运行时间证明投资合理时使用。

在纠错码范围内，你可能会听到注册式纠错码（有时称为RDIMM）和无缓冲纠错码（有时称为UDIMM）。

注册式内存增加了缓冲，使系统能够支持更多模块和更高的总容量，这在服务器中很常见，但它可能会增加轻微的延迟惩罚。

无缓冲纠错码在工作站中更为常见。

关键的考点是：注册式和无缓冲式不可互换，必须符合主板要求。

纠错码内存检测并纠正单比特内存错误，有助于防止静默数据损坏，使其对服务器和任务关键型系统非常有价值。

非纠错码内存是消费级系统的标准，因为它更便宜且速度略快，而且对于典型用途来说风险是可接受的。

纠错码需要内存、主板和中央处理器的支持，你在升级前必须验证兼容性。

接下来，我们将以通道配置结束本节，因为你如何在各个通道上安装内存会显著影响带宽和实际性能。

Hey everyone,now let's talk about ECC versus non-ECC RAM.

ECC stands for error correcting code and it is designed to detect and correct certain memory errors automatically.

Most consumer computers use non-ECC RAM because it is cheaper and slightly faster,while many servers and professional systems use ECC because data integrity matters more than a tiny performance difference.

Memory errors happen when a bit flips unexpectedly,which can be caused by electrical noise,heat,aging hardware or even cosmic radiation.

Most of the time you never notice but when errors occur in the wrong place they can cause corrupted data,application crashes or system instability.

In a large environment with many machines running continuously,errors happen often enough that you need a system level strategy to detect and correct them instead of hoping they never occur.

Non-ECC RAM does not provide error detection or correction.

If a bit flip occurs,the CPU may read corrupted data and use it as if it were correct.

In many home scenarios,the impact can be minimal,like a rare crash or a small glitch,which is why non-ECC remains the standard for consumer desktops and laptops.

The downside is that non-ECC cannot distinguish between correct data and corrupted data,so silent corruption is possible in rare cases.

ECC RAM adds extra bits to each memory word so the memory controller can detect and correct certain errors.

A common way to describe it is that ECC stores additional parity information so it can correct single bit errors automatically and detect many multi-bit errors.

When the system detects and corrects an error,it can log the event so administrators can monitor whether a DIM is starting to fail.

The key idea is that ECC reduces the chance of silent data corruption.

ECC modules often have an extra memory chip compared to non-ECC modules because they store the extra correction bits.

A common visual pattern is that non-ECC sticks may have 8 or 16 chips while ECC may appear as 9 or 18 chips depending on module layout.

However,the most reliable method is reading the module label and the motherboard specs because chip layout can vary.

For A plus,the high yield rule is that ECC must be explicitly supported by the platform.

ECC typically has a small performance overhead because the memory controller is generating and checking error correction data.

A common ballpark is a 2-3%impact compared to equivalent non-ECC RAM.

For most users,that is not noticeable.

In environments where data integrity matters,that small cost is worth it.

In performance focussed consumer gaming setups,users often prefer non-ECC because reliability is good enough and cost matters.

You cannot just install ECC RAM in any system and expect ECC features to work.

You need ECC capable RAM,a motherboard that supports ECC and a CPU memory controller that supports ECC.

Many consumer platforms do not support ECC while server and workstation platforms often do.

For troubleshooting and upgrades,this is critical.

Even if ECC physically fits,the system may treat it as non-ECC or may not boot depending on compatibility.

ECC is commonly used in servers running databases,virtualization hosts,file servers,and systems where a crash or corruption has serious cost.It also matters in scientific computing,financial systems and professional workloads where correctness matters.

The A plus reasoning is that ECC is chosen for stability and data integrity,not for gaming performance.

Non-ECC is typical for home desktops,gaming systems and general consumer laptops.

Most everyday tasks do not justify the extra cost and platform requirements of ECC.

If an occasional error causes a crash once in a long while,the impact is usually acceptable in consumer use.

The exam skill is matching the right memory type to the scenario rather than assuming ECC is always better.

ECC RAM usually costs more than non-ECC,often due to additional components and smaller market demand.

It can also be harder to find in typical retail stores.

This reinforces the idea that ECC is primarily a professional feature used when reliability and uptime justify the investment.

Within ECC,you may hear about registered ECC,sometimes called RDIM,and unbuffered ECC,sometimes called UDIM.

Registered memory adds buffering that allows systems to support more modules and higher total capacity,common in servers,but it can add a small latency penalty.

Unbuffered ECC is more common in workstations.

The key testable point is that registered and unbuffered are not interchangeable and must match the motherboard requirements.

ECC RAM detects and corrects single-bit memory errors and helps prevent silent data corruption,making it valuable for servers and mission critical systems.

Non-ECC RAM is standard in consumer systems because it is cheaper and slightly faster and the risk is acceptable for typical use.

ECC requires support from the RAM,motherboard and CPU and you must verify compatibility before upgrading.

Next,we'll wrap the section with channel configurations,because how you install RAM across channels can significantly impact bandwidth and real-world performance.

135. RAM 通道配置

欢迎回来。

我们来谈谈内存通道。

通道是中央处理器内存控制器与随机存取存储器之间的路径。

更多的通道意味着更高的带宽，这可以显著提升内存密集型任务的性能，尤其是在使用集成显卡的系统中。

了解单通道、双通道与四通道的区别，有助于你将内存安装在正确的插槽中，从而获得你付费应有的性能。

内存通道是内存控制器与内存模块之间独立的数据路径。

一个简单的理解方式是将其想象成高速公路上的车道。

一个通道就是一条车道。

两个通道是两条并行运行的车道，允许更多数据同时传输。

每个通道通常宽六十四位，使用多个通道可增加可用带宽，从而减少中央处理器等待内存的次数。

单通道模式通常发生在只安装了一根内存条时，或者内存条的安装方式未能启用多通道模式时。

单通道提供基本带宽，对于许多办公任务来说运行良好，但对于数据传输量大的工作负载，它可能成为瓶颈。

带有集成显卡的系统对此尤为敏感，因为图形处理器共享系统内存，所以内存带宽直接影响图形性能。

在集成显卡上，单通道会显著降低游戏性能，有时降幅很大，因为图形处理器缺乏带宽。

它还会拖慢视频编辑、大文件压缩和重度多任务处理等任务。

重要的概念是，在正确的插槽中添加第二根匹配的内存条，往往能带来比人们预期更大的实际性能提升，即使中央处理器和存储设备保持不变。

双通道并行使用两个通道，是大多数拥有两个或更多内存插槽的消费级台式机和笔记本电脑的标准配置。

要启用双通道，你需要将一对匹配的内存条安装在正确的配对插槽中，这些插槽通常在主板上通过颜色编码标示。

许多主板要求你先填充特定插槽，例如在四插槽主板上填充插槽二和插槽四。

当配置正确时，双通道的内存带宽实际上是单通道的两倍。

双通道可以显著提升对带宽敏感的任务的性能，对于集成显卡游戏而言，这往往是一个巨大的改进。

即使在正常的台式机使用中，双通道也能让系统在负载下感觉更流畅，因为中央处理器等待内存的时间减少了。

最佳做法是使用两根完全相同的内存条，即容量和速度相同，因为不匹配的内存条会降低实现最佳通道行为的可能性。

四通道见于高端台式机平台和许多服务器平台，它并行使用四个通道。

这提供了极高的内存带宽，有助于重度渲染、大规模视频处理、虚拟化和科学计算等工作负载。

四通道需要支持它的中央处理器和主板，并且通常需要在正确的通道组中安装四根内存条。

对于A Plus考试，关键是要认识到主流消费级中央处理器通常最多支持双通道，而四通道是工作站和服务器的功能。

现代系统可能支持弹性模式，其中部分内存以双通道运行，其余不匹配的容量以单通道运行。

例如，如果你将一根十六吉字节的内存条与一根八吉字节的内存条配对，每根的前八吉字节可以以双通道运行，而额外的八吉字节则以单通道运行。

这虽然可行，但并非理想方案。

适合考试的建议是尽可能使用匹配的配对，以获得最佳性能并简化故障排查。

要确认通道模式，你可以检查基本输入输出系统，或使用报告系统正在运行单通道、双通道还是四通道的系统信息工具。

当用户升级了内存却未看到性能提升时，这是一个很好的故障排查步骤，因为他们可能将内存条安装在了错误的插槽中。

重新安装到正确的配对插槽可以立即启用双通道并提高带宽。

内存通道决定了中央处理器访问随机存取存储器的带宽大小。

单通道可以工作，但可能会限制性能，尤其是对于集成显卡。

双通道是大多数消费级系统的标准，当你在正确的配对插槽中安装匹配的内存条时，带宽大约可以翻倍。

四通道用于高端工作站和服务器，以实现最大带宽。

使用匹配的配对并正确放置插槽，是最简单的升级之一，却能产生显著的性能收益。

英文原文

Welcome back.

Let's talk about memory channels.

Channels are the pathways between the CPU memory controller and the RAM.

More channels mean more bandwidth,which can noticeably improve performance in memory heavy tasks and especially in systems that use integrated graphics.

Understanding single channel versus dual channel versus quad channel helps you install RAM in the right slots so you get the performance you paid for.

A memory channel is an independent data path between the memory controller and the memory modules.

A simple way to picture it is lanes on a highway.

One channel is one lane.

Two channels are two lanes running in parallel,allowing more data to move at the same time.

Each channel is typically 64 bits wide and using multiple channels increases available bandwidth which reduces how often the CPU has to wait on memory.

Single channel operation usually happens when only one RAM module is installed or when modules are installed in a way that does not enable multi-channel mode.

Single channel provides basic bandwidth and works fine for many office tasks but it can be a bottleneck for workloads that move a lot of data.

Systems with integrated graphics are especially sensitive because the GPU shares system RAM so memory bandwidth directly affects graphics performance.

Single channel can reduce game performance significantly on integrated graphics,sometimes by large percentages,because the GPU is starved for bandwidth.

It can also slow down tasks like video editing,large file compression and heavy multitasking.

The important idea is that adding a second matching module in the correct slot often gives a bigger real world improvement than people expect,even when the CPU and storage stay the same.

Dual channel uses two channels in parallel and is the standard configuration for most consumer desktops and laptops that have two or more RAM slots.

To enable dual channel,you install a matched pair of RAM modules in the correct paired slots,often indicated by color coding on the motherboard.

Many boards want you to populate specific slots first,like slot 2 and slot 4 on a 4 slot board.

When configured correctly,dual channel can effectively double memory bandwidth compared to single channel.

Dual channel can significantly improve performance in bandwidth sensitive tasks and is often a major improvement for integrated graphics gaming.

Even in normal desktop use,dual channel can help the system feel smoother under load because the CPU spends less time waiting for memory.

The best practice is using two identical modules,same capacity and speed,because mismatched modules can reduce the chance of optimal channel behavior.

QuadChannel is found on high end desktop platforms and many server platforms,and it uses four channels in parallel.

This provides very high memory bandwidth and helps workloads like heavy rendering,large scale video processing,virtualization and scientific computing.

Quad channel requires a CPU and motherboard that support it and it typically requires installing four modules in the correct channel grouping.

For A Plus,the key is recognizing that mainstream consumer CPUs usually max out at dual channel while quad channel is a workstation and server feature.

Modern systems may support flex mode where part of the memory runs in dual channel and the remaining unmatched capacity runs in single channel.

For example,if you pair a 16 gig module with an 8 gig module,the first 8 gig from each can run in dual channel while the extra 8 gig runs in single channel.

This works but it's not ideal.

The exam friendly recommendation is to use matching pairs whenever possible for the best performance and the simplest troubleshooting.

To confirm channel mode you can check BIOS or use system information tools that report whether the system is running single,dual or quad channel.

This is a great troubleshooting step when a user upgraded RAM but did not see performance improvement because they may have installed modules in the wrong slots.

Reseating into the correct paired slots can instantly enable dual channel and improve bandwidth.

Memory channels determine how much bandwidth the CPU has to access RAM.

Single channel works but can limit performance,especially for integrated graphics.

Dual channel is the standard for most consumer systems and can roughly double bandwidth when you install matched modules in the correct paired slots.

Quad channel is used in high end workstations and servers for maximum bandwidth.

Using matched pairs and correct slot placement is one of the simplest upgrades that can produce a noticeable performance benefit.

136. 硬盘驱动器（HDD）

大家好，欢迎进入这个新章节，我们将深入探讨存储设备，即那些永久保存你的操作系统、程序和数据的存储介质。

今天我们从机械硬盘开始，这是一种已经存在数十年的传统机械存储技术。

尽管速度不如固态硬盘，但机械硬盘凭借其每吉字节的低成本，在大容量存储方面仍然至关重要。

让我们来探索它们的工作原理以及驱动它们运行的机制。

机械硬盘将数据以磁性方式存储在涂有磁性材料的旋转盘片上。

在密封的驱动器外壳内部，有一个或多个圆形铝制或玻璃盘片堆叠在主轴上。

读写头悬浮在盘片表面上方仅几纳米的微米级气垫上，这比人类头发的宽度还要窄。

当盘片以每分钟数千转的速度旋转时，读写头内外移动以访问不同区域，通过检测和改变磁场来读写数据。

读写头利用电磁原理工作。

写入数据时，磁头产生一个磁场，将盘片上的微小区域磁化为一个方向代表二进制一，或相反方向代表二进制零。

读取数据时，磁头检测这些区域经过其下方时的磁化方向。

磁头安装在致动臂上，这些臂在盘片表面快速摆动以访问不同的磁道。

这种机械运动是机械硬盘比固态存储慢得多的原因。

主轴速度衡量盘片旋转的快慢，以每分钟转数表示。

笔记本电脑驱动器和预算型台式机驱动器最常见的速度是每分钟五千四百转。

在此速度下，数据以中等速率经过磁头，为基本计算任务提供不错的性能。

每分钟五千四百转驱动器的优势在于功耗更低、发热更少且运行更安静。

这些驱动器非常适合文件存储、媒体库和备份用途。

每分钟七千二百转是台式机硬盘的标准速度，代表了性能与成本之间的良好平衡。

更快的旋转意味着数据更快地经过磁头，从而减少访问时间并提高传输速率。

每分钟七千二百转的驱动器明显快于每分钟五千四百转的驱动器，在实际使用中通常快百分之二十到百分之三十。

代价是功耗略高、发热更多以及噪音稍大。

多年来，每分钟七千二百转一直是台式机主存储的标准。

高性能机械硬盘的转速为每分钟一万转甚至每分钟一万五千转。

这些企业级驱动器提供了可能的最快机械硬盘性能，相比每分钟七千二百转的驱动器，具有显著更低的延迟和更高的吞吐量。

然而，它们价格昂贵、消耗大量电力、产生大量热量且非常嘈杂。

在固态硬盘接管之前，每分钟一万转和一万五千转的驱动器在服务器中很常见。

如今，随着固态硬盘以具有竞争力的价格提供更好的性能，它们正变得罕见。

主轴速度并不是唯一的性能因素。

缓存大小也很重要。

内置内存缓冲区通常为六十四到二百五十六兆字节，临时存储数据以实现更快的访问。

盘片密度影响性能。

每个盘片上打包更多数据的驱动器可以在每转中读取更多数据。

接口速度也很重要。

串行高级技术附件三支持每秒六吉比特，盘片数量影响容量，有时也影响性能。

设计良好的每分钟七千二百转驱动器可以胜过设计不佳的每分钟一万转驱动器。

机械硬盘以低成本提供巨大容量，这是它们最大的优势。

消费级台式机驱动器通常达到一到八太字节，而面向高级用户的驱动器可达十六和十八太字节。

企业级驱动器容量更大，可达二十太字节及以上。

机械硬盘的每吉字节成本远低于固态硬盘，机械硬盘通常为每吉字节三到五美分，而固态硬盘为十到十五美分。

对于存储大型视频库、备份或归档数据等速度并非关键的应用，机械硬盘提供了无与伦比的价值。

机械硬盘拥有活动部件，使其容易受到物理冲击和磨损。

在驱动器旋转时掉落笔记本电脑或碰撞台式机可能导致磁头碰撞，即磁头接触盘片从而破坏数据。

随着时间的推移，机械部件会磨损，轴承会退化，电机会故障，磁头也可能失灵。

机械硬盘的典型寿命在正常使用下为三到五年，尽管许多驱动器使用寿命更长。

定期备份至关重要，因为所有驱动器最终都会故障。

机械硬盘在几种场景下仍然合理。

对于媒体文件、文档和归档的大容量存储，其中访问速度并非关键，机械硬盘提供了每美元最高的存储量。

对于不常访问的备份驱动器，机械硬盘非常经济。

作为主固态硬盘的辅助存储，使用固态硬盘存放操作系统和程序，使用机械硬盘存放文件，你可以在需要的地方获得速度，在需要的地方获得容量。

成本至关重要的预算系统通常exclusively使用机械硬盘。

机械硬盘存在显著的局限性，导致其逐渐衰落。

它们速度慢，机械寻道时间以毫秒计，而固态硬盘以微秒计。

它们脆弱，活动部件容易受到冲击和振动的影响。

它们有噪音，你可以听到它们旋转和寻道的声音。

它们比固态硬盘消耗更多电力并产生更多热量。

随着固态硬盘价格持续下降，机械硬盘的适用场景正缩小到大容量存储和归档应用，其中每太字节成本是首要考虑因素。

以上就是机械硬盘技术。

请记住，机械硬盘将数据以磁性方式存储在旋转盘片上，读写头悬浮在盘片表面之上。

常见的主轴速度为：笔记本电脑和预算型驱动器为每分钟五千四百转，标准台式机驱动器为每分钟七千二百转，高性能企业级驱动器为每分钟一万转。

更高的速度意味着更好的性能，但也意味着更多的电力和热量。

机械硬盘以低成本提供巨大容量，这是它们的主要优势，但它们速度慢、脆弱，并且拥有最终会故障的活动部件。

机械硬盘在大容量存储和备份方面仍然有价值，但固态硬盘正在接管主存储的角色。

接下来，我们将查看机械硬盘的外形规格及其不同的用例。

届时见。

英文原文

Hi there,welcome to this new section where we are diving into storage devices,the permanent storage that holds your operating system,programs and data.

Today we are starting with HTDs,hard disk drives,the traditional mechanical storage technology that's been around for decades.

Despite being slower than SSDs,HTDs remain important for bulk storage due to their low cost per gigabyte.

Let's explore how they work and what makes them tick.

Hard disk drives store data magnetically on spinning platters coated with magnetic material.

Inside the sealed drive enclosure are one or more circular aluminum or glass platters stacked on a spindle.

Read and write heads float on a microscopic cushion of air just nanometers above the platter surfaces,closer than the width of a human hair.

As the platters spin at thousands of revolutions per minute,the heads move in and out to access different areas,reading and writing data by detecting and changing magnetic fields.

The read and write heads use electromagnetic principles.

To write data,the head creates a magnetic field that magnetizes tiny regions of the platter in one direction for a binary 1 or the opposite direction for a binary 0.

To read data,the head detects the magnetic orientation of these regions as they pass beneath it.

The heads are mounted on actuator arms that swing rapidly across the platter surfaces to access different tracks.

This mechanical movement is why HTDs are much slower than solid state storage.

Spindle speed measures how fast the platters rotate expressed in revolutions per minute RPM.

The most common speed for laptop drives and budget desktop drives is 5400 RPM.

At this speed,data passes under the heads at a moderate rate,providing decent performance for basic computing tasks.

The advantage of 5400 RPM drives is lower power consumption,less heat generation,and quieter operation.

These drives are fine for file storage,media libraries,and backup purposes.

7200 RPM is the standard speed for desktop hard drives and represents a good balance between performance and cost.

The faster rotation means data passes under the heads more quickly,reducing access times and improving transfer rates.

A 7200 RPM drive is noticeably faster than a 5400 RPM drive,typically 20 to 30%faster in real-world use.

The trade-off is slightly higher power consumption,more heat and a bit more noise.

For primary storage in desktops,7200 RPM has been the standard for years.

High performance H T D s spin at ten thousand rpm or even fifteen thousand rpm.

These enterprise drives offer the fastest mechanical hard drive performance possible with significantly lower latency and higher throughput than 7200 RPM drives.

However,they are expensive,consume substantial power,generate considerable heat and are quite loud.

10K and 15K RPM drives were common in servers before SSDs took over.

Today,they are becoming rare as SSDs offer even better performance at competitive prices.

Spindle speed isn't the only performance factor.

Cache size matters.

The built-in memory buffer,typically 64 to 256 megabytes,temporarily stores data for faster access.

Platter density affects performance.

Drives with more data packed on each platter can read more data per revolution.

Interface speed matters.

SATA 3 supports 6 gigabits per second and the number of platters impacts capacity and sometimes performance.

A well-designed 7200 RPM drive can outperform a poorly designed 10000 RPM drive.

HTDs offer enormous capacity at low cost.This is their biggest advantage.

Consumer desktop drives commonly reach 1 to 8 terabytes with 16 and 18 terabyte drives available for power users.

Enterprise drives go even larger,20 terabytes and beyond.

The cost per gigabyte for HTDs is much lower than SSDs,often 3 to 5 cents per gigabyte for HTDs versus 10 to 15 cents for SSDs.

For storing large video libraries,backups or archived data where speed isn't critical,HTDs provide unbeatable value.

HTDs have moving parts,making them vulnerable to physical shock and wear.

Dropping a laptop or bumping a desktop while the drive is spinning can cause head crashes where the head contacts the platter destroying data.

Over time,mechanical components wear out,bearings degrade,motors fail and heads can malfunction.

Typical HTD lifespan is 3 to 5 years of normal use,though many drives last longer.

Regular backups are essential because all drives eventually fail.

HTDs still make sense in several scenarios.

For bulk storage of media files,documents and archives,where access speed isn't critical,HTDs offer the most storage per dollar.

For backup drives that aren't accessed constantly,HTDs are economical.

For secondary storage alongside a primary SSD,using the SSD for the operating system and programs and the HTD for file storage,you get speed where it matters and capacity where you need it.

Budget systems where cost is paramount often use H T D s exclusively.

H T D s have significant limitations driving their decline.

They are slow,mechanical seek times are measured in milliseconds versus microseconds for SSDs.

They are fragile,moving parts are vulnerable to shock and vibration.

They are noisy,you can hear them spinning and seeking.

They consume more power and generate more heat than SSDs.

As SSD prices continue falling,the use cases for HTDs are narrowing to bulk storage and archival applications where cost per terabyte is the primary concern.

That's hard disk drive technology.

Remember,HTDs store data magnetically on spinning platters with read and write heads that float above the surface.

Common spindle speeds are 5400 RPM for laptops and budget drives,7200 RPM for standard desktop drives and 10000 RPM for high performance enterprise drives.

Higher speed means better performance but more power and heat.

HTDs offer enormous capacity at low cost,their primary advantage,but they are slow,fragile and have moving parts that eventually fail.

HTDs remain valuable for bulk storage and backups but SSDs are taking over primary storage roles.

Next,we'll look at HTD form factors and their different use cases.

See you there.

137. HDD 外形规格

大家好，既然我们已经了解了硬盘的工作原理，现在来谈谈它们的物理尺寸，也就是外形规格。

硬盘主要有两种尺寸：二点五英寸和三点五英寸。

这些尺寸指的是内部盘片的近似直径。

外形规格决定了硬盘可以安装在哪里，以及它是为哪种系统设计的。

了解这些差异有助于你根据需求选择合适的硬盘。

三点五英寸硬盘是全尺寸台式机标准。

这些硬盘的尺寸约为宽四英寸、深五点八英寸、高一英寸。

三点五英寸指的是内部盘片的直径。

较大的尺寸允许使用更大的盘片，这意味着更高的容量。

三点五英寸硬盘的容量通常从一太字节到十八太字节或更高。

它们设计用于安装在台式机机箱和外置硬盘盒中标准的三点五英寸驱动器托架内。

三点五英寸硬盘较大的尺寸提供了几个优势。

它们提供目前可用的最高容量。

如果你需要在单个硬盘中获得八、十二或十八太字节的容量，你需要选择三点五英寸硬盘。

与同等容量的二点五英寸硬盘相比，它们的每吉字节成本通常更低。

它们可以以更高的速度旋转。

每分钟一万转和一万五千转的硬盘只有三点五英寸格式。

而且它们有更多空间容纳高级功能，如更多盘片、更大缓存和更好的散热。

三点五英寸硬盘比二点五英寸硬盘需要更多的电力。

它们使用标准的串行高级技术附件电源连接器，提供五伏和十二伏电压。

它们需要十二伏线路来为较大的主轴电机供电。

三点五英寸硬盘在运行期间通常消耗六到十瓦特，高性能型号消耗的甚至更多。

这在拥有充足电源的台式机中不是问题，但这也是为什么三点五英寸硬盘不用于笔记本电脑的原因。

因为它们会过快耗尽电池电量。

二点五英寸硬盘是较小的外形规格，最初是为笔记本电脑设计的。

它们的尺寸约为宽二点七五英寸、深三点九英寸，厚度各异，通常为七毫米或九点五毫米高。

内部较小的盘片意味着与三点五英寸硬盘相比，最大容量较低，机械硬盘通常最高可达五太字节。

这些硬盘专为空间受限且注重能效的环境而设计。

二点五英寸硬盘有其自身的优势。

它们物理上更小更轻，非常适合便携式设备。

它们在运行期间消耗的电力更少，通常为一瓦五到三瓦，这对笔记本电脑的电池寿命至关重要。

它们产生的热量比三点五英寸硬盘少。

它们更耐冲击和振动，因为较小、较轻的组件不易受到物理损坏。

而且它们更安静，因为较小的电机和盘片产生的噪音更小。

二点五英寸硬盘可以完全由五伏线路供电。

它们不需要十二伏电压。

这就是为什么外置二点五英寸硬盘可以仅靠通用串行总线总线电源运行，而无需单独的电源适配器。

当安装在笔记本电脑内部时，它们像三点五英寸硬盘一样通过串行高级技术附件电源连接，但它们只从五伏线路取电。

这种较低的功耗要求对于笔记本电脑和便携式设备至关重要，因为能效直接影响电池寿命。

三点五英寸硬盘非常适合台式计算机、连接墙式电源放置在桌面上的外置备份驱动器、家庭和企业的网络附加存储设备、容量至关重要的服务器和数据中心，以及存储连续视频流的监控系统。

任何你需要最大容量、不关心便携性且电力供应充足的场景，都是三点五英寸硬盘的擅长领域。

二点五英寸硬盘非常适合笔记本电脑和笔记本计算机、依靠通用串行总线电源运行的便携式外置驱动器、PlayStation和Xbox等游戏机、紧凑型小外形规格个人电脑，以及任何重视空间和能效的地方。

即使在台式机中，有些人也使用二点五英寸硬盘，因为现代机箱通常配有二点五英寸安装支架，而且较小的硬盘更易于操作。

固态硬盘几乎exclusively使用二点五英寸外形规格，因此安装基础设施非常普遍。

你可以使用适配器支架将二点五英寸硬盘安装在三点五英寸托架中。

这些简单的金属或塑料支架可以将二点五英寸硬盘转换以适应三点五英寸的安装位置。

这在用固态硬盘升级旧台式机或想在台式机中使用笔记本电脑硬盘时很常见。

适配器的价格仅为几美元，并能将较小的硬盘牢固地固定在较大的托架中。

然而，你无法将三点五英寸硬盘安装在二点五英寸的空间中。

它根本放不进去。

仅基于外形规格是否存在性能差异？

通常没有。假设技术相似，每分钟七千二百转的二点五英寸硬盘的性能与每分钟七千二百转的三点五英寸硬盘相似。

不过，三点五英寸硬盘可以实现稍高的性能，因为较大的盘片在外缘具有更高的线速度，并且有更多空间用于高级电子设备和更大的缓存。

出于实际目的，主轴速度和内部设计比外形规格对性能的影响更大。

以上就是机械硬盘的外形规格。

请记住，三点五英寸硬盘是台式机标准，具有高达十八太字节及以上的highest容量，消耗更多电力并需要五伏和十二伏电源。

二点五英寸硬盘是笔记本电脑标准，更紧凑且更节能，仅靠五伏运行，机械硬盘的容量上限约为五太字节。

对于桌面系统、网络附加存储和最大容量存储，请使用三点五英寸硬盘。

对于笔记本电脑、便携式驱动器和空间受限的系统，请使用二点五英寸硬盘。适配器支架允许将二点五英寸硬盘安装在三点五英寸托架中。

接下来，我们将探讨固态硬盘及其相对于机械硬盘的革命性优势。

The form factor determines where a drive can be installed and what kind of system it's designed for.

Understanding these differences helps you choose the right drive for your needs.

The bigger size of 3.5 inch drives provides several advantages.

If you need 812 or 18 terabytes in a single drive,you are looking at 3.5 inch.

They typically cost less per gigabyte than 2.5 inch drives of equivalent capacity.

They can spin at higher speeds.

10000 and 15000 RPM drives only came in 3.5 inch format.

And they have more room for advanced features like more platters,larger caches and better cooling.

2.5 inch drives have their own advantages.

They are physically smaller and lighter,making them perfect for portable devices.

they consume less power,typically one point five to three watts,during operation,which is crucial for laptop battery life.

2.5 inch drives can be powered entirely by the 5 volt line.

They don't need 12 volts.

This is why external 2.5 inch drives can run off USB bus power alone without requiring a separate power adapter.

When installed internally in laptops,they connect via SATA power just like 3.5-inch drives,but they only draw from the 5-volt line.

This lower power requirement is essential for laptops and portable devices where energy efficiency directly impacts battery life.

3.5-inch drives are ideal for desktop computers,external backup drives that sit on a desk connected to wall power,network attached storage,NAS,devices for home and business,servers and data centers where capacity is paramount,and surveillance systems storing continuous video feeds.

Any scenario where you need maximum capacity,you're not concerned about portability and power is readily available,that's where 3.5-inch drives excel.

2.5-inch drives are perfect for laptops and notebooks,portable external drives that run on USB power,game consoles like PlayStation and Xbox,compact small form factor PCs,and anywhere space and power efficiency matter.

Even in desktops,some people use 2.5-inch drives because modern cases often have 2.5-inch mounting brackets and the smaller drives are easier to work with.

However,you cannot mount a 3.5-inch drive in a 2.5-inch space.

It simply won't fit.

However,three point five inch drives can achieve slightly higher performance because the larger platters have higher linear velocity at the outer edges,and there's more space for advanced electronics and larger caches.

For practical purposes,spindle speed and internal design matter more than form factor for performance.

That's HTD form factors.

Remember,3.5 inch drives are the desktop standard with the highest capacities up to 18TB and beyond,consuming more power and requiring both 5V and 12V power.

2.5 inch drives are the laptop standard,more compact and power efficient,running on 5V alone,topping out around 5TB for HTDs.
