172. ADF 与平板扫描仪

大家好，让我们通过讨论多功能设备中两种主要的扫描机制来结束本节：自动进稿器和平板扫描仪。

把它想象成洗碗。

有时你需要手洗一件精致的物品，有时你可以把整批餐具放入洗碗机。

平板扫描是细致且精确的方法，而自动进稿器扫描则是放入一叠纸然后让它自动运行的方法。

如果你的设备两者兼备，你就能两全其美。

所以让我们来分解一下何时使用每一种。

平板扫描仪是经典配置。

一块带有盖板的玻璃板。

你将文档正面朝下放在玻璃上，盖上盖子然后扫描。

内部，一个灯管和传感器在玻璃下方移动，逐行捕获文档。

平板扫描仪简单、可靠，往往能产生非常清晰的扫描件，因为纸张在玻璃上保持静止和平整，这有助于提高清晰度和对齐度。

当你需要控制或处理特殊文档时，平板扫描仪表现出色。

它们非常适合脆弱或珍贵的纸张、老照片、收据、名片以及任何形状奇特或精致的物品。

对于书籍和杂志等无法通过进稿器的装订材料，它们也是最佳选择。

如果你想要最高质量，且不想冒扫描仪抓取并弯曲页面的风险，平板扫描仪是你的安全之选。

平板扫描仪的缺点是速度。

如果你有一份五十页的文档，在平板扫描仪上扫描意味着扫描、抬起盖子、换页、再次扫描，重复五十次，很快就会让人厌倦。

双面扫描也很慢，因为你必须手动翻转每一页，而且你受限于玻璃的尺寸，通常是信纸或法律用纸大小。

平板扫描仪非常适合特殊文档，但对于高容量扫描来说效率不高。

ADF代表自动进稿器，它是一种托盘机制，可自动将一叠页面送入扫描仪。

这是办公室生产力功能，因为它将扫描变成了批量作业。

你放入纸堆，按下扫描，它就会一页接一页地进纸，无需你在一旁照看。

对于合同、报告、表单和任何多页文档，与平板扫描相比，自动进稿器节省了大量时间。

自动进稿器有单面和双面之分。

单面扫描每张纸的一面，因此如果文档是双面的，你必须翻转纸堆并再次扫描。

双面自动进稿器，有时称为DADF，可自动扫描两面，要么在一次通过中扫描两面，要么根据设计在内部翻转页面。

双面功能对办公室来说意义重大，因为它加快了扫描速度并减少了人工翻页的错误。

在选购或规划工作流程时，自动进稿器的规格很重要。

容量是指进稿器可以容纳多少页。

入门级设备通常可容纳二十到三十五页，办公型号通常可容纳五十到一百页，而高容量扫描仪可容纳二百页以上。

速度通常以每分钟页数列出，基本机型的常见范围是每分钟十五到三十页，中端机型为每分钟三十到五十页，高端扫描仪则为每分钟八十到一百二十页或更多。

双面扫描可以用每分钟图像数来衡量，因为每张纸可以生成两个图像。

自动进稿器对进纸内容很挑剔。

纸张重量很重要。

许多自动进稿器能很好地处理十六到二十八磅的纸张，但太薄的纸张可能会起皱，太厚的纸张可能无法进纸。

纸张状况也很重要。

起皱的页面、撕裂的边缘、订书钉、回形针和便利贴基本上就是自动进稿器卡纸的诱因。

特殊尺寸也可能导致进纸错误。

如果文档脆弱、珍贵、形状奇特或太厚，平板扫描仪是更安全的选择。

为了保持自动进稿器扫描顺畅，每次都要养成几个习惯。

移除订书钉和回形针，清除任何便利贴。

扇开纸堆，使页面干净分离。

将页面对齐导纸板，不要超过标称容量过度填充。

尽量不要在一叠纸中混合不同的纸张尺寸或重量。

此外，保持自动进稿器滚轮和扫描玻璃清洁，因为灰尘和残留物会导致进纸错误和条纹。

一点准备工作就能预防大多数自动进稿器问题。这是一个简单的决策规则。

当你有多页文档、标准纸张且想要速度时，请使用自动进稿器，特别是如果你有双面扫描功能。

当你有单页重要文档、脆弱文档、书籍等装订材料、收据等特殊尺寸或任何可能卡住或被进稿器损坏的物品时，请使用平板扫描仪。

如果你的设备两者兼备，你基本上就拥有了适合每种扫描任务的正确工具。

许多多功能打印机结合了这两种扫描类型。

自动进稿器像盖子一样安装在顶部，平板玻璃位于下方。

这种设计提供了灵活性：自动进稿器用于日常批量扫描，平板扫描仪用于特殊文档。

对于扫描需求混合的办公室，两者兼备是最理想的，因为你不会陷入试图强行通过一种方法处理所有事情的困境。

大多数扫描仪问题是由文档准备不足或组件脏污引起的。

对于自动进稿器卡纸，请移除所有纸张，检查是否有撕碎的碎片并清洁滚轮。

如果扫描出现条纹，请清洁平板玻璃和自动进稿器扫描条，因为指纹和灰尘会显示为线条。

如果一次进纸多页，请扇开纸堆并检查滚轮是否磨损。

如果扫描质量看起来很低，请提高DPI并确保文档平整且对齐。

许多神秘的扫描仪问题可以通过清洁和正确装纸来解决。

这就是自动进稿器和平板扫描仪。

平板扫描仪精确且温和，最适合脆弱文档、书籍和特殊形状，但对于多页工作来说速度较慢。

自动进稿器是速度工具，非常适合成堆的标准文档，而双面自动进稿器让双面扫描变得毫不费力。

如果你经常扫描，容量和速度很重要，而文档准备可以预防大多数自动进稿器卡纸。如果你的设备两者兼备，你每次都可以选择最佳方法。

至此，你已经完成了关于多功能设备和打印机的第十九节。

干得漂亮。

英文原文

Hey everyone,let's wrap up this section by talking about the two main scanning mechanisms you'll find in multifunction devices,ADF and flatbed scanners.

Think of it like washing dishes.

Sometimes you hand wash one delicate item and sometimes you load a whole dishwasher.

Flatbed scanning is the careful and precise method and ADF scanning is the load a stack and let it run method.

If your device has both,you get the best of both worlds.

So let's break down when to use each one.

Flatbed scanners are the classic setup.

A glass plate with a lid.

You place your document face down on the glass,close the lid and scan.

Inside,a light bar and sensor move beneath the glass and capture the document line by line.

Flatbeds are simple,reliable and tend to produce very clean scans because the paper stays still and flat against the glass which helps with sharpness and alignment.

Flatbeds shine when you need control or when documents are unusual.

They're great for fragile or valuable papers,old photos,receipts,business cards and anything that's oddly shaped or delicate.

They're also the best option for bound materials like books and magazines that can't go through a feeder.

If you want maximum quality and you don't want the risk of the scanner grabbing and bending the page,the flatbed is your safe choice.

The downside of a flatbed is speed.

If you have a 50 page document,scanning it on a flatbed means scan,lift lid,swap page,scan again and repeat 50 times,which gets old fast.

Double-sided scanning is also slow because you have to flip each page manually and you are limited by the size of the glass which is often letter or legal.

Flatbeds are excellent for special documents but they are not efficient for high volume scanning.

ADF stands for automatic document feeder and it's the tray mechanism that feeds a stack of pages through the scanner automatically.

This is the office productivity feature because it turns scanning into a batch job.

You load the stack,press scan and it feeds page after page without you babysitting it.

For contracts,reports,forms and anything multi-page,ADF saves enormous time compared to flatbed scanning.

ADFs come in simplex and duplex.

Simplex scans one side of each sheet so if the document is double-sided you'd have to flip the stack and scan again.

Duplex ADF sometimes called DADF scans both sites automatically either by scanning both sides in one pass or by flipping pages internally depending on the design.

Duplex is a big deal for offices because it speeds up scanning and reduces human error with page flipping.

ADF specs matter when you're shopping or planning workflows.

Capacity is how many pages the feeder can hold.

Budget devices might hold around twenty to thirty five pages,office models often hold fifty to one hundred pages,and high volume scanners can hold two hundred plus pages.

Speed is often listed in pages per minute and common ranges are 15 to 30 pages per minute for basic units,30 to 50 for mid-range and 80 to 120 pages per minute or more for high end scanners.

Duplex scanning can be measured in images per minute because each sheet can produce two images.

ADFs are picky about what they'll feed.

Paper weight matters.

Many ADFs handle about 16 to 28 pound paper well,but very thin paper can wrinkle and very thick paper may not feed.

Condition matters too.

Wrinkled pages,tone edges,staples,paper clips and sticky notes are basically ADF jam fuel.

Odd sizes can also misfeed.

If the document is fragile,valuable,oddly shaped or thick,the flatbed is the safer option.

To keep ADF scanning smooth,do a few habits every time.

Remove staples and paper clips and clear any sticky notes.

Fan the paper stack so pages separate cleanly.

Align the pages against the guides and don't overfill past the stated capacity.

Try not to mix different paper sizes or weights in one stack.

Also,keep the ADF rollers and scanning glass clean because dust and residue cause misfeeds and streaks.

A little prep prevents most ADF problems.Here's the simple decision rule.

Use the ADF when you have multi-page documents,standard paper and you want speed,especially if you have duplex scanning.

Use the flatbed when you have single important pages,fragile documents,bound materials like books,odd sizes like receipts or anything that might jam or be damaged by a feeder.

If your device has both,you basically have the right tool for every scanning job.

Many multifunction printers combine both scanner types.

The ADF is mounted on top like a lid and the flatbed glass is underneath.

That design gives you flexibility,ADF for everyday bad scanning and flatbed for special documents.

For offices with mixed scanning needs,having both is ideal because you don't get stuck trying to force everything through one method.

Most scanner issues are caused by document prep or dirty components.

For ADF jams,remove all paper,check for tone scraps and clean rollers.

If scans have streaks,clean the flatbed glass and the ADF scanning strip because fingerprints and dust show up as lines.

If multiple pages feed at once,fan the stack and check whether rollers are worn.

If scans look low quality,increase DPI and make sure the document is flat and aligned.

Many mystery scanner problems are solved with cleaning and proper loading.

That's ADF and Flatbed Scanners.

Flatbeds are precise and gentle,best for fragile documents,books and odd shapes,but slow for multi-page work.

ADF is the speed tool,great for stacks of standard documents,and duplex ADF makes double-sided scanning effortless.

Capacity and speed matter if you scan often,and document preparation prevents most ADF jams.If your device has both,you can choose the best method every time.

And with that,you have completed section 19 on multifunction devices and printers.

Awesome work.

173. 激光打印机维护

大家好，欢迎回到打印机维护这一新章节。

今天我们从激光打印机维护开始，这基本上就是如何让这些办公室主力军平稳运行，而不是在最糟糕的时候变成卡纸机器。

我们将涵盖碳粉更换、维护套件、校准和清洁程序，这些能帮你避免昂贵的维修、愤怒的用户和令人沮丧的停机时间。

把这想象成是给激光打印机做换油和轮胎换位。

激光打印机是为大容量而建的，但它们并非魔法。

碳粉灰尘会在内部积聚，滚轮会磨损，基于加热的部件也会随着时间推移而老化。

如果你忽视维护，你开始看到的将是卡纸、条纹、污迹、打印褪色，最终是一台完全拒绝合作的打印机。

进行基本保养的回报是巨大的。

定期维护可以将打印机寿命从三到五年延长至七到十年，并有助于保持一致的打印质量，这在文件需要看起来干净整洁的专业环境中尤为重要。

碳粉盒是你在激光打印机上需要更换的首要消耗品。

大多数打印机在碳粉不足时会发出警告，通常是在剩余百分之十到百分之二十时。

这是一条黄金法则。

不要等到完全用尽。

一旦你开始看到持续的褪色或收到低碳粉警告，你就应该计划更换。

这里有一个专业技巧。

在更换之前，轻轻左右摇晃碳粉盒以重新分布碳粉。

这通常能挤出更多几页纸，为你争取时间，特别是当你试图在更换耗材前完成工作时。

更换碳粉通常很简单，但你需要尊重热量。

关闭打印机电源并让其冷却五到十分钟，因为定影器可能极热，温度约为二百摄氏度，即大约三百九十华氏度。

然后打开前面板，按下释放卡扣，直接拔出旧碳粉盒。

拆开新碳粉盒包装，轻轻摇晃五六次以分布碳粉。

移除任何保护胶带或密封条，将其滑入到位直到听到咔哒声。

关闭面板并打印测试页，这样你就知道可以正常工作了。

现在你会遇到经典争论：原厂versus兼容或再制造碳粉。

原厂碳粉盒（原始设备制造商）通常价格高出两到三倍，但它们通常提供最一致的打印质量，且兼容性意外最少。

兼容碳粉盒可以为你节省百分之三十到百分之五十，但它们有时会导致问题，在某些情况下还可能影响保修支持。

一个好的规则是：对于关键业务打印，坚持使用原厂产品。

对于高容量或注重预算的环境，像LD Products和Easy Inc这样信誉良好的第三方品牌也可以正常工作。

只需检查评论和保修条款。维护套件基本上是激光打印机的主要服务间隔。

它们捆绑了随时间磨损的部件。

比如定影器组件、转印辊、拾取辊和分离垫。

定影器是将碳粉粘合到纸张上的加热辊，而滚轮和垫子则确保纸张顺畅进给而不一次抓取多张。

大多数打印机每打印十万到二十万页就需要一个维护套件，具体取决于型号，忽视该时间表是导致持续卡纸的最快方式之一。

许多打印机在达到制造商设定的页数阈值时，会直接通过“维护套件”或“计划维护”等消息发出警告。

例如，某些惠普打印机在二十二万五千页时发出警报。

即使没有消息，打印机也会通过症状告诉你：频繁卡纸、清洁后不消失的污迹或条纹、进纸问题，或指向定影器或滚轮寿命的错误代码。

关键的心态是这样的。

磨损的部件不仅会降低质量。

它们还会开始损坏纸张并导致反复故障。

安装维护套件比更换碳粉更复杂，通常需要三十到六十分钟。

你需要该型号的正确套件、一把十字螺丝刀以及打印机的维修说明书。

关闭打印机电源，拔掉插头，并让其完全冷却。

然后你按照说明书指定的顺序拆下面板，更换定影器组件、转印辊、拾取辊和分离垫。

最后，你重新组装所有部件并重置维护计数器，以便打印机知道已安装了新部件。

校准是打印机随时间保持彩色输出和碳粉密度准确的方法。

许多现代激光打印机自动校准，但你通常可以通过控制面板手动触发它，例如设置、维护、校准，或通过打印机软件。

你应该在安装新碳粉后、安装维护套件后，或任何时候注意到颜色偏移或密度问题时运行校准。该过程通常需要两到五分钟，打印机会打印测试图案并自动调整内部设置。

外部清洁很容易但很重要。

它能防止灰尘进入内部，并保持打印机外观专业。

每周用微湿的无绒布擦拭外部，避免使用可能损坏塑料的强力清洁剂。

在纸盘和走纸路径周围使用压缩空气去除灰尘，并用超细纤维布擦拭控制面板，屏幕上不要使用液体。

每月清理通风口和风扇进气口，以便打印机能够呼吸，避免热量积聚导致随时间出现奇怪故障。

内部清洁是防止碳粉灰尘灾难的地方，但你必须安全操作。

每月或在每打印两千到五千页后，打开打印机并使用专用碳粉吸尘器或无绒布清除可触及区域的碳粉灰尘。

不要使用普通吸尘器，因为碳粉颗粒可能对吸尘器有害，在最坏的情况下甚至可能引发火灾风险。

用压缩空气和无绒布蘸异丙醇清洁走纸路径。

如果打印机有内置清洁模式，请运行它。

这些循环可以移动部件并帮助自动清除碎屑。

定影器和滚轮是许多打印质量和进纸问题的源头。

对于定影器，你可以使用定影器清洁纸（一种专为吸附残留物设计的特殊纸张），或者运行几张空白页以帮助清除轻微积聚。

对于转印辊和拾取辊，使用蘸水的无绒布。

此处避免使用酒精，因为它会使橡胶变干。

在旋转滚轮的同时轻轻擦拭，然后在关闭打印机并重新通电之前让所有部件完全干燥。

干得好！

你现在知道了预防大多数激光打印机故障的关键维护程序。

安全更换碳粉、了解何时需要维护套件、运行校准以确保持续输出，以及内外清洁以防止灰尘、卡纸和条纹。

当你始终如一地执行这些步骤时，你就能预防绝大部分常见问题，并让打印机运行多年。

接下来，我们将转向喷墨打印机维护，那里打印头和干涸的墨水带来了完全不同的挑战。

届时见！

英文原文

Hello and welcome back to this new section on printer maintenance.

Today we are kicking things off with laser printer maintenance which is basically how you keep these office workhorses running smoothly instead of turning into jam machines at the worst possible time.

We are going to cover toner replacement,maintenance kits,calibration and cleaning routines that can save you from costly repairs,angry users and frustrating downtime.

Think of this as oil changes and tire rotations but for your laser printer.

Laser printers are built for volume but they are not magic.

Toner dust builds up inside,rollers wear down and heat based parts get tired over time.

If you ignore maintenance you'll start seeing paper jams,streaks,smudges,faded prints and eventually a printer that simply refuses to cooperate.

The payoff for doing basic care is huge.

Regular maintenance can extend printer life from 3 to 5 years to 7 to 10 years and it helps you maintain consistent print quality,especially important in professional environments where documents need to look clean and readable.

Toner cartridges are the number one consumable you'll replace on laser printers.

Most printers will warn you when toner is low,typically when you're around 10 to 20 percent remaining.

Here's the golden rule.

Don't wait until it is completely empty.

Once you start seeing consistent fading or you get that low toner warning,you should plan the replacement.

And here's a pro trick.

Before swapping it,gently shake the cartridge side to side to redistribute toner.

That can often squeeze out a few more pages and buy you time,especially when you're trying to finish a job before replacing supplies.

Replacing toner is usually simple,but you need to respect the heat.

Power off the printer and let it cool for 5-10 minutes because the fuser can be extremely hot,around 200 degrees Celsius,which is about 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

Then open the front panel,press the release tab and pull the old cartridge straight out.

Unpack the new cartridge,gently rock it 5-6 times to distribute toner.

Remove any protective tape or seals and slide it into place until it clicks.

Close the panel and print a test page so you know you're back in business.

Now you'll hit the classic debate,OEM vs.compatible or remanufactured toner.

OEM cartridges,original equipment manufacturer,often cost 2-3 times more,but they usually deliver the most consistent print quality and the fewest compatibility surprises.

Compatible cartridges can save you 30 to 50%,but they can sometimes cause issues and in some cases they may affect warranty support.

A good rule is for critical business printing stick with OEM.

For high-volume or budget-conscious environments,reputable third-party brands like LD Products and Easy Inc.can work fine.

Just check reviews and warranty terms.Maintenance kits are basically the major service interval for a laser printer.

They bundle the parts that wear out over time.

Things like the fuser assembly,transfer roller,pickup rollers and separation pads.

The fuser is the heated roller that bonds toner to paper and the rollers and pads are what keep paper feeding smoothly without grabbing multiple sheets.

Most printers need a maintenance kit every 100000 to 200000 pages depending on the model and ignoring that schedule is one of the fastest ways to end up with constant jams.

Many printers will warn you directly with messages like maintenance kit or schedule maintenance when you hit the manufacturer's page count threshold.

For example,some HP printers alert at 225000 pages.

Even without a message,the printer will tell you with symptoms,frequent jams,smudges or streaks that don't go away with cleaning,paper feed issues or error codes pointing to fuser or roller life.

The key mindset is this.

Worn parts don't just reduce quality.

They can start damaging paper and cause repeated failures.

Installing a maintenance kit is more involved than toner replacement and it typically takes 30 to 60 minutes.

You'll need the correct kit for the model,a Philips screwdriver and the printer's service instructions.

Power off the printer,unplug it and let it cool completely.

Then you remove panels,swap the fuser assembly,transfer roller,pickup rollers and separation pads in the order the instructions specify.

Finally,you reassemble everything and reset the maintenance counter so the printer knows it has fresh parts installed.

Calibration is how the printer keeps color output and toner density accurate over time.

Many modern laser printers auto-calibrate but you can usually trigger it manually through the control panel,something like settings,maintenance,calibrate or through printer software.

You should run calibration after installing new toner,after installing a maintenance kit or anytime you notice color shifts or density problems.The process typically takes 2 to 5 minutes and the printer prints test patterns and adjusts internal settings automatically.

External cleaning is easy but important.

It prevents dust from getting inside and keeps the printer looking professional.

Weekly,wipe the exterior with a slightly damp lint-free cloth and avoid harsh cleaners that can damage plastic.

Use compressed air around trays and paper paths to remove dust and wipe the control panel with a microfiber cloth,no liquids on screens.

Monthly vacuum vents and fan intakes so the printer can breathe and avoid heat buildup that causes weird failures over time.

Internal cleaning is where you prevent the toner dust apocalypse,but you must do it safely.

Monthly or after every 2000 to 5000 pages,open the printer and remove toner dust from accessible areas using a toner-rated vacuum or lint-free cloths.

Do not use a regular vacuum because toner particles can be hazardous to the vacuum and,in worst cases,can be a fire risk.

Clean the paper path with compressed air and lint-free cloths dampened with isopropyl alcohol.

If the printer has a built-in cleaning mode,run it.

Those cycles can move components and help clear debris automatically.

The fuser and rollers are where a lot of print quality and feed problems start.

For the fuser,you can use a fuser cleaning sheet,special paper designed to pick up residue,or you can run several blank pages to help clear light buildup.

For transfer and pickup rollers,use a lint-free cloth dampened with water.

Avoid alcohol here because it can dry out rubber.

Gently wipe along the roller while rotating it,then let everything dry completely before closing the printer and powering it back on.

Great work!

You now know the key maintenance routines that prevent the majority of laser printer failures.

Replacing toner safely,understanding when a maintenance kit is needed,running calibration for consistent output and cleaning inside and out to prevent dust,jams,and streaks.

When you do these steps consistently,you prevent a huge percentage of common problems and keep your printer running for years.

Next up,we'll switch gears to inkjet printer maintenance,where printheads and dried ink bring a whole different set of challenges.

See you there!

174. 喷墨打印机维护

大家好，欢迎回到第二十节：打印机维护。

现在我们从激光打印机切换到喷墨打印机，喷墨打印机的特性完全不同。

它们非常适合家庭和小型办公室使用，能够打印出精美的照片，但也需要更多动手护理，特别是在墨水、打印头和进纸方面。

今天我们将涵盖墨盒更换、打印头清洁与更换、滚轮和进纸器维护，以及如何清除卡纸而不将小问题变成打印机损坏的大麻烦。

喷墨打印机很精密，因为它们依赖微小的喷嘴喷射微细墨滴。

当墨水干涸或堵塞这些喷嘴时，打印质量会迅速下降。出现线条、颜色消失、文本看起来褪色。

与可以闲置数周的激光打印机不同，喷墨打印机最怕被忽视。

打印头内的干墨水是头号故障模式，因此定期维护和定期使用，例如每周至少打印一次，可以将打印机寿命从两到三年延长到五年以上。

当你看到打印褪色、缺少颜色、出现条纹，或者打印机发出低墨水警告时，请更换墨盒。

许多打印机在墨水剩余百分之十到百分之二十时会发出警告，你应该认真对待这些警告，尤其是黑色墨水，因为无法阅读的文本会很快成为问题。

与碳粉不同，你不能通过摇晃墨盒来延长其寿命。

此外，有些打印机在墨水不足时会完全锁定打印功能，因为干跑会损坏打印头。

更换墨水通常很简单，但关键细节是这样的。

先打开打印机电源。许多喷墨打印机只有在通电时才会将carriage安全定位，强行移动可能会造成损坏。

打开墨盒访问门，等待carriage移动到更换位置，通常是中间位置。

松开旧墨盒，将其取出，避免触摸铜触点或喷嘴。

拆开新墨盒包装，移除保护胶带，以轻微角度插入直到听到咔哒声，然后关闭门。

之后，运行对齐打印，以便打印机重新校准以获得清晰的输出。

现在我们遇到经典的喷墨问题：原装墨水还是第三方墨水。

原装墨水更贵，通常贵三到五倍，例如原装墨盒每盒二十五到四十美元，而第三方墨盒每盒八到十五美元。

原装墨水提供最一致的颜色，通常能避免保修纠纷，而像Easy Ink和LD Products这样信誉良好的第三方品牌可以为日常文档节省百分之六十到百分之七十的费用。

实用的规则是：对于照片打印，坚持使用原装墨水。

对于基本文档，信誉良好的第三方墨水通常没问题。

避免超便宜的无名墨盒，因为堵塞和色彩不良很常见。

打印头是喷墨打印机的心脏，也是最常见的故障源。

它包含数百个直径约为零点零一毫米的微小喷嘴，用于喷射墨滴。

如果这些喷嘴因干墨水、灰尘或气泡而堵塞，你会看到条纹、缺色、缺线，甚至空白页。

打印头清洁循环通过强制墨水通过喷嘴来清除堵塞，学习如何正确运行它们是喷墨维护中最有价值的技能之一。

大多数喷墨打印机在打印机菜单或计算机软件中都有内置的清洁实用程序。

从标准清洁循环开始。

这通常需要两到三分钟，并使用少量墨水。

然后打印喷嘴检查或测试页。

如果问题仍然存在，运行深度清洁循环，这可能需要五到十分钟，并使用更多墨水。

对于顽固堵塞，你可以重复最多三次，但在深度清洁之间等待六到十二小时是明智的，这样墨水可以浸泡干涸的堵塞物，而不是连续浪费墨水。

如果自动清洁失败，手动清洁是更换前的最后手段。

有些打印机的打印头集成在墨盒中，而另一些则有独立的打印头组件，因此你必须先查阅手册。如果可拆卸，将喷嘴板浸泡在蒸馏水或专用清洁溶液中三到六小时。

轻轻吸干，不要用无绒布擦拭喷嘴表面，你可以使用球囊注射器小心地将清洁溶液冲洗过打印头。

然后让其干燥二十四小时，重新安装并再次运行清洁循环。

打印头并非永久耐用。

根据使用情况，预期寿命约为两到五年。

当清洁循环在三到四次尝试后仍无法恢复质量、缺色或缺线持续存在、收到打印头故障错误或有可见损坏时，请更换打印头。

替换打印头的成本通常在三十到一百五十美元之间，具体取决于打印机型号。

对于较旧或非常便宜的打印机，更换可能不符合成本效益，购买新打印机可能是更明智的选择。

喷墨打印机的进纸问题通常是滚轮问题。滚轮负责拾取纸张、输送纸张和分离纸张，但纸尘和墨水残留物会覆盖滚轮，导致进纸错误、打印歪斜和卡纸。

良好的清洁间隔是每五百到一千页，或每当出现进纸问题时。

使用蘸有蒸馏水的无绒布，自来水会留下矿物质残留物，并在旋转时擦拭滚轮。

对于顽固残留物，你可以少量使用异丙醇，但不要浸泡橡胶部件。

卡纸很烦人，但大多数是可以预防的。

使用优质纸张，因为廉价纸张会脱落纤维，在进纸机构中积聚。

将纸张平放在阴凉干燥处保存，因为湿度会使纸张翘曲并粘连在一起。

不要过度填充纸盒。

许多纸盒最多容纳一百到二百五十张纸，并在装纸前先扇开纸堆。

当发生卡纸时，在开始拉纸之前先关闭打印机电源，以免在运动过程中损坏传感器或齿轮。

要安全清除卡纸，请关闭电源，打开所有可访问的门，并沿正常纸路方向（通常朝向输出托盘）拉出卡住的纸张。

不要向后猛拉，因为这会损坏滚轮并撕裂纸张。

如果纸张撕裂，请移除所有碎片。

如有必要，请使用镊子，因为微小碎片会导致重复卡纸。关闭门，打开电源并打印测试页。

如果卡纸继续发生，请清洁滚轮并检查是否有磨损部件或翘曲的纸张。

太棒了，你现在知道了如何正确更换墨盒、清洁和更换打印头、维护滚轮以及清除卡纸而不造成连带损坏。

如果你保持喷墨打印机活跃、清洁且进纸正常，它们可以可靠地使用多年，而不是成为那个总是毁掉你一天的打印机。

接下来，我们将转向热敏打印机维护，主要关注进纸组件、特殊纸张以及保持加热元件清洁。

届时见。

英文原文

Hey everyone,welcome back to section 20,Printer Maintenance.

Now we are switching from laser printers to inkjet printers and inkjets are a totally different personality.

They are awesome for home and small office use and they can produce beautiful photo prints,but they also need more hands-on care,especially around ink,print heads and paper feeding.

Today we'll cover ink cartridge replacement,print head cleaning and replacement,roller and feeder maintenance and how to clear paper jams without turning a small problem into a broken printer.

Inkjet printers are delicate because they rely on tiny nozzles that spray microscopic ink droplets.

When ink dries out or clogs those nozzles,print quality goes downhill fast.Lines appear,colors vanish and text looks washed out.

Unlike laser printers that can sit unused for weeks,inkjets hate being ignored.

Dried ink in printheads is the number one failure mode,so regular maintenance and regular use like printing at least once a week can extend printer life from two to three years to five plus years.

Replace ink cartridges when you see fading,missing colors,streaks or when the printer throws low ink warnings.

Many printers warn you when ink is around 10 to 20%remaining and you should take those warnings seriously,especially for black ink because unreadable text becomes a problem quickly.

Unlike toner,you can't shake ink cartridges to get extra life.

Also,some printers will lock out printing entirely when ink is low because running dry can damage the printhead.

Ink replacement is usually simple but the key detail is this.

Power the printer on first.Many inkjet printers position the carriage safely only when powered on and forcing it can cause damage.

Open the cartridge access door and wait for the carriage to move into the replacement position,usually the center.

Release the old cartridge,remove it and avoid touching the copper contacts or the nozzles.

Unpack the new cartridge,remove the protective tape,insert it at a slight angle until it clicks and then close the door.

Afterward,run an alignment print so the printer can recalibrate for clean output.

Now we hit the classic inkjet question,original ink or third party.

OEM ink is more expensive,often 3 to 5 times more and an example range is$25 to$40 per cartridge for OEM versus$8 to$15 for third party.

OEM gives the most consistent color and usually avoids warranty disputes,while reputable third party brands like Easy Ink and LD Products can save 60 to 70%for everyday documents.

The practical rule is,for photo printing,stick with OEM.

For basic documents,reputable third party ink is usually fine.

Avoid ultra cheap no name cartridges because clogs and bad colour are common.

The printhead is the heart of an inkjet printer and it's also the most common source of trouble.

It contains hundreds of microscopic nozzles around 0.01 millimeters in diameter that spray ink droplets.

If those nozzles clog from dried ink,dust or air bubbles,you get streaks,missing colors,missing lines or even blank pages.

Printhead cleaning cycles work by forcing ink through the nozzles to clear blockages and learning how to run them correctly is one of the most valuable inkjet maintenance skills.

Most inkjets have built-in cleaning utilities in the printer menu or the computer software.

Start with the standard cleaning cycle.

This usually takes 2-3 minutes and uses a small amount of ink.

Then print a nozzle check or test page.

If the issue continues,run a deep cleaning cycle which can take 5-10 minutes and uses more ink.

For stubborn clogs,you can repeat up to 3 times,but it's smart to wait 6-12 hours between deep cleanings so ink can soak into dried blockages rather than just wasting ink back to back.

If automated cleaning fails,manual cleaning is the last resort before replacement.

Some printers have printheads built into the cartridges while others have a separate printhead assembly,so you must check your manual first.If removable,soak the nozzle plate in distilled water or a specialized cleaning solution for 3-6 hours.

Gently blot,do not wipe the nozzle surface with a lint-free cloth and you can use a bulb syringe to carefully flush cleaning solution through the printhead.

Then let it dry for 24 hours,reinstall it and run a cleaning cycle again.

Printheads don't last forever.

Depending on use,you can expect around 2-5 years of life.

Replace the printhead when cleaning cycles don't restore quality after 3-4 attempts,when missing colors or lines are persistent,when you get printhead failure errors or if there is visible damage.

Replacement printheads typically cost$30 to$150 depending on the printer model.

For older or very cheap printers,replacement may not be cost effective and buying a new printer can be the smarter move.

Paper feeding issues in inkjets are often roller problems.Rollers pick up paper,feed it through and separate sheets,but paper dust and ink residue can coat the rollers causing misfeeds,skewed prints and jams.

A good cleaning interval is every 500 to 1000 pages or whenever feeding issues appear.

Use a lint-free cloth dampened with distilled water,tap water can leave mineral residue,and wipe the rollers while rotating them.

For stubborn residue you can use isopropyl alcohol sparingly,but don't soak rubber parts.

Paper jams are annoying,but most are preventable.

Use decent paper because cheap paper sheds fibers that build up in the feed mechanism.

Store paper flat in a cool dry place because humidity makes sheets warp and stick together.

Don't overfill trays.

Many trays max out around 100 to 250 sheets and fan the stack before loading.

When a jam happens,power off the printer before you start pulling paper so you don't damage sensors or gears mid-motion.

To clear a jam safely,power off,open all accessible doors and pull the jammed paper in the direction of the normal paper path,usually toward the output tray.

Don't yank backward because that can damage rollers and rip paper.

If paper tears,remove every fragment.

Use tweezers if needed because tiny scraps cause repeat jams.Close the doors,power on and print a test page.

If jams continue,clean the rollers and inspect for worn parts or warped paper.

Awesome,you now know how to replace ink cartridges correctly,clean and replace printheads,maintain rollers and clear jams without causing collateral damage.

If you keep inkjets active,clean and properly fed,they can be reliable for years instead of becoming the printer that always ruins your day.

Next,we'll move to thermal printer maintenance where the big concerns are feed assemblies,special paper and keeping the heating element clean.

See you there.

175. 热敏打印机维护

大家好，现在我们来谈谈热敏打印机的维护。

这些是你在现实世界中随处可见的打印机。

商店的收据、运输标签、条形码标签和票据。

热敏打印机很棒，因为它们不需要墨水也不需要碳粉，但它们仍然需要维护，只是维护方式不同而已。

重点在于进纸组件、热敏纸或色带、加热元件，以及防止碎屑进入打印机，从而确保你的标签和收据清晰可读。

热敏打印的核心在于热量。

直热式打印机直接将热量施加于热敏纸上，使受热部分变黑。

典型的收据和许多运输标签都属于此类。

热转印打印机利用热量将色带上的蜡或树脂熔化到标签上，从而生成更耐用的打印效果，非常适合条形码和长期保存的标签。

这两种类型都依赖于一个加热元件，通常称为打印头，它拥有数百个微小的加热点。

这就是为什么打印头的保养是热敏维护的重中之重。

进纸组件负责在打印机中移动纸张。

它通常包括胶辊、驱动齿轮和传感器。

胶辊是一个橡胶辊，它将纸张均匀地压在加热元件上，这种均匀的压力确保了标签或收据整个宽度的打印质量一致。

随着时间的推移，灰尘、标签粘合剂残留物和碎屑会在胶辊和传感器上积聚，导致进纸不均匀、打印出现空白或卡纸。一个良好的惯例是每一到两周清洁一次胶辊，或在高用量环境中每卷纸使用后清洁一次。

关闭电源并拔掉打印机插头，使用释放闩打开打印头组件，用蘸有百分之七十到百分之九十异丙醇的无绒布擦拭胶辊，同时用手旋转它。

如果标签留下粘性残留物，请彻底清除。

粘合剂积聚是导致进纸问题的主要原因。

用压缩空气吹出齿轮和狭窄空间中的杂物，并在关闭打印机前让所有部件干燥。

热敏打印机对纸张很挑剔，尤其是直热式打印机。

直热纸具有一层热敏涂层，通常描述为基于苯酚或隐色染料，会对热量产生反应。

纸张质量很重要。

廉价的直热纸可能在三到六个月内褪色，而优质纸张可以保存两到三年。

存储也很重要。

将纸卷存放在阴凉干燥的地方，远离阳光和热源。

如果热敏纸过热，整卷纸甚至在打印前就会变黑或变色，这基本上就像毁掉了整个墨盒，只不过这次是纸张。

热敏纸装填是一个小细节，但如果操作错误会导致大问题。

直热纸有一面是涂层面，必须朝向加热元件。

一个简单的测试方法是用指甲刮擦纸张。

如果留下深色痕迹，那就是涂层面。

大多数打印机从下方进纸，因此装卷时应使涂层面朝上指向打印头，对齐纸卷，并调整导纸板使其紧贴，以防纸张横向漂移和歪斜。

热敏打印头基本上是一排微型加热器，它们在几毫秒内开关。

这些点的温度可达约一百五十到二百摄氏度，即大约三百到三百九十华氏度，以使纸张变黑或熔化色带墨水。

由于它是一个精密部件，打印头上的任何灰尘、粘合剂或烧焦残留物都可能导致条纹、线条变淡或完全无法打印的死角。

保持打印头清洁是维持打印质量和延长打印机寿命的最重要方法。

清洁频率取决于打印量。

在高用量环境中，每天打印数百张标签或收据，需每周清洁。

在低用量环境中，每月清洁一次通常即可。

最好的工具是热敏打印头清洁笔，基本上是酒精笔，价格通常在五到十五美元左右，或者是蘸有百分之九十以上异丙醇的无绒棉签。

避免使用水、刺激性化学品和任何研磨性物品，因为打印头表面很脆弱。

关闭电源并拔掉打印机插头，打开打印头组件，等待五到十分钟让其冷却，因为刚打印完时它可能非常烫。

然后轻轻地单向平滑擦拭打印头末端。

不要像打磨桌子一样来回scrubbing。

用新的棉签重复两到三次，直到没有残留物转移。

让其干燥三到五分钟，然后合上盖子并进行测试打印。

碎屑是热敏打印机的隐形杀手。

纸尘、标签粘合剂碎片、色带残留物和环境灰尘都会导致压力不均匀和加热不均匀，并且会干扰传感器，导致即使装有纸张也会出现卡纸和缺纸错误。

通过定期清洁，你可以将打印头寿命从一到两年延长到三到五年，这在打印头是最昂贵易耗品的高忙环境中意义重大。

每当清洁打印头时，也要清洁其余的纸路。

保持罐体直立，短时喷射压缩空气，吹出胶辊区域、传感器区域以及碎屑积聚的任何角落。

使用软刷松动顽固碎屑，然后再次吹扫。

检查是否有粘合剂积聚，并用异丙醇清除。

最后，用无绒布擦拭可触及的内部表面，以便下一卷纸开始时环境干净。

良好的计划取决于使用情况。

高用量需要每周清洁。

中等用量可以每两周清洁一次。

低用量，即每天打印少于一百次，通常每月清洁一次即可。

保留维护日志。

使用优质热敏纸以减少碎屑。

尽可能将打印机存放在清洁区域，并培训用户正确装纸。

预防性维护比更换打印头和在繁忙时段损失时间更划算。

干得漂亮！

你现在知道了如何通过清洁进纸组件、装载正确的热敏纸、安全清洁加热元件以及控制碎屑来维护热敏打印机。

这些简单的习惯可以预防大多数热敏打印机问题，并保护最关键部件——打印头。

接下来，我们将完成第二十节，探讨针式打印机维护，包括色带更换和多联表单处理。

届时见。

英文原文

Hey everyone,now we're talking thermal printer maintenance.

These are the printers you see everywhere in the real world.

Receipts at stores,shipping labels,barcode tags and tickets.

Thermal printers are great because there's no ink and no toner,but they still need maintenance,just different maintenance.

The big focus is the feed assembly,the thermal paper or ribbon,the heating element and keeping debris out of the printer,so your labels and receipts stay crisp and readable.

Thermal printing is all about heat.

Direct thermal printers apply heat directly to heat sensitive paper,turning it black where heated.

Classic receipts and many shipping labels.

Thermal transfer printers use heat to melt wax or resin from a ribbon onto the label which creates more durable prints,great for barcodes and long lasting labels.

Both types depend on a heating element often called the print head which has hundreds of tiny heating points.

That's why print head care is everything in thermal maintenance.

The feed assembly is what moves paper through the printer.

It usually includes the platen roller,drive gears and sensors.

The platen roller is a rubber roller that presses the paper evenly against the heating element and that even pressure is what gives you consistent print quality across the full width of the label or receipt.

Over time dust,label adhesive residue and debris build up on the roller and sensors causing uneven feeds,gaps in printing and jams.A solid routine is cleaning the platen roller every one to two weeks or after every roll in high volume environments.

Power off and unplug the printer,open the printhead assembly using the release latch and wipe the platen roller with a lint free cloth dampened with 70 to 90 percent isopropyl alcohol while rotating it by hand.

If labels leave sticky residue,remove it thoroughly.

Adhesive buildup is a major cause of feed issues.

Blow out gears and tight spaces with compressed air and let everything dry before closing the printer.

Thermal printers are picky about paper,especially direct thermal.

Direct thermal paper has a heat sensitive coating often described as phenol or leuco dye based that reacts to heat.

Paper quality matters.

Cheap direct thermal paper can fade in 3 to 6 months while premium paper can last 2 to 3 years.

Storage matters too.

Keep rolls in a cool dry place away from sunlight and heat sources.

If thermal paper gets overheated the whole roll can darken or discolor before it even prints which is basically like ruining an entire ink cartridge except its paper.

Thermal paper loading is one of those small details that causes big problems if you get it wrong.

Direct thermal paper has a coated side that must face the heating element.

The easy test is to scratch the paper with your finger nail.

If it leaves a dark mark,that's the coated side.

Most printers feed from underneath,so you load the roll so the coated side faces up toward the printhead,align the roll evenly,and set the guides snug so the paper doesn't drift sideways and skew.

The thermal printhead is basically a line of tiny heaters that switch on and off in milliseconds.

Those points can reach around 150 to 200 degrees Celsius,which is about 300 to 390 degrees Fahrenheit,to darken paper or melt ribbon ink.

Because it's a precision part,any dust,adhesive,or burnt residue on the printhead can cause streaks,faded lines,or dead zones where printing disappears completely.

Keeping the printhead clean is the single biggest way to maintain print quality and extend printer life.

Cleaning frequency depends on how much you print.

In high-volume environments,hundreds of labels or receipts a day,clean weekly.

In low-volume environments,monthly is often fine.

The best tools are thermal printhead cleaning pens,basically alcohol pens,and they typically cost about$5 to$15 or lint-free swabs dipped in 90%plus isopropyl alcohol.

Avoid water,harsh chemicals,and anything abrasive because the printhead surface is delicate.

Power off and unplug the printer,open the printhead assembly,and wait 5-10 minutes for it to cool because it can be extremely hot right after printing.

Then gently wipe the printhead end to end in one smooth motion.

Don't scrub back and forth like you're sanding a table.

Repeat 2-3 times with fresh swabs until no residue transfers.

Let it dry for 3-5 minutes,then close up and test print.

Debris is the silent killer of thermal printers.

Paper dust,label adhesive bits,ribbon residue,and environmental dust all cause uneven pressure and uneven heating and they can confuse sensors leading to jams and paper out errors even when paper is loaded.

With regular cleaning,you can extend printhead life from 1 to 2 years to 3 to 5 years,which is a big deal in busy environments where printheads are the most expensive wear item.

Whenever you clean the printhead,clean the rest of the paper path too.

Use short bursts of compressed air while holding the can upright and blow out the platen area,sensor area and any tight corners where scraps collect.

Use a soft brush to loosen stubborn debris,then blow again.

Inspect for adhesive buildup and remove it with isopropyl alcohol.

Finally,wipe down accessible interior surfaces with a lint-free cloth so the next roll starts clean.

A good schedule depends on usage.

High volume needs weekly cleaning.

Medium volume can be bi-weekly.

Low volume,under 100 prints per day,monthly is usually fine.

Keep a maintenance log.

Use quality thermal paper to reduce debris.

Store printers in clean areas when possible and train users to load paper correctly.

Preventive maintenance is cheaper than replacing printheads and losing time during busy shifts.

Great job!

You now know how to maintain thermal printers by cleaning the feed assembly,loading the correct thermal paper,cleaning the heating element safely,and controlling debris.

These simple habits prevent most thermal printer problems and protect the printhead,the most critical component.

Next up,we'll finish section 20 with impact printer maintenance,including ribbon replacement and multi-part form handling.

See you there.

176. 针式打印机维护

大家好，欢迎来到“针式打印机维护”这一节的最后一讲。

这些是老式的点阵打印机，许多人认为它们几十年前就消失了，但在依赖多联表单的行业中，它们仍在使用。

如果你曾见过仓库发货单伴随着那种经典的嗡嗡声打印出来，那就是针式打印机在做激光或喷墨打印机无法高效完成的工作：即时生成复写风格的副本。

针式打印机的工作原理是通过针头撞击浸满墨水的色带，将字符物理压印在纸上，就像打字机一样。

这种冲击力会穿透多联表单的多层纸张，无需扫描或复印即可生成副本。

这就是为什么它们仍被用于仓库的发货单和装箱单、需要客户留存联的发票、需要duplicate记录的医疗表单，以及任何依赖即时多层文档的工作流程。

多联表单，也称为复写纸或无碳复写纸，通常有两到六层。

顶层是原件，然后是黄色、粉色或蓝色等彩色副本。

每张纸的背面都涂有微胶囊染料，在压力下破裂并转移到下一张纸上。

根据打印机的不同，这些表单可以是带有穿孔边缘和链轮孔的连续进纸格式，也可以是单张纸格式。

正确装载多联纸张可以防止大多数卡纸和对齐问题。对于连续进纸表单，将链轮孔与两侧的链轮对齐，确保所有层均匀对齐，并调整链轮宽度，使纸张绷紧但不要拉伸。

对于单张纸表单，整齐地装入纸堆，不要过满，通常在五十到一百张之间，并在装纸前先扇开纸堆，以防各层粘连。

针式打印机通常有一个纸张厚度设置，通常由杠杆控制。

你可能会看到设置为“一”代表单张纸，“二”到“三”代表两到三联表单。请使用正确的设置，因为错误的厚度会导致副本模糊或色带过度磨损。

将表单平放在阴凉干燥处保存，因为湿度会使纸张卷曲和粘连。

如果副本模糊，请增加撞击力或检查色带。

如果各层分离，请降低速度或调整厚度设置以改善处理效果。

针式打印机色带是浸满墨水的织物色带，随着打印机运行而前进。

当色带磨损时，打印会变淡、出现条纹，或者打印机几乎只能输出难以辨认的灰色文本。

一旦打印变得难以阅读，请立即更换色带。

继续使用磨损的色带会增加摩擦力，并可能加速打印头磨损，这是一个更大且更昂贵的问题。

更换色带很快，通常只需两到五分钟。

为了安全起见，请关闭打印机电源，打开盖子，找到色带盒，松开并将其拉出。

拆开新色带盒的包装，移除任何保护夹或胶带，并将其卡入色带导轨中，以便正确穿引。

盖上盖子并打印测试页，确认文本颜色深且一致。

你会看到不同的色带样式：织物色带、盒式色带，以及需要手动穿线的老式卷轴色带。

盒式色带最容易更换。

请使用原厂或高质量的兼容色带，因为廉价色带可能会起毛、脱落纤维并产生碎屑，从而堵塞打印头。

黑色是标准配置，有些打印机支持彩色色带，用于特殊的高亮工作流程。

针式打印机的打印头通常有九针或二十四针，快速击打以生成字符，每秒可达一千次撞击。

随着时间的推移，针头可能会磨损、断裂或卡住。

典型的症状是缺少点阵，导致字母看起来有空洞，例如字母“H”打印成两条独立的垂直线。

许多打印头的额定寿命约为三亿到五亿个字符，这通常相当于典型使用下的三到七年。

当缺失点阵现象持续存在且更换色带无法解决时，当错误消息指示打印头故障时，或当可见物理损坏时，请更换打印头。

替换打印头的成本通常在五十到二百美元以上，具体取决于型号。

对于较旧的打印机，更换可能不符合成本效益，升级可能是更好的长期支持决策。

更换打印头是这里最复杂的任务，通常需要十到二十分钟。

关闭电源并拔掉打印机插头，取下色带，找到打印头组件，小心断开扁平电缆，同时注意方向。

卸下螺丝或夹子，取出旧打印头，安装新打印头，重新连接电缆，固定所有部件，重新安装色带，然后运行测试打印以验证对齐和字符质量。

针式打印机非常可靠，尤其是使用连续进纸时，但卡纸仍然会发生，通常是由于链轮孔未对齐、各层分离或纸路中有碎屑。

关闭电源，打开盖子，沿着卡纸位置之前的穿孔线撕开，而不是向后猛拉。

移除所有卡住的纸张和任何撕裂的碎片，确认链轮对齐，然后小心重新装载。

对于单张纸卡纸，取出纸堆，清除碎屑，然后重新装载对齐良好的表单。干得漂亮！

你现在知道了如何维护针式打印机。

正确装载多联表单，使用正确的厚度设置，在色带破坏打印质量之前将其更换，识别打印头磨损，安全更换打印头，并在不撕裂整个纸路的情况下清除卡纸。

至此完成了第二十节：激光、喷墨、热敏和针式打印机的打印机维护。

这些技能在现场能节省真正的时间和金钱，这正是让你在支持角色中变得有价值的实用知识。

我们在下一节再见。

英文原文

Hey everyone,welcome to the final lecture of section Impact Printer Maintenance.

These are the old school dot matrix printers that many people assume disappeared decades ago,but they are still used in industries that rely on multi-part forms.

If you have ever seen a warehouse packing slip printing with that classic buzzing sound,that's an impact printer doing what no laser or inkjet can do efficiently,creating instant carbon copy style duplicates.

Impact printers work by striking pins through an ink-soaked ribbon onto paper,physically imprinting characters like a typewriter.

That impact force transfers through multiple layers of multi-part forms,producing duplicates without scanning or photocopying.

That's why they are still used for shipping and packing slips in warehouses,invoices that need customer copies,medical forms requiring duplicate records,and any workflow that depends on immediate multi-layer documentation.

Multi-part forms,also called carbon copy or carbonless forms,usually have two to six layers.

You have the top sheet as the original and then colored copies like yellow,pink or blue.

The back of each sheet is coated with micro-encapsulated dye that breaks under pressure and transfers to the sheet below.

These forms can be continuous feed with perforated edges and tractor holes or cut sheet formats depending on the printer.

Loading multi-part paper correctly prevents most jams and alignment problems.For continuous feed forms,align the tractor holes with the sprockets on both sides,make sure all layers are aligned evenly and adjust tractor width so the paper is taut but not stretched.

For cut sheet forms,load the stack evenly aligned,don't overfill,often around 50 to 100 sheets,and fan the stack first so layers don't stick together.

Impact printers often have a paper thickness setting commonly controlled by a lever.

You might see settings like 1 for single sheet and 2 to 3 for 2 to 3 part forms.Use the correct setting because the wrong thickness causes faint copies or extra ribbon wear.

Store forms flat in a cool dry place because humidity makes sheets curl and stick.

If copies are faint,increase impact force or check the ribbon.

If layers separate,reduce speed or adjust thickness settings to improve handling.

Impact printer ribbons are ink-soaked fabric ribbons that advance as the printer runs.

When the ribbon wears out,print fades,streaks appear or the printer produces barely readable grey text.

Replace the ribbon as soon as print becomes difficult to read.

Running a worn ribbon increases friction and can accelerate print head wear,which is a bigger and more expensive problem.

Ribbon deplacement is quick,often two to five minutes.

Power off the printer to be safe,open the cover,locate the ribbon cartridge,release it and pull it out.

Unpack the new cartridge,remove any protective clips or tape and snap it into the ribbon guides so it seeds correctly.

Close the cover and print a test page to confirm text is dark and consistent.

You'll see different ribbon styles,fabric ribbons,cartridge ribbons and older spool ribbons that require manual threading.

Cartridge ribbons are the easiest to replace.

Use OEM or high-quality compatible ribbons because cheap ribbons can fray,shed fibers and create debris that clogs the printhead.

Black is standard and some printers support color ribbons for special highlighting workflows.

Impact printer printheads usually have 9 or 24 pins that fire rapidly to create characters up to 1000 impacts per second.

Over time,pins can wear down,break or stick.

The classic symptom is missing dots where letters look holy,like an H printing as two separate vertical lines.

Many printheads are rated around 300 to 500 million characters,which often translates to around 3 to 7 years of typical use.

Replace the printhead when missing dots are consistent and ribbon replacement doesn't fix it,when error messages indicate printhead failure or when physical damage is visible.

Replacement printheads often cost$50 to$200 plus depending on the model.

On older printers,replacement might not be cost effective and upgrading can be the better long-term support decision.

Printhead replacement is the most involved task here,often 10 to 20 minutes.

Power off and unplug the printer,remove the ribbon,locate the printhead assembly,and carefully disconnect the ribbon cable while noting orientation.

Remove screws or clips,lift out the old printhead,install the new one,reconnect the cable,secure everything,reinstall the ribbon,and run test prints to verify alignment and character quality.

Impact printers can be very reliable,especially with continuous feed,but jams still happen,usually from misaligned tractor holes,layers separating or debris in the paper path.

Power off,open the cover and tear along the perforation before the jam rather than yanking backward.

Remove all jammed paper and any torn fragments,confirm tractor alignment and reload carefully.

For cut sheet jams,remove the stack,clear debris and reload properly aligned forms.Awesome work!

You now know how to maintain impact printers.

Load multi-part forms correctly,use the right thickness settings,replace ribbons before they destroy print quality,recognize print head wear,replace print heads safely and clear jams without tearing up the whole paper path.

That completes Section twenty Printer Maintenance Across Laser,Inkjet,Thermal,and Impact Printers.

These skills save real time and real money in the field,and they're exactly the kind of practical knowledge that makes you valuable in support roles.

See you in the next section.

177. 虚拟机的用途

欢迎大家来到另一个激动人心的技术章节。

在本章中，我们将学习虚拟化概念。

本章涵盖了现代IT中最具变革性的技术之一。

今天我们从虚拟机的目的开始，虚拟机简称VM。虚拟机本质上是一台计算机内的计算机。

它是一种模拟物理硬件的软件，允许你在单台物理机器上同时运行多个操作系统。

这听起来像魔法，但实际上非常实用且强大。

把虚拟机想象成打包在软件文件中的一台完整计算机。

它拥有虚拟CPU核心、内存、通过虚拟硬盘提供的存储、网络适配器，甚至USB端口，所有这些都由管理程序提供。

每台虚拟机都运行自己的操作系统，例如Windows、Linux或Mac OS，并且它与宿主机以及其他虚拟机保持隔离。

这意味着你可以在同一台物理笔记本电脑上同时运行Windows Server、Ubuntu Linux和Windows 10，而每一台的表现都好像拥有自己专用的计算机一样。

虚拟化带来了巨大的好处。

你可以实现硬件整合，这意味着你可以在一台物理服务器上运行十到五十多台虚拟机，而无需维护十到五十台独立的服务器。

通过减少硬件采购、电力消耗、冷却和数据中心空间百分之六十到百分之八十，你可以节省成本。

你获得了灵活性，因为你可以在几分钟内启动新的虚拟机，而物理硬件则需要几天时间。

你还获得了改进的灾难恢复能力，因为虚拟机基本上是文件，可以快速备份、复制和还原。

此外还简化管理，因为你可以从单个控制台管理数百台虚拟机。

这就是为什么现在百分之九十以上的企业服务器都实现了虚拟化。

以下是虚拟化真正大放异彩的地方。

资源共享。

一台拥有六十四核CPU、五百一十二GB内存和十TB存储的物理服务器，如果只运行一个工作负载，大部分时间处于空闲状态。

利用率可能只有百分之十到百分之二十。

通过虚拟化，你可以将这些资源划分为多个虚拟机，例如十台虚拟机，每台获得六核、五十GB内存和一TB存储，利用率瞬间跃升至百分之七十到百分之八十。

管理程序还可以动态重新分配资源。

因此，如果一台虚拟机暂时需要更多CPU，它可以借用空闲虚拟机的未使用容量，这也是云平台如此高效的一个重要原因。

最常见的企业用例是服务器整合。

公司过去运行数十甚至数百台物理服务器，包括文件服务器、邮件服务器、数据库服务器和Web服务器，每台机器利用率不足且维护成本高昂。

虚拟化让你可以将十到二十台物理服务器整合到一台强大的主机上。

例如，一家小企业可以用两台运行八台虚拟机的虚拟化主机，取代八台成本超过三万美元的物理服务器，每年节省一万五千美元以上。

更妙的是，添加新服务器只需大约十分钟，而不是几周。

开发人员喜欢虚拟机，因为测试变得快速且灵活。

如果你需要在Windows 10、Windows 11、Ubuntu 22.04和CentOS 8上测试应用程序，你可以启动四台虚拟机并测试所有环境，而无需购买四台机器或反复重装操作系统。

虚拟机还支持快照，这就像保存整个机器状态。

你在进行风险更改之前拍摄快照，测试你的更新，如果出现问题，你可以在几秒钟内回滚。

这将测试变成了一个安全、可重复的过程，而不是一场噩梦。

虚拟机是灾难恢复的巨大胜利。

对于物理服务器，从灾难中恢复可能意味着重装操作系统、重装应用程序、还原数据以及重建配置，导致数小时甚至数天的停机时间。

对于虚拟机，你将整个系统作为文件备份，然后将这些文件还原到兼容的硬件或云端，并在几分钟内启动虚拟机。

高可用性在此基础上构建，通过自动在其他主机上重启失败的虚拟机，通常只需几秒钟。

这就是为什么关键任务服务喜爱虚拟化的原因。

停机时间从几小时缩短到几分钟。

虚拟机非常适合培训，因为它们让人们通过实践来学习，而不会破坏真实系统。

与其为教室购买成堆的服务器，不如让每位学生在笔记本电脑上运行自己的实验室，在隔离的虚拟机中运行Windows Server、Linux、域控制器和安全工具。学生可以自由实验、犯错，然后立即重置。

这就是为什么认证培训和动手IT教育严重依赖虚拟化。

有时你需要不止一个操作系统。

也许你使用Mac但需要Windows来运行特定工具，或者你使用Windows但需要Linux进行开发。

虚拟机让你可以在不进行双重启动且不购买另一台计算机的情况下运行多个操作系统。

你可以像在选项卡之间切换一样在系统之间切换，这对于跨平台测试、IT支持工作和混合环境团队来说非常有用。虚拟机也是遗留应用程序的救星。

如果你有一个只在旧操作系统上运行的旧应用程序，你可以在虚拟机中运行该操作系统，让应用程序继续工作，而无需维护古老的物理硬件。

与其为了一个Windows XP时代的工具而维持一台布满灰尘的旧机器，不如将该环境虚拟化、隔离它，并保持其余基础设施的现代化。

这让企业有时间进行现代化改造而不中断运营。

虚拟机为风险工作创建了安全的沙盒环境。

安全团队可以在虚拟机内分析可疑文件，如果结果是恶意软件，损害将被控制在范围内，特别是当虚拟机配置了正确的隔离时。

IT团队也可以先在虚拟机中测试不可信的软件或未知的附件。如果出现问题，你可以删除虚拟机或还原到干净的快照，从而回到安全状态。

让我们将其连接到一个现实世界的场景。

一家拥有五十名员工的公司可能需要一台文件服务器、一个Active Directory域控制器、一台邮件服务器、一台会计数据库服务器和一台Web服务器。

传统上，这需要五台物理服务器，成本约为两万到三万美元，再加上持续的成本。

通过虚拟化，他们可以花费约一万五千美元购买两台用于冗余的强大主机服务器，运行五台虚拟机，并获得更简单的备份、更快的灾难恢复和更轻松的管理。

IT团队不再需要照看五台独立的机器，而是从一个控制台管理整个环境。

太棒了。

你现在了解了什么是虚拟机、它们为何如此有用，以及组织使用它们的主要原因。

服务器整合、成本节约、灵活性、灾难恢复、测试、培训、多操作系统支持、遗留支持和沙盒化。

虚拟化是现代IT的基础，云计算heavily建立在这些概念之上。

接下来，我们将专门关注沙盒环境，以及虚拟机如何创建保护生产系统的安全测试空间。届时见。

英文原文

Welcome to another exciting technology section.

In this we'll learn virtualization concepts.

This section covers one of the most transformative technologies in modern IT.

Today we are starting with the purpose of virtual machines or VMs.A VM is essentially a computer within a computer.

Software that emulates physical hardware,allowing you to run multiple operating systems on a single physical machine simultaneously.

It sounds like magic,but it's incredibly practical and powerful.

Think of a VM as a complete computer packaged in software files.

It has virtual CPU cores,RAM,storage through virtual hard disks,network adapters and even USB ports,all provided by a hypervisor.

Each VM runs its own operating system such as Windows,Linux or Mac OS,and it stays isolated from the host machine and from other VMs.

That means you can run Windows Server,Ubuntu Linux,and Windows 10 all on the same physical laptop at the same time and each one behaves like it has its own dedicated computer.

Virtualization delivers massive benefits.

You get hardware consolidation,meaning you can run 10 to 50 plus VMs on one physical server instead of maintaining 10 to 50 separate servers.

You get cost savings by reducing hardware purchases,power consumption,cooling and data center space by 60 to 80 percent.

You get flexibility because you can spin up new VMs in minutes instead of days for physical hardware.

You also get improved disaster recovery because VMs are basically files you can backup,copy and restore quickly.

Plus simplified management because you can manage hundreds of VMs from a single console.

This is why 90%plus of enterprise servers are now virtualized.

Here's where virtualization really shines.

Resource sharing.

A physical server with 64 CPU cores,512 GB RAM and 10TB storage sits mostly idle if it runs just one workload.

Maybe 10 to 20%utilization.

With virtualization you carve up those resources into multiple VMs such as 10 VMs each receiving 6 cores,50 GB RAM and 1 TB storage and suddenly utilization jumps to 70 to 80 percent.

The hypervisor can also redistribute resources dynamically.

So if one VM needs more CPU temporarily,it can borrow unused capacity from idle VMs which is a big reason cloud platforms work so well.

The most common enterprise use case is server consolidation.

Companies used to run dozens or hundreds of physical servers,file servers,email servers,database servers and web servers with each machine underutilized and expensive to maintain.

Virtualization lets you consolidate ten to twenty physical servers onto one powerful host machine.

For example,a small business can replace 8 physical servers that cost$30000 plus with two virtualization hosts running 8 VMs saving$15000 plus annually.

Even better,adding a new server can take about 10 minutes instead of weeks.

Developers love VMs because testing becomes fast and flexible.

If you need to test an app on Windows 10,Windows 11,Ubuntu 22.04 and CentOS 8,you can spin up 4 VMs and test all environments without buying 4 machines or reinstalling operating systems over and over.

VMs also support snapshots,which are like saving the entire machine state.

You take a snapshot before a risky change,test your update,and if anything breaks,you roll back in seconds.

That turns testing into a safe,repeatable process instead of a nightmare.

VMs are a huge win for disaster recovery.

With physical servers,restoring from disaster can mean reinstalling an OS,reinstalling apps,restoring data,and rebuilding configurations,hours or days of downtime.

With VMs,you backup the entire system as files,then restore those files to compatible hardware or to the cloud and boot the VM in minutes.

High availability builds on this by restarting failed VMs on other hosts automatically,often within seconds.

That's why mission critical services love virtualization.

Downtime drops from hours to minutes.

VMs are perfect for training because they let people learn by doing without breaking real systems.

Instead of buying piles of servers for a classroom,each student can run their own lab on a laptop,Windows Server,Linux,domain controllers,and security tools inside isolated VMs.Students can experiment freely,make mistakes,and then reset instantly.

That's why certification training and hands-on IT education lean heavily on virtualization.

Sometimes you need more than one operating system.

Maybe you use a Mac but need Windows for a specific tool or you use Windows but need Linux for development.

VMs let you run multiple OSs without dual booting and without buying another computer.

You can switch between systems like switching tabs which is incredibly useful for cross-platform testing,IT support work and mixed environment teams.VMs are also a lifesaver for legacy applications.

If you have an older application that only works on an old OS,you can run that OS inside a VM and keep the app working without maintaining ancient physical hardware.

Instead of keeping a dusty old machine alive just for one Windows XP era tool,you virtualize that environment,isolate it and keep the rest of your infrastructure modern.

This gives businesses time to modernize without disrupting operations.

VMs create safe sandbox environments for risky work.

Security teams can analyze suspicious files inside a VM and if it turns out to be malware the damage stays contained,especially when the VM is configured with the right isolation.

IT teams can also test untrusted software or unknown attachments in a VM first.If something goes wrong you delete the VM or revert to a clean snapshot and you're back to safety.

Let's connect this to a real world scenario.

A 50 employee company might need a file server,an Active Directory domain controller,an email server,an accounting database server and a web server.

Traditionally that's five physical servers costing about twenty thousand to thirty thousand dollars plus ongoing costs.

With virtualization they can buy two strong host servers for redundancy for about fifteen thousand dollars,run five VMs and gain simpler backups,faster disaster recovery and easier management.

Instead of babysitting five separate machines the IT team manages the environment from one console.

Excellent.

You now understand what VMs are,why they are so useful and the main reasons organizations use them.

Server consolidation,cost savings,flexibility,disaster recovery,testing,training,multi-OS support,legacy support and sandboxing.

Virtualization is foundational to modern IT and cloud computing builds heavily on these concepts.

Next up,we'll focus specifically on sandbox environments and how VMs create safe testing spaces that protect production systems.See you there.

178. 沙盒环境

大家好，在本讲座中，我们将专注于沙盒环境，这是一种隔离的受控空间，您可以在其中进行测试、实验和分析，而无需冒生产系统受损的风险。

虚拟机非常适合沙盒化，因为如果配置得当，它们可以与宿主机和网络隔离。

沙盒化是信息技术和网络安全工作的日常工具，无论您是在测试高风险更新、评估新软件还是安全地分析可疑文件。

沙盒是一个受控环境，其中发生的任何事情都停留在内部。

就像儿童的沙盒，他们可以在里面建造和摧毁城堡，而不会弄乱房子。

在信息技术领域，沙盒虚拟机是一个独立的测试世界，您可以随时将其擦除并重建。

您可以安装不可信的软件、更改设置、打开可疑文件或故意破坏配置，如果出现问题，您只需删除虚拟机或将其回滚到干净状态。

隔离是全部意义所在。

在生产环境中，糟糕的更新可能导致停机，错误的配置可能破坏连接，不良的安装可能毁坏系统。

在沙盒虚拟机中，失败是安全的。

您可以先进行测试，了解什么会出问题，只有在确定稳定后才部署到生产环境。

这就是专业人士避免经典噩梦场景的方法。

我安装了一个东西，现在什么都不能用了。

常见的沙盒测试包括软件评估，即在向用户推广之前尝试新工具。

更新测试，即在广泛部署之前测试Windows更新、驱动程序更新和应用程序补丁。

配置测试，即在受控环境中尝试防火墙规则、注册表更改或策略调整。

以及灾难恢复演练，在不影响真实服务的情况下练习恢复和故障场景。

沙盒化将高风险变更转化为可预测、可重复的练习。

沙盒化也是安全的基石。

如果您收到可疑的电子邮件附件或从不熟悉的来源下载文件，在主系统上打开它是有风险的。

在沙盒虚拟机中，您可以在无法访问敏感数据的隔离环境中打开该文件。

如果它是恶意的，损害将被控制在内部，您可以在分析后擦除虚拟机。

这是降低现实世界恶意软件风险的最简单方法之一。

要正确进行沙盒化，网络隔离至关重要。

您通常将沙盒虚拟机的网络配置为三种安全样式之一。

仅主机模式，虚拟机只能与宿主机通信；内部网络模式，它只能与其他隔离的虚拟机通信；或带有仅出站规则的网络地址转换模式，它可以访问互联网进行下载，但无法访问您的内部局域网。

大原则很简单。

切勿将沙盒虚拟机直接连接到您的生产网络，因为那会使containment的目的失效。

快照是让沙盒化变得快速的超级力量。在您做任何高风险操作之前，请拍摄快照，这是虚拟机的时间点保存状态。

如果您的测试破坏了系统或使其感染，您可以在几秒钟内回滚。

这意味着您可以反复测试高风险变更、比较结果并进行迭代，而无需不断重装操作系统。

在实践中，快照让虚拟机感觉像是一次性的，因为它们确实是。

一个专门的沙盒用例是恶意软件分析。

安全团队在隔离的虚拟机中运行可疑文件，同时监控行为。

他们会观察进程、网络活动和持久化尝试，以查看恶意软件试图做什么。

虚拟机可能包含诱饵文件，以观察恶意软件是否搜索文档或凭据。

分析结束后，虚拟机会被删除或回滚到干净的快照，以确保没有残留污染。

除了手动虚拟机设置外，还有专门为沙盒工作流构建的工具。

Cuckoo Sandbox通过运行文件并生成行为报告来自动化恶意软件分析。

Windows Sandbox提供了一个轻量级的一次性环境，关闭时会自动重置。

Any.run提供基于云的交互式沙盒体验，而Joe Sandbox是一个商业分析平台。

当您分析大量文件或需要标准化报告时，这些工具可以减少人工工作量。

为了保持沙盒化的安全和有效，请遵循一些最佳实践。

切勿重复使用已受损的沙盒。

在测试不可信文件后，务必回滚或删除它。

在每次高风险操作前拍摄快照。

并禁用共享文件夹和剪贴板共享等便利功能，以防恶意软件跳转到宿主机。此外，记录您测试的内容和发生的情况，因为良好的笔记能将“我觉得它做了些奇怪的事”转变为真正的可重复事件报告。

现实情况是：一些现代恶意软件试图检测沙盒并表现良好以避免分析。

它可能会检查虚拟机伪影、虚拟硬件标识符或沙盒工具。

有些恶意软件会延迟执行数小时，以熬过自动化分析窗口。

对于高端威胁，团队可能需要更长时间的监控、更好的隐蔽配置，甚至需要在物理机器上进行分析。

即使存在这些限制，沙盒化仍能捕获大多数常见威胁并防止许多实际损害。

做得很好。

您现在了解了沙盒环境，即基于虚拟机的隔离测试空间，可保护生产系统免受高风险软件、高风险配置和可疑文件的侵害。

网络隔离和快照是您最好的朋友，良好的沙盒习惯可以防止许多安全和稳定性灾难。

接下来，我们将探讨利用虚拟机进行测试开发，即开发人员和测试人员如何利用虚拟化技术在许多环境中构建可靠的软件。

届时见。

英文原文

Hey everyone,in this lecture we are focusing on sandbox environments,isolated controlled spaces where you can test,experiment and analyze without risking your production systems.

VMs are perfect for sandboxing because they can be isolated from the host machine and from the network when configured correctly.

Sandboxing is a daily tool for IT and cybersecurity work,whether you're testing a risky update,evaluating new software or analyzing suspicious files safely.

A sandbox is a controlled environment where whatever happens inside stays inside.

Like a child's sandbox where they can build and destroy castles without messing up the house.

In IT,a sandbox VM is a separate test world that you can wipe and rebuild anytime.

You can install untrusted software,change settings,open suspicious files or intentionally break configurations and if things go wrong you just delete the VM or roll it back to a clean state.

Isolation is the whole point.

In production a bad update can cause downtime,a bad configuration can break connectivity and a bad install can wreck a system.

In a sandbox VM,failure is safe.

You can test first,learn what breaks and only deploy to production when you know it's stable.

This is how professionals avoid the classic nightmare scenario.

I installed one thing and now nothing works.

Common sandbox tests include software evaluation where you try a new tool before rolling it out to users.

Update testing where you test Windows updates,driver updates and application patches before deploying widely.

Configuration testing where you try firewall rules,registry changes or policy adjustments in a controlled environment.

And disaster recovery drills where you practice restores and failure scenarios without impacting real services.

Sandboxing turns risky changes into predictable,repeatable exercises.

Sandboxing is also a cornerstone of security.

If you receive a suspicious email attachment or download a file from an unfamiliar source,opening it on your main system is risky.

In a sandbox VM,you can open that file in an isolated environment with no access to sensitive data.

If it's malicious,the damage stays contained and you can wipe the VM after analysis.

This is one of the simplest ways to reduce real-world malware risk.

To sandbox correctly,network isolation matters.

You generally configure your sandbox VM network in one of three safe styles.

Host only,where the VM can only talk to the host,internal network,where it can only talk to other isolated VMs,or NAT with outbound-only rules,where it can reach the internet for downloads but not reach your internal LAN.

The big rule is simple.

Never attach a sandbox VM directly to your production network,because that defeats the purpose of containment.

Snapshots are the superpower that makes sandboxing fast.Before you do anything risky,you take a snapshot,which is a point-in-time saved state of the VM.

If your test breaks the system or infects it,you revert back in seconds.

That means you can test risky changes repeatedly,compare results,and iterate without constantly reinstalling the OS.

In practice,snapshots make VMs feel disposable,because they are.

A specialized sandbox use case is malware analysis.

Security teams run suspicious files inside isolated VMs while monitoring behavior.

They'll watch processes,network activity,and persistence attempts to see what the malware tries to do.

The VM might include decoy files to observe whether the malware searches for documents or credentials.

After analysis,the VM is deleted or reverted to a clean snapshot so no contamination remains.

Beyond manual VM setups,there are tools built specifically for sandbox workflows.

Cuckoo Sandbox automates malware analysis by running files and producing behavior reports.

Windows Sandbox provides a lightweight disposable environment that resets when closed.

Any.run provides an interactive cloud-based sandbox experience,and Joe Sandbox is a commercial analysis platform.

These tools reduce manual effort when you are analyzing lots of files or need standardized reporting.

To keep sandboxing safe and effective,follow a few best practices.

Never reuse a compromised sandbox.

Always revert or delete it after testing untrusted files.

Snapshot before every risky action.

And disable convenience features like shared folders and clipboard sharing so malware can't jump to the host.Also,document what you tested and what happened because good nodes turn I think it did something weird into a real repeatable incident report.

Here's the reality:some modern malware tries to detect sandboxes and behave nicely to avoid analysis.

It may check for VM artifacts,virtual hardware identifiers,or sandbox tools.

Some malware delays execution for hours to outlast automated analysis windows.

For high-end threats,teams may need longer monitoring,better stealth configurations,or even analysis on physical machines.

Even with these limitations,sandboxing still catches the majority of common threats and prevents a lot of real damage.

Great work.

You now understand sandbox environments as isolated VM-based test spaces that protect production systems from risky software,risky configurations,and suspicious files.

Network isolation and snapshots are your best friends and good sandbox habits prevent many security and stability disasters.

Next,we'll explore test development with VMs,how developers and testers use virtualization to build reliable software across many environments.

See you there.

179. 使用 VM 进行测试开发

大家好！

今天我们讨论利用虚拟机进行测试开发，即开发人员、测试人员和运维开发团队如何利用虚拟化技术高效地构建、测试和验证软件。

软件必须在许多操作系统版本、配置和环境中运行，而使用物理机器来实现这一点既缓慢、昂贵又令人沮丧。

虚拟机通过让您按需创建测试环境、并行运行测试以及在出现问题时立即重置系统，解决了这个问题。

开发人员经常遇到环境问题。

一个应用程序可能需要在Windows十、Windows十一、Windows Server、Ubuntu和CentOS上运行，每个系统都有不同的依赖项和设置。

设置这么多物理机器或不断擦除并重装一台机器是巨大的时间浪费。

使用虚拟机，您可以并排创建多个环境，同时进行测试，并在用户发现之前尽早捕捉特定于平台的问题。

虚拟机为测试带来五大好处。

快速供应让您能在十到三十分钟内创建新环境，而不是花费数小时或数天。

并行测试让您能同时测试多个操作系统版本。

一致性让每个人拥有相同的环境，因此“在我的机器上能运行”不再成为借口。

隔离让您能测试冲突的软件版本而不会发生碰撞。

成本节约意味着一台强大的工作站可以托管五到十个虚拟机，而无需购买五到十台独立的机器。

兼容性测试是虚拟机的亮点所在。

如果您的客户使用不同的操作系统版本，您需要确认您的应用程序在所有这些版本上都能正常运行。

一种明智的方法是为您支持的每个操作系统版本保留虚拟机模板，然后在需要全新的测试系统时克隆模板。

您运行测试，记录结果，随后删除克隆体。

这能保持您的测试实验室整洁，并避免因一台测试机器被用于所有用途而导致的缓慢退化。

快照就像是测试人员的时间机器。

您安装操作系统和依赖项，然后拍摄一个名为“干净安装”的快照。

然后您安装应用程序并再次拍摄快照。

现在您可以测试更新、高风险更改和新构建，如果出现问题，您可以在几秒钟内还原。

这消除了数小时的重装时间，并将测试转变为快速迭代，而非缓慢恢复。

在持续集成斜杠持续交付工作流中，快照变得更为强大。

流水线可以从快照启动虚拟机，部署最新构建，运行自动化测试，收集日志，然后销毁虚拟机。

这每天可以发生数十次甚至数百次，且每次运行都从已知的良好状态开始。

这种一致性使得自动化测试值得信赖，因为您不是在调试环境，而是在调试代码。

许多真实的应用程序不仅仅是一台服务器。

您可能有一台Web服务器、一台应用服务器、一台数据库服务器，也许还有缓存或消息队列。

虚拟机让您能够在一台机器上创建多个虚拟机并通过虚拟网络连接它们，从而复制整个堆栈。

这意味着您可以在本地测试真实的环境，而无需一个装满硬件的专用实验室房间。

回归测试意味着确保新更改没有破坏现有功能。

传统上，回归测试耗时极长。

借助虚拟机和自动化，您可以还原到已知基线，安装新构建，运行回归套件，并快速审查结果。

这使得即使频繁发布更新，也能进行彻底的测试。

Web开发人员需要在不同浏览器和平台上进行测试。虚拟机帮助您在Windows环境中运行Chrome、Firefox和Edge，在Linux环境中进行额外覆盖，并在Mac硬件上的Mac OS环境中进行Safari测试。

移动测试通常使用行为类似虚拟机的模拟器和仿真器，让您无需拥有数十台设备即可测试应用程序。

云服务也提供托管环境，以便即时测试各种组合。

虚拟机改善了协作，因为团队可以共享模板。

与其让每位开发人员以不同方式构建自己的设置，不如创建一个包含正确工具和依赖项的虚拟机模板并进行分发。

每个人都在相同的环境中工作，错误可可靠地复现，并且入职变得更快，因为新团队成员可以导入虚拟机并迅速开始工作。

强大的虚拟机策略建立在模板之上。

为您支持的每个操作系统维护基础模板，每季度进行修补，然后创建基于角色的模板，如Web开发、质量保证测试和数据库开发。

当您需要新环境时，请克隆模板，而不是从头重建。

良好的模板能节省大量时间并保持测试的一致性。

太棒了！

您现在了解了虚拟机如何通过实现快速环境创建、并行测试、一致的设置、快照、自动化和全栈模拟来支持测试开发。

快照和模板是您实现速度和稳定性的秘密武器。

接下来，我们将探讨应用程序虚拟化，它采用了一种不同的方法，即虚拟化单个应用程序而不是整个操作系统。届时见。

Hey everyone!

Today we are talking about test development with VMs,how developers,testers and DevOps teams use virtualization to build,test and validate software efficiently.

Software has to run across many OS versions,configurations and environments and doing that with physical machines is slow,expensive and frustrating.

VMs solve that problem by letting you create test environments on demand,run tests in parallel and reset systems instantly when something breaks.

Developers constantly run into environment issues.

An app might need to run on Windows 10,Windows 11,Windows Server,Ubuntu and CentOS,each with different dependencies and settings.

Setting up that many physical machines or constantly wiping and reinstalling one machine is a huge waste of time.

With VMs,you create multiple environments side by side,test them simultaneously and catch platform specific issues early before users do.

VMs bring five big benefits to testing.

Rapid provisioning lets you create new environments in 10 to 30 minutes instead of hours or days.

Parallel testing lets you test multiple OS versions at the same time.

Consistency gives everyone the same environment so it works on my machine stops being an excuse.

Isolation lets you test conflicting versions of software without collisions.

And cost savings means one strong workstation can host 5 to 10 VMs instead of buying 5 to 10 separate machines.

Compatibility testing is where VMs shine.

If your customers use different OS versions,you need to confirm your app behaves correctly across all of them.

A smart approach is to keep VM templates for each OS version you support,then clone a template when you need a fresh test system.

You run your tests,record results and delete the clone afterward.

This keeps your test lab clean and avoids the slow decay that happens when one test machine gets used for everything.

Snapshots are like a time machine for testers.

You install the OS and dependencies and take a snapshot called clean install.

Then you install your app and snapshot again.

Now you can test updates,risky changes and new builds and if anything goes wrong,you revert in seconds.

This eliminates hours of reinstallation and turns testing into fast iteration instead of slow recovery.

In CI slash CD workflows,snapshots become even more powerful.

A pipeline can spin up a VM from a snapshot,deploy the newest build,run automated tests,collect logs,then destroy the VM.

This can happen dozens or hundreds of times per day and every run starts from a known good state.

That consistency is what makes automated testing trustworthy because you are not debugging the environment,you are debugging the code.

Many real applications aren't just one server.

You might have a web server,an application server,a database server,and maybe caching or messaging.

VMs let you replicate entire stacks by creating multiple VMs on one machine and connecting them with virtual networking.

That means you can test a realistic environment locally without a dedicated lab room full of hardware.

Regression testing means making sure new changes didn't break existing functionality.

Traditionally,regression testing takes forever.

With VMs and automation,you can revert to a known baseline,install the new build,run the regression suite,and review results quickly.

This makes thorough testing possible even when you release updates frequently.

Web developers need to test across browsers and platforms.VMs help you run Windows environments with Chrome,Firefox,and Edge,Linux environments for additional coverage,and Mac OS environments on Mac hardware for Safari testing.

Mobile testing often uses emulators and simulators that behave like VMs,letting you test apps without owning dozens of devices.

Cloud services also provide hosted environments to test combinations instantly.

VMs improve collaboration because teams can share templates.

Instead of every developer building their own setup differently,you create a VM template with the right tools and dependencies and distribute it.

Everyone works in the same environment,bugs reproduce reliably,and onboarding becomes faster because new team members can import the VM and start working quickly.

A strong VM strategy is built on templates.

Maintain base templates for each OS you support,keep them patched quarterly,then create role-based templates like web development,QA testing,and database development.

When you need a new environment,you clone the template instead of rebuilding from scratch.

Good templates save huge amounts of time and keep testing consistent.

Awesome!

You now understand how VMs support test development by enabling fast environment creation,parallel testing,consistent setups,snapshots,automation,and full stack simulation.

Snapshots and templates are your secret weapons for speed and stability.

180. 应用虚拟化

大家好，现在我们将转向应用程序虚拟化。

这是一种不同风格的虚拟化，专注于单个应用程序而不是整个操作系统。使用虚拟机，您虚拟化的是整台计算机。

使用应用程序虚拟化，您将一个应用程序及其依赖项打包成一个自包含的单元，以便它可以在兼容的操作系统上运行，而无需传统安装。

这有助于防止应用程序冲突，简化部署，甚至可以实现应用程序的按需流式传输。

传统的应用程序安装可能会很混乱。

应用程序将文件分散在系统中，修改注册表，安装共享库，有时还会与其他应用程序发生冲突。

这就是经典的动态链接库地狱的来源。

您安装了应用程序A和应用程序B，突然其中一个崩溃了，因为它们需要同一依赖项的不同版本。

应用程序虚拟化隔离了应用程序，使它们不会相互干扰，同时也使卸载更干净，因为您不会留下遗留文件和注册表项的痕迹。

应用程序虚拟化的工作原理是拦截系统调用，如文件访问和注册表访问，并将它们重定向到虚拟应用程序环境中。

应用程序的表现就像正常安装了一样，但虚拟化层将其文件和设置保持分离。

每个虚拟化应用程序都在自己的气泡中运行，因此多个应用程序可以并行运行而不会发生冲突，甚至同一应用程序的多个版本有时也可以在同一台机器上运行。

Microsoft App-V是一个知名的企业应用程序虚拟化解决方案。

它对应用程序进行打包，以便可以通过集中管理工具以受控方式交付给用户。

用户启动应用程序时，包会被流式传输或交付到端点，同时与操作系统保持隔离。

对于拥有大量应用程序和大量用户的大型组织，像App-V这样的工具可以简化部署，并减少应用程序冲突和混乱安装带来的痛苦。

VMware ThinApp是另一种流行的方法。

ThinApp可以将应用程序打包成可移植的可执行文件，因此它可以在没有传统安装的情况下运行，通常也不需要管理员权限。

这在锁定环境中非常有用，因为用户无法安装软件，而且对于那些在现代系统上表现不佳的旧版应用程序也很有用，因为打包后的应用程序携带了其依赖项。

应用程序虚拟化的一个巨大好处是流式传输。

用户无需在每台计算机上安装每个应用程序，而是可以启动应用程序并按需接收所需内容。

启动组件首先到达，因此应用程序可以快速打开，而其他部分则在后台流式传输。

这可以减少存储使用量，减少新用户的部署时间，并防止带宽浪费，因为只有actively使用的应用程序才会消耗资源。

应用程序虚拟化提供了几个实际好处。

更少的软件冲突、更简单的部署、更容易的更新，有时还能提供更强的安全性，因为应用程序与底层操作系统更加隔离。

它还可以支持多版本共存，这对于测试非常棒。

在大型环境中，与在数千台机器上排查一次性安装的故障相比，集中打包和管理应用程序可以节省大量支持时间。

一个强有力的用例是旧版应用程序支持。

如果旧应用程序在现代操作系统上崩溃，应用程序虚拟化有时可以将该应用程序与旧版依赖项一起打包，使其仍能运行。

这避免了为单个旧版应用程序维护完整的虚拟机，并且可以为组织争取时间，以便他们规划该软件的迁移或替换。

当您需要一个程序的多个版本时，应用程序虚拟化在测试中也很有用。

您可以分别打包应用程序的版本一、版本二和版本三，并在同一台机器上运行它们，而无需使用多个虚拟机。

这使得兼容性测试更快，并减少了当每个版本都需要自己完整的虚拟机时发生的测试实验室蔓延。

在轮班制和热桌场景下，应用程序虚拟化可以帮助交付企业应用程序，而无需将它们永久安装在设备上。

用户可以访问应用程序、工作，然后可以干净地移除应用程序。

这可以减少公司未完全控制的设备上的数据持久性，并支持用户在系统之间移动的灵活工作环境。应用程序虚拟化并非完美无缺。

有些应用程序虚拟化效果不佳，特别是那些使用内核级驱动程序、深度操作系统集成、硬件依赖性或严格复制保护的应用程序。

也可能存在一些性能开销，通常在百分之五到百分之十左右，而且打包可能很复杂并需要专业知识。

许可也很重要。

某些软件许可证限制虚拟化，因此组织必须在部署前核实条款。

以下是宏观比较：虚拟机虚拟化整个操作系统并提供最强的隔离，但使用更多资源。

应用程序虚拟化在共享操作系统上隔离单个应用程序，对于应用程序部署场景来说可能更轻量且更容易。

容器以更轻量级的方式虚拟化应用程序，通常用于服务器端和云原生工作负载。

正确的选择取决于您的需求：是完全的操作系统灵活性、应用程序级别的隔离，还是轻量级的可扩展部署。

做得很好。

您现在了解了应用程序虚拟化，它是如何隔离应用程序的，为什么它有助于解决冲突和部署，以及像App-V和ThinApp这样的工具适合在哪里使用。

它是虚拟机的强大补充，特别是当您想要应用程序级别的隔离而不运行完整的客户操作系统时。

接下来，我们将更深入地探讨旧版软件和操作系统支持策略，以便您在现代化的同时安全地保持旧的关键业务工具运行。

英文原文

Hey everyone,now we are shifting to application virtualization.

A different flavor of virtualization that focuses on individual applications instead of entire operating systems.With VMs,you virtualize a whole computer.

With application virtualization,you package one app and its dependencies into a self-contained unit so it can run on a compatible OS without a traditional installation.

This helps prevent app conflicts,simplifies deployment,and can even enable apps to stream on demand.

Traditional app installation can be messy.

Applications scatter files across the system,modify the registry,install shared libraries,and sometimes conflict with other apps.

That's where classic DLL hell comes from.

You install app A and app B and suddenly one breaks because they needed different versions of the same dependency.

Application virtualization isolates apps so they don't step on each other's toes and it also makes removal cleaner because you're not leaving behind a trail of leftover files and registry entries.

Application virtualization works by intercepting system calls like file access and registry access and redirecting them into a virtual app environment.

The app behaves like it's installed normally but the virtualization layer keeps its files and settings separate.

Each virtualized app runs in its own bubble so multiple apps can run side by side without conflicts and even multiple versions of the same app can sometimes run on the same machine.

Microsoft AppFee is a well-known enterprise application virtualization solution.

It packages applications so they can be delivered to users in a controlled way often through centralized management tools.

Users launch the app and the package is streamed or delivered to the endpoint while remaining isolated from the OS.

For large organizations with lots of apps and lots of users,tools like AppFee can simplify deployment and reduce the pain of app conflicts and messy installations.

VMware ThinApp is another popular approach.

ThinApp can package an app into a portable executable so it can run without a traditional installation,often without requiring admin rights.

That's useful in lockdown environments where users can't install software and it's also useful for legacy apps that don't behave well on modern systems because the packaged app carries its dependencies with it.

A big benefit of application virtualization is streaming.

Instead of installing every app on every computer,users can launch apps and receive what they need on demand.

Startup components arrive first so the app opens quickly and additional pieces stream in the background.

This can reduce storage usage,reduce deployment time for new users and prevent wasted bandwidth because only actively used apps consume resources.

Application virtualization provides several practical benefits.

Fewer software conflicts,simpler deployment,easier updates,and sometimes stronger security because apps are more isolated from the underlying OS.

It can also support multi-version coexistence,which is great for testing.

In large environments,packaging and managing apps centrally can save a lot of support time compared to troubleshooting one-off installations on thousands of machines.

One strong use case is legacy app support.

If an old app breaks on a modern OS,application virtualization can sometimes package the app along with older dependencies so it still runs.

This avoids maintaining full VMs for a single legacy application,and it can buy organizations'time while they plan a migration or replacement for that software.

Application virtualization is also useful in testing when you need multiple versions of one program.

Instead of using multiple VMs,you can package version 1,version 2,and version 3 of the app separately and run them on the same machine.

That makes compatibility testing faster and reduces the test lab sprawl that happens when every version needs its own full VM.

In bioed and hot desking scenarios,application virtualization can help deliver corporate apps without permanently installing them on the device.

Users can access the app,work,and then the app can be removed cleanly.

This can reduce data persistence on devices that the company doesn't fully control,and it supports flexible work environments where users move between systems.Application virtualization isn't perfect.

Some apps don't virtualize well,especially apps that use kernel-level drivers,deep OS integration,hardware dependencies,or strict copy protection.

There can also be some performance overhead,often around 5-10%,and packaging can be complex and require expertise.

Licensing matters too.

Some software licenses restrict virtualization,so organizations must verify terms before deployment.

Here's the big picture comparison:VMs virtualize entire operating systems and give the strongest isolation,but use more resources.

Application virtualization isolates individual apps on a shared OS which can be lighter and easier for app deployment scenarios.

Containers virtualize applications in an even more lightweight way,typically for server-side and cloud-native workloads.

The right choice depends on what you need,full OS flexibility,app-level isolation,or lightweight scalable deployments.

Excellent work.

You now understand application virtualization,how it isolates apps,why it helps with conflicts and deployment,and where tools like App V and ThinApp fit.

It's a powerful complement to VMs,especially when you want app-level isolation without running a full guest OS.

181. 遗留软件与操作系统支持

大家好，今天我们来聊聊遗留软件和操作系统支持，基本上就是让那些为十到二十年前的操作系统构建的老式应用继续运行。

在现实世界中，企业始终依赖着老式应用，而你在IT部门的工作就是让它们保持功能正常，同时无需维持一整个由旧电脑组成的“博物馆”。

核心思路是，我们首先尝试最简单的兼容性修复，如果失败，我们就利用虚拟化保留旧环境，以便应用能够安全地继续工作。

遗留软件不仅仅是老旧。

它是那些至关重要、替换成本高昂或与特定操作系统版本紧密绑定的软件。

它可能是某个行业的专用工具、定制的内部应用，或者是公司多年前斥巨资购买的许可软件。

问题在于，现代操作系统的更新改变了安全性、驱动程序和系统库的工作方式，这些变化可能会破坏老式应用，即使硬件本身没有问题。

因此，遗留支持实际上是关于同时管理兼容性和风险。

遗留应用通常失败，是因为现代操作系统的行为方式与老式应用的预期不符。

有些应用需要管理员级别的访问权限，但现代系统对此进行了严格限制。

有些应用依赖于不再存在的旧版驱动程序。

有些安装程序过于陈旧，无法在新版Windows上正常运行。

而在更棘手的情况下，应用依赖于根本不再受支持的旧组件。

因此，即使你强制安装，操作系统也无法提供软件所需的内容。

在构建任何复杂方案之前，你先尝试兼容模式。

兼容模式是一项内置功能，它改变了操作系统向应用程序呈现自身的方式。

让应用以为它正在运行在旧版本的Windows上。

实际上，这是一个低投入、高回报的步骤。

你通常只需更改兼容性设置并以正确的权限运行程序，就能修复老式应用。

从故障排除的角度来看，这是在转向更大解决方案之前要拨动的第一个开关。

许多遗留应用编写于用户默认以管理员身份运行的时代。

现代操作系统围绕最小权限原则设计，因此那些试图写入受保护位置或修改系统设置的应用可能会失败。

一种常见的变通方法是以管理员身份运行应用。

但你也要将其视为一项安全决策，而不仅仅是一种便利。

如果一个应用始终需要提升的权限，那是一个危险信号，你应该考虑利用虚拟化将其隔离。

如果兼容性设置无法解决问题，通常是因为应用需要的不仅仅是兼容性垫片，比如特定的驱动程序、旧版运行时或已不存在的操作系统行为。

此时，与其与现代操作系统对抗，不如保留软件所期望的旧环境。

这就是虚拟化成为主要工具的地方，因为它让你能够在完整的旧操作系统内运行应用，而无需旧的物理硬件。

虚拟XP模式是微软的方法，旨在较新的宿主操作系统中，于虚拟化的XP环境内运行旧的Windows XP应用。

关键概念不仅仅在于存在一台虚拟机，而在于用户体验几乎可以无缝衔接。

人们可以继续使用XP时代的应用，而无需为此专门配备一台独立的电脑。

即使具体的产品名称如今不再使用，但“虚拟化遗留操作系统以维持应用运行”这一策略仍然是标准的IT方法。

在现代环境中，你通常会构建一台运行应用所需遗留操作系统（如Windows XP或Windows 7）的虚拟机，然后在该虚拟机内安装应用。

这保留了兼容性，因为应用正是在其设计运行的环境中运行。

对IT而言，好处在于你可以像操作文件一样对虚拟机进行快照、备份和迁移，而无需努力维护那些难以保障安全且难以更换的老化物理机器。

这里有一个权衡：运行旧操作系统可能存在风险，因为旧操作系统无法获得现代安全更新。

这意味着如果你的技术解决方案处理不当，可能会变成安全问题。

因此，正确的思维模式是：如果我们必须运行遗留操作系统软件，我们就将其隔离。

通过控制该虚拟机的访问范围，并限制其暴露于互联网和生产网络，从而保护环境的其余部分。

一种良好的支持方法是将遗留虚拟机视为受控实验室系统。

你保持网络连接最小化，仅限制访问其所需内容，并避免将其用于电子邮件、网页浏览或一般用户活动。

你还要保留备份或快照，以便在出现问题时快速回滚。

并且你要记录配置，因为除非写下来，否则遗留支持往往会变成只有内部人员才懂的“部落知识”。

因此，你的工作流程如下。

首先，尝试兼容模式和权限调整。

如果应用仍然无法运行，尝试通过虚拟化在保留的操作系统环境中运行它。

如果虚拟化可行但安全风险过高或维护负担过重，那么你就开始规划替换或迁移。

目标始终如一。

在确保业务今日正常运转的同时，建立更安全的长期解决方案。

这就是遗留软件和操作系统支持。

请记住，当旧应用是为十到二十年前的操作系统设计时，最实用的解决方案是先尝试兼容模式，如果失败则使用虚拟化。

虚拟XP模式是“在虚拟机中运行旧操作系统”这一策略的经典案例，同样的理念今天依然适用。

接下来，我们将进阶到跨平台虚拟化，即在同一硬件上运行不同的操作系统，以便你可以在Windows、Mac OS和Linux之间协同工作。
