230. 坏点

坏点是显示器上呈现为微小黑点或明亮彩色小点的单个像素缺陷。

它们在新显示器上最为明显，因为用户期望面板完美无缺，而即使只有一个缺陷，根据其位置也可能令人分心。

故障排除的目标是确认问题是真正的坏点还是卡住的像素，然后决定尝试修复是否合理，或是应该通过退货或保修政策来处理这种情况。

显示器上的每个像素都由发出红、绿和蓝光的子像素组成。

坏点通常完全关闭，呈现为黑色，因为像素或其控制晶体管未工作。

卡住的像素通常卡在一种颜色上，如红色、绿色、蓝色或白色，因为某个子像素保持开启状态。

这种区别很重要，因为卡住的像素有时可以改善，而坏点通常是永久性的硬件缺陷。

在正常使用过程中，坏点可能难以察觉，因为它们会融入复杂的内容中。

最有效的测试方法是显示纯色背景并仔细检查屏幕。

纯白屏幕有助于坏点作为黑点凸显出来，而纯黑屏幕有助于卡住的像素作为亮点凸显出来。

纯红、纯绿和纯蓝屏幕有助于识别哪个子像素可能卡住，并确认缺陷在不同颜色下是否一致。

坏点在所有背景下都保持黑色且不发生变化，这强烈表明是永久性硬件故障。

卡住的像素倾向于保持一种颜色点亮或呈现为亮点，并且在较暗的背景下可能更为明显。

这是因为卡住的像素有时涉及子像素卡住而非完全失效。

它们是唯一一类尝试修复可能合理的缺陷。

卡住像素的恢复尝试通常使用针对受影响区域的快速颜色循环，以促使子像素恢复正常行为。

这通常通过运行像素修复程序大约十到三十分钟来完成，然后重新检查相同的测试屏幕。

现实的预期成功率是：一些卡住的像素会改善，一些不会，且重复尝试的效果可能会递减。

不应指望坏点对这些技术产生反应。

大多数制造商定义了可接受的缺陷阈值，这意味着少量像素缺陷可能不符合标准保修下的更换条件。

具体阈值因品牌和产品线而异，通常取决于缺陷是坏点还是卡住的像素，以及它们是否聚集。

由于政策各异，当像素完美度是首要考虑因素时，在购买前审查显示器的保修条款非常重要。

如果在购买后立即发现缺陷，最简单的解决方案通常是在零售商退货窗口期内进行换货，根据卖家不同，这通常是两周到一个月。

过了退货窗口期后，保修服务通常需要返厂授权流程，您需要提供购买凭证、序列号和缺陷证据。

最佳操作实践是尽早测试新显示器，以便在发现缺陷时能够采用最快的解决途径。

像素缺陷可能难以拍摄，因此文档记录需要刻意而为。

使用使缺陷具有高对比度的纯色背景屏幕，然后使用特写摄影和稳定对焦来捕捉该点。

此外，记录缺陷的大致位置，例如左上象限或靠近中心，因为位置会影响可用性，并可能影响支持案例中的处理严重程度。

并非所有像素缺陷都具有相同的实际影响。

边缘附近的一两个缺陷在正常工作中可能几乎注意不到，而中心附近的缺陷则会令人分心并降低可用性。

决定退货、保修还是接受缺陷，应基于位置、注意到它的频率以及更换所涉及的成本和停机时间。

坏点表现为持久的黑点，通常是永久性硬件缺陷，而卡住的像素表现为明亮的彩色点，有时可以通过有针对性的颜色循环尝试得到改善。

使用纯色测试来确认类型，清晰地记录缺陷，并应用最高效的解决途径。

在有条件的情况下通过退货窗口换货，或在需要时进行保修服务。

下个主题再见，我们将讨论闪烁屏幕，即图像存在但由于刷新率、驱动程序、自适应同步或连接不稳定而出现闪烁或频闪的情况。

英文原文

Dead pixels are individual pixel defects that appear as tiny black dots or small bright colored points on a display.

They are most noticeable on new monitors because users expect a perfect panel and even one defect can be distracting depending on location.

The goal in troubleshooting is to confirm whether the issue is a truly dead pixel or a stuck pixel,then decide whether a fix attempt is reasonable or whether the situation should be handled through return or warranty policy.

Each pixel on a display is made of subpixels that produce red,green and blue light.

A dead pixel is typically fully off,appearing black,because the pixel or its control transistor is not functioning.

A stuck pixel is usually stuck on one color such as red,green,blue,or white,because a subpixel remains on.

This distinction matters because stuck pixels can sometimes be improved,while dead pixels are usually permanent hardware defects.

Dead pixels can be difficult to notice during normal usage because they blend into complex content.

The most effective way to test is to display solid color backgrounds and inspect the screen closely.

A pure white screen helps dead pixels stand out as black dots,while a pure black screen helps stuck pixels stand out as bright points.

Solid red,green,and blue screens help identify which subpixel may be stuck and confirm whether the defect is consistent across colors.

A dead pixel remains black on all backgrounds and does not change,which strongly suggests a permanent hardware failure.

A stuck pixel tends to remain lit in one color or appears as a bright point and it may be more noticeable on darker backgrounds.

Because stuck pixels sometimes involve a subpixel sticking rather than complete failure.

They are the only category where a fix attempt may be reasonable.

Stuck pixel recovery attempts typically use rapid color cycling targeted at the affected area to encourage the subpixel to return to normal behavior.

This is commonly done by running a pixel fix routine for roughly 10 to 30 minutes and then rechecking the same test screens.

A realistic success expectation is that some stuck pixels improve,some do not,and repeated attempts may have diminishing returns.

Dead pixels should not be expected to respond to these techniques.

Most manufacturers define an acceptable defect threshold,meaning a small number of pixel defects may not qualify for replacement under standard warranty.

The specific threshold varies by brand and product line and it often depends on whether defects are dead or stuck and whether they are clustered.

Because policies vary,it is important to review the display's warranty terms before purchase when pixel perfection is a priority.

If a defect is discovered immediately after purchase,The simplest resolution is often an exchange within the retailer return window,which is commonly around two weeks to one month,depending on the seller.

After the return window,warranty service typically requires an RMA process where you provide proof of purchase,the serial number,and evidence of the defect.

The operational best practice is to test new monitors early so you can use the fastest resolution path if defects are found.

Pixel defects can be difficult to photograph,so documentation should be deliberate.

Use a solid background screen that makes the defect high contrast,then use close-up photography and steady focus to capture the dot.

Also,record the defect's approximate location,such as upper left quadrant or near the center,since location affects usability and may affect how seriously it is treated during a support case.

Not all pixel defects have the same real-world impact.

One or two defects near the edge may be barely noticeable during normal work,while a defect near the center can be distracting and reduce usability.

The decision to return,warranty,or accept the defect should be based on location,frequency of noticing it,and the cost and downtime involved in replacement.

Dead pixels appear as persistent black dots and are typically permanent hardware defects,while stuck pixels appear as bright coloured dots and may sometimes improve with targeted color cycling attempts.

Use solid color tests to confirm the type,document the defect clearly and apply the most efficient resolution path.

Return window exchange when available or warranty service if needed.

Cat you in the next topic,flashing screens,where the image is present but flickers or strobes due to refresh rate,drivers,adaptive sync or connection instability.

231. 屏幕闪烁

屏幕闪烁或闪动是一种症状，表现为显示器快速条纹化、眨眼或明显脉动，通常会导致眼睛疲劳并使系统难以使用。

在故障排除中，这通常指向一小部分可能的原因：不兼容的刷新率设置、不稳定或损坏的显卡驱动程序、自适应同步行为或不稳定的物理连接。

正确的方法是先进行配置检查，然后处理驱动程序，最后验证线缆和硬件。

闪烁的一个常见原因是刷新率设置不正确。

显示器支持特定的刷新率，例如六十赫兹、七十五赫兹、一百二十赫兹或一百四十四赫兹。

如果操作系统设置的刷新率是显示器无法正确处理的，结果可能会出现可见的闪烁或图像不稳定。

纠正措施是测试支持的选项并确认稳定性，如果您需要快速稳定步骤，六十赫兹是许多显示器的安全基线。

即使显示器额定支持更高的刷新率，完整的刷新率可能取决于使用正确的端口和线缆类型。

有些显示器仅在特定输入上支持其最高刷新率，而有些线缆可能无法在更高分辨率下可靠地传输高刷新率信号。

如果仅在启用更高刷新率时出现闪烁，在假设显示器本身有缺陷之前，请验证您是否使用了推荐的输入类型和已知良好的线缆。

闪烁也可能是由驱动程序不稳定或缺陷引起的。

最佳实践是使用图形处理器制造商的官方驱动程序更新流程来更新显卡驱动程序，然后重新启动。

如果闪烁是在驱动程序更新后立即开始的，回滚到之前的驱动程序版本可以作为一个有效的确认步骤。

当闪烁仅出现在某些应用程序中、视频播放期间或系统更改电源状态时，驱动程序问题的可能性尤其大。

自适应同步功能，如Free Sync和G-Sync，可能会导致某些显示器型号出现闪烁，特别是在帧率降至低范围时。

一种常见的模式是闪烁主要出现在游戏或图形处理器密集型工作负载中，而不是在桌面上。

如果闪烁与低帧率相关，请禁用自适应同步作为测试，或调整设置以保持帧率高于闪烁区域。

目标是确定自适应同步行为是否是触发因素，而不是一般的硬件故障。

间歇性连接可能会产生看起来像设置问题的闪烁。

确认线缆两端都已完全插入，然后用另一根已知良好的线缆进行测试。

如果有多个端口可用，还要在图形处理器上测试不同的输出端口。

如果更换线缆或端口消除了问题，您就已经隔离了物理层原因，这通常比更换显示器或图形处理器更快且更便宜。

一些显示器包含旨在减少运动模糊的响应时间或过驱动设置。

如果设置得过于激进，这些设置可能会引入伪影，例如类似闪烁的行为、反向重影或运动过程中的亮度不稳定。

一个实用的测试是将过驱动设置为中等水平或禁用它，然后重新检查稳定性。

如果闪烁有所改善，则问题是配置相关的，而不是面板缺陷。

在某些环境中，闪烁可能与电源质量或电气干扰有关。

在不同的插座或电源排插上测试显示器有助于隔离嘈杂的电源。

对于通过适配器或扩展坞连接的显示器，测试直接连接也有帮助。

虽然现代数字显示器的电气干扰比旧式模拟标准少见，但在某些设置中仍可能导致不稳定行为。

为了确定问题是出在计算机还是显示器上，请用另一台设备测试该显示器，或用另一台显示器测试该计算机。

如果闪烁随显示器转移，请怀疑显示器设置、线缆或显示器硬件。

如果闪烁在多台显示器上随计算机转移，请怀疑图形处理器驱动程序、图形处理器硬件或系统的输出配置。

隔离可防止反复猜测。

屏幕闪烁和闪动最常见的原因是刷新率不匹配、显卡驱动程序问题、自适应同步行为或不稳定的线缆和端口连接。

首先设置稳定的刷新率，然后确认驱动程序健康状况，测试自适应同步设置，并用已知良好的替换件验证线缆和端口。

祝您在下一个主题“颜色显示不正确”中一切顺利，在该主题中图像稳定但由于线缆、配置或驱动程序设置导致颜色准确性错误。

英文原文

A flashing or flickering screen is a symptom where the display rapidly strokes,blinks or visibly pulses,often causing eye strain and making the system difficult to use.

In troubleshooting,this typically points to a small set of likely causes,an incompatible refresh rate setting,unstable or corrupted graphics drivers,adaptive sync behavior or an unstable physical connection.

The correct approach is to start with configuration checks,then move to drivers and finally validate cabling and hardware.

A common cause of flicker is an incorrect refresh rate setting.

Displays support specific refresh rates such as 60 Hz,75 Hz,120 Hz or 144 Hz.

If the operating system is set to a refresh rate the monitor does not handle correctly,the result can be visible flicker or an unstable image.

The corrective action is to test supported options and confirm stability,with 60 Hz being a safe baseline for many displays if you need a quick stabilization step.

Even when a monitor is rated for a higher refresh rate,the full refresh rate may depend on using the correct port and cable type.

Some monitors only support their highest refresh rate on specific inputs and some cables may not reliably carry high refresh signals at higher resolutions.

If flicker appears only when you enable a higher refresh rate,validate you are using the recommended input type and a known good cable before assuming the monitor itself is defective.

Flicker can also be caused by driver instability or bugs.

The best practice is to update graphics drivers using the GPU manufacturer's official driver update process and then reboot.

If the flicker started immediately after a driver update,rolling back to the previous driver version can be an effective confirmation step.

Driver issues are especially likely when the flicker appears only in certain applications during video playback or when the system changes power states.

Adaptive sync features such as free sync and g-sync can cause flicker on some monitor models,especially when frame rates drop into low ranges.

A common pattern is flicker that appears mainly in games or GPU heavy workloads rather than on the desktop.

If the flicker correlates with low frame rates,disable adaptive sync as a test or adjust settings to keep frame rates above the flicker zone.

The goal is to determine whether adaptive sync behavior is the trigger rather than a general hardware failure.

Intermittent connections can create flicker that looks like a settings problem.

Confirm both ends of the cable are fully seated,then test with a different known good cable.

Also test a different output port on the GPU if multiple ports are available.

If changing a cable or port eliminates the issue,you have isolated a physical layer cause,which is typically faster and cheaper to fix than replacing a monitor or GPU.

Some monitors include response time or overdrive settings intended to reduce motion blur.

If set too aggressively,these settings can introduce artifacts such as flicker-like behavior,inverse ghosting or unstable brightness during motion.

A practical test is to set overdrive to a medium level or disable it and then recheck stability.

If the flicker improves the issue is configuration related rather than a defective panel.

In some environments flicker can be linked to power quality or electrical interference.

Testing the monitor on a different outlet or power strip can help isolate a noisy power source.

For displays connected through adapters or docking stations,testing direct connection can also help.

While electrical interference is less common with modern digital displays than it was with older analog standards,it can still contribute to unstable behavior in certain setups.

To determine whether the issue is the computer or the display,test the monitor with another device or test the computer with a different monitor.

If the flicker follows the monitor,suspect monitor settings,the cable or the display hardware.

If the flicker follows the computer across multiple displays,suspect the GPU drivers,GPU hardware or the system's output configuration.

Isolation prevents repeated guesswork.

Flashing and flickering screens are most commonly caused by refresh rate mismatches,graphics driver problems,adaptive sync behavior or unstable cabling and port connections.

Start by setting a stable refresh rate,then confirm driver health,test adaptive sync settings and validate cables and ports with known good swaps.

Cat you in the next topic,incorrect color display,where the image is stable but color accuracy is wrong due to cabling,configuration or driver settings.

232. 颜色显示不正确

颜色显示异常问题包括出现不寻常的色调、缺失颜色通道或整体色彩偏移，导致肤色看起来不自然且整个屏幕显示异常。

这会影响可用性，对于涉及设计、摄影或视频工作的角色来说尤为关键。

故障排除的目标是确定问题源于线缆和信号类型、物理连接质量、显卡驱动程序行为还是显示器配置。

线缆类型对色彩稳定性至关重要。

VGA是一种模拟标准，更容易出现信号衰减和色彩偏移，尤其是在使用较长线缆或较高分辨率时。

HDMI、DisplayPort和DVI-D等数字标准以数字方式传输像素数据，在正常工作状态下通常能提供一致的色彩。

如果用户正在使用VGA并报告持续的色彩不准确，迁移到数字连接通常是最有效的纠正措施。

即使是数字线缆也可能发生故障，当它们出现故障时，色彩问题可能表现为奇怪的色调、闪烁或缺失通道，使屏幕看起来严重偏粉、偏绿或偏蓝。

如果颜色突然发生变化，应将线缆作为首要怀疑对象。

最快的确认步骤是换上一根已知良好的线缆并重新测试。

如果问题消失，则说明线缆是原因所在。

连接松动会导致间歇性色彩问题，因为某些引脚或触点可能无法可靠连接。

这在带有螺丝的连接器上尤为常见，线缆可能已插入但未完全固定。

重新插拔两端的线缆，并在适用的情况下拧紧任何固定螺丝。

如果重新插拔后立即恢复正确色彩，则问题是接触不稳定，而非驱动程序或显示器缺陷。

驱动程序问题或不正确的显卡输出设置可能导致色彩错误。

使用制造商的官方驱动程序包更新图形驱动程序并重新启动。

如果问题是在更新后开始的，请回退到之前的驱动程序版本作为确认步骤。

还要检查显卡控制面板中的输出色彩格式和范围设置，因为不正确的输出范围设置会导致黑色发白或阴影过暗。

显示器通常包含图像预设，如电影、游戏、鲜艳或sRGB，这些预设会显著改变感知色彩。

色温设置也会使图像偏向冷色调或暖色调。

一般准确性的常用参考点是约六千五百开尔文的色温，以及在可用时选择面向sRGB的预设。

如果颜色看起来不正确，请将显示器的图像和色彩设置重置为默认值，然后在进行更深入的校准工作之前重新检查。

操作系统提供基本校准工具，指导用户调整伽马值、亮度、对比度和色彩平衡。

当显示器没有严重缺陷但日常使用看起来明显异常时，这可能很有用。

虽然内置工具不能替代专业校准硬件，但它们可以纠正常见的配置错误，并提高典型办公和培训环境中的一致性。

色彩配置文件告诉应用程序如何解释和显示颜色。

如果分配了错误的配置文件，即使硬件功能正常，显示效果也可能持续异常。

验证是否选择了合理的默认配置文件，并删除可能由旧驱动程序或校准软件安装的不寻常或不正确的配置文件。

当只有某些应用程序显示颜色不正确时，此步骤尤为重要。

对于专业的色彩关键型工作，软件校准是有限的，因为它依赖于人类感知和手动调整。

硬件色度计测量实际的屏幕输出，并为显示器构建自定义配置文件。

这最适合于设计、摄影和印刷工作流程，因为这些场景需要在设备和输出介质之间进行准确的色彩匹配。

对于一般办公用途，简单的校准和正确的预设通常就足够了。

颜色显示错误问题最常见的原因包括模拟线缆、损坏或松动的数字线缆、不正确的显示器预设，或显卡驱动程序及输出配置问题。

首先验证线缆类型和连接质量，然后重置显示器设置，更新或回退驱动程序，并验证色彩配置文件。

下一个主题：显示器音频问题，重点关注HDMI和DisplayPort音频路由、显示器扬声器能力以及操作系统输出设备选择。

英文原文

Incorrect color display problems include unusual tints,missing color channels or overall color shifts where skin tones look unnatural and the entire screen appears off.

This can affect usability and can be critical for roles involving design,photography or video work.

The troubleshooting objective is to identify whether the issue originates from cabling and signal type,physical connection quality,GPU driver behavior or monitor configuration.

Cable type matters for color stability.

VGA is an analog standard and is more prone to signal degradation and color shifts,especially with longer cables or higher resolutions.

Digital standards such as HDMI,DisplayPort and DVID transmit pixel data digitally and generally provide consistent color when functioning correctly.

If a user is using VGA and reporting persistent color inaccuracies,migrating to a digital connection is often the most effective corrective action.

Even digital cables can fail and when they do,color problems can appear as strange tints,sparkles or missing channels that make the screen look heavily pink,green or blue.

If colors change suddenly,treat the cable as a primary suspect.

The fastest confirmation step is swapping in a known good cable and retesting.

If the problem disappears,the cable was the cause.

Loose connections can cause intermittent color issues because certain pins or contacts may not connect reliably.

This is especially common with connectors that use screws where a cable may be inserted but not fully secured.

Reseat the cable at both ends and tighten any retention screws where applicable.

If reseating restores correct color instantly,the issue was contact instability rather than a driver or monitor defect.

Driver problems or incorrect GPU output settings can produce incorrect colors.

Update the graphics driver using the manufacturer's official driver package and reboot.

If the issue began after an update,roll back to the previous driver version as a confirmation step.

Also check GPU control panel settings for output color format and range since incorrect output range settings can cause washed out blacks or overly dark shadows.

Monitors often include picture presets such as movie,game,vivid or sRGB and these presets can dramatically change perceived color.

Color temperature settings can also shift the image toward cooler or warmer tones.

A common reference point for general accuracy is a color temperature around 6500 Kelvin and an sRGB oriented preset when available.

If colors look incorrect,reset the monitor's picture and color settings to defaults and then recheck before doing deeper calibration work.

Operating systems provide basic calibration tools that guide users through adjusting gamma,brightness,contrast,and color balance.

This can be useful when a display is not grossly defective but looks noticeably off for daily use.

While built-in tools are not a substitute for professional calibration hardware,they can correct common misconfigurations and improve consistency across typical office and training environments.

Color profiles tell applications how to interpret and display colors.

If the wrong profile is assigned,the display may look consistently wrong even though the hardware is functioning correctly.

Verify that a reasonable default profile is selected and remove unusual or incorrect profiles that may have been installed by older drivers or calibration software.

This step is especially important when only certain applications display incorrect colors.

For professional color critical work,software calibration is limited because it relies on human perception and manual adjustment.

A hardware colorimeter measures actual screen output and builds a custom profile for the monitor.

This is most appropriate for design,photography and print workflows where accurate color matching is required across devices and output media.

For general office use,simpler calibration and correct presets are typically sufficient.

Incorrect color display issues are most often caused by analog cabling,damaged or loose digital cables,incorrect monitor presets or GPU driver and output configuration problems.

Start by verifying cable type and connection quality,then reset monitor settings,update or rollback drivers and validate color profiles.

Next topic:audio issues with displays focusing on HDMI and display port audio routing,monitor speaker capability and operating system output device selection.

233. 显示器音频问题

HDMI和DisplayPort可以同时传输视频和音频，但经常出现视频正常而音频无法通过显示器或电视播放的情况。

在大多数情况下，根本原因是配置问题而非硬件故障。

故障排除的目标是确认显示器具备音频输出能力，然后确认操作系统正在将音频路由到正确的设备，最后验证驱动程序和设备状态。

并非所有显示器都内置扬声器，有些显示器的HDMI输入仅用于视频。

如果显示器没有扬声器，即使计算机成功发送音频，也不会产生声音。

确认显示器是否内置扬声器或拥有音频输出接口，并确认显示器设置中是否已启用扬声器。

此步骤可避免在没有音频输出硬件的情况下浪费时间在软件故障排除上。

如果显示器或电视支持音频，下一步是将其选为活动输出设备。

操作系统通常会保留上次使用的音频设备，或在连接和断开设备时自动切换。

选择与显示器关联的HDMI或DisplayPort音频输出，然后使用已知的音频源进行测试。

许多无声事件仅仅是因为音频被发送到了内部扬声器、耳机或已断开的设备。

包含扬声器的显示器通常拥有自己的音量和静音设置，可通过屏幕显示菜单进行控制。

验证显示器未处于静音状态，且音量设置在可用水平。

这一点经常被忽视，因为用户误以为计算机的音量控制是唯一重要的控制项。

HDMI和DisplayPort音频通常依赖于显卡驱动程序的音频组件。

如果这些组件缺失或损坏，显示器可能不会显示为音频设备，或者无法正常工作。

更新显卡驱动程序包是标准的纠正步骤。

安装后，确认系统检测到HDMI或DisplayPort音频设备，并且该设备可选。

操作系统可能会将HDMI音频设备标记为禁用，尤其是在驱动程序更改或反复连接事件之后。

检查播放设备，显示禁用的设备，如果显示音频设备存在但处于非活动状态，请启用它。

启用后，将其设置为默认输出以进行测试，然后确认声音输出。

USB-C扩展坞和适配器会影响音频路由，尤其是当它们向操作系统呈现多个音频设备时。

如果通过扩展坞传输音频失败，请尝试直接从计算机连接到显示器或电视进行测试。

如果直接连接有效，则扩展坞或适配器可能是故障域。

在受管理的环境中，标准化可靠的扩展坞并维护备件可减少重复发生的事件。

如果显示器缺乏扬声器，但仍希望从同一HDMI源获取音频，可以使用HDMI音频提取器将音频分离到外部扬声器，同时将视频传输到显示器。

这对于培训室和会议设置是一个实用的解决方案，在这些场景中，显示器用于视频，但需要通过外部扬声器播放声音。

更改后，使用简单的音频测试进行验证，例如系统声音测试或已知的媒体片段。

如果适用，确认左声道和右声道均能正常工作，并确认音量稳定。

在每次更改后立即测试有助于确定哪一步骤解决了问题。

大多数显示器音频问题是由显示器缺乏扬声器、操作系统将音频路由到错误的输出设备、显示器音频被静音或缺失显卡驱动程序音频组件引起的。

首先确认功能，选择正确的播放设备，验证显示器音量，更新驱动程序，并在需要时重新启用禁用的设备。

下一个主题见，间歇性投影仪关机，这最常见的原因是过热、气流受限、过滤器维护和风扇可靠性。

英文原文

HDMI and DisplayPort can carry both video and audio,but it is common to have video working while audio does not play through the monitor or television.

In most cases,the root cause is configuration rather than hardware failure.

The troubleshooting goal is to confirm the display is capable of audio output,then confirm the operating system is routing audio to the correct device,and finally validate drivers and device state.

Not all monitors include speakers,and some have HDMI inputs purely for video.

If the display has no speakers,audio will not be produced even if the computer is sending it successfully.

Confirm whether the monitor has built-in speakers or an audio out jack and confirm whether the speakers are enabled in the monitor settings.

This step prevents spending time on software troubleshooting when there is no audio hardware to output sound.

If the monitor or TV supports audio,the next step is selecting it as the active output device.

Operating systems often keep the last used audio device or switch automatically when devices are connected and disconnected.

Choose the HDMI or DisplayPort audio output associated with the monitor,then test with a known audio source.

Many no sound incidents are simply audio being sent to internal speakers,headphones or a disconnected device.

Displays that include speakers usually have their own volume and mute settings controlled through the on-screen display menu.

Verify the display is not muted and that volume is set to a usable level.

This is frequently overlooked because users assume the computer's volume control is the only control that matters.

HDMI and DisplayPort audio typically depend on the graphics driver's audio components.

If these components are missing or corrupted,the display may not appear as an audio device or may not function correctly.

Updating the graphics driver package is a standard corrective step.

After installation,confirm the system detects the HDMI or DisplayPort audio device and that it is selectable.

Operating systems may mark HDMI audio devices as disabled,particularly after driver changes or repeated connection events.

Check playback devices,show disabled devices and enable the display audio device if it is present but inactive.

Once enabled,set it as the default output for testing,then confirm sound output.

USB-C docks and adapters can affect audio routing,especially if they present multiple audio devices to the operating system.

If audio fails through a dock,test by connecting directly from the computer to the monitor or TV.

If direct connection works,the dock or adapter is the likely fault domain.

In managed environments,standardizing reliable docks and maintaining spares reduces repeated incidents.

If the monitor lacks speakers but you still want audio from the same HDMI source,an HDMI audio extractor can separate audio to external speakers while passing video to the display.

This is a practical solution for training rooms and conference setups where the display is used for video but sound is required through external speakers.

After changes,validate using a simple audio test such as a system sound test or a known media clip.

Confirm both left and right channels function if applicable and confirm volume is stable.

Testing immediately after each change helps you identify which step resolved the issue.

Most display audio problems are caused by the display lacking speakers,the operating system routing audio to the wrong output device,muted monitor audio or missing graphics driver audio components.

Confirm capability first,select the correct playback device,validate monitor volume,update drivers and re-enable disabled devices if needed.

Cath you in the next topic,intermittent projector shutdown,which most commonly relates to overheating,airflow restrictions,filter maintenance and fan reliability.

234. 投影仪间歇性关机

间歇性投影仪关机是一种常见症状，表现为投影仪在使用过程中突然断电，有时在短暂冷却后会自动重启，有时则需要手动重启。

在大多数情况下，这种行为是对过热的一种保护性反应。

投影仪会产生大量热量，当冷却性能下降时，设备会关机以防止灯泡和内部组件受损。

投影仪使用内部温度传感器，如果内部温度超过安全限值，投影仪将自动关机。

典型的关机温度范围约为七十到八十摄氏度。

投影仪冷却后，通常需要大约五到十分钟，才允许重新启动。

如果投影机关机，且温度或灯泡指示灯显示警告模式，应将其视为过热事件，并直接进行气流和维护检查，而不是反复尝试重新开机。

过热关机的最常见原因是气流受限。

投影仪依靠进气口吸入冷空气，并通过排气口排出热空气。

如果通风口被墙壁阻挡、放置在柜子里，或被纸张、织物或袋子等物体包围，热量会迅速积聚。

一个实用的原则是，在所有通风口周围保持至少六到十二英寸的净空，以便空气能够无阻地循环。

许多投影仪使用空气过滤器来防止灰尘进入内部冷却路径。

当过滤器堵塞时，气流会减少，从而导致过热。

过滤器通常位于侧面或底部的一个小面板后面，根据型号不同，可能是可清洗或可更换的。

在多尘的环境中，合理的维护间隔是每三到六个月清洁或更换一次过滤器，以保持气流稳定并防止反复关机。

即使有过滤器，灰尘仍可能在散热片、风扇叶片和内部气流通道上积聚。

这会降低冷却效率，并可能导致旧投影仪关机。

一个实用的老化指标是：投影仪已使用超过三年，且几乎没有或从未进行过内部清洁。

内部清洁可能需要专业服务，自行打开设备可能会带来保修失效或损坏的风险。

因此，应根据环境和支持政策将此作为一个决策点。

冷却风扇至关重要，如果风扇故障或转速显著下降，过热会迅速发生。

在运行期间，您应该能听到气流和风扇活动的声音，许多投影仪在负载下会提高风扇转速。

如果投影仪异常安静，或者在开机后迅速关机，应怀疑风扇故障。

某些型号在菜单中提供风扇状态或风扇速度指示器，确认的风扇故障通常需要维修或更换，而不是标准的用户故障排除。

房间环境也很重要，因为投影仪只能冷却到周围空气的温度。

许多投影仪的最高建议工作温度范围约为三十五到四十摄氏度，大致相当于九十五到一百零四华氏度。

在炎热的房间中，如小型服务器机房、阁楼或通风不良的空间，即使通风口畅通且过滤器清洁，投影仪也可能过热。

在这些情况下，纠正措施在于改善环境。

改善通风、增加冷却设备，或重新安置投影仪。

一旦怀疑过热，请确认从进气口到排气口的气流路径畅通无阻。确保投影仪未放置在会阻挡通风口的柔软表面上，且未被封闭在无气流的空间内。

确认过滤器清洁、室温合理，并且投影仪有足够的净空。

此步骤可减少重复发生的事件，并防止在具有操作破坏性的演示场景中发生关机。

如果在清理通风口、清洁过滤器并确认室温正常后关机仍在继续，可能的原因包括内部积尘、风扇故障或其他内部热管理问题。

此时，继续运行会缩短灯泡寿命并增加组件损坏的风险。

正确的下一步是升级服务以进行检查，必要时更换风扇，并使用安全程序进行内部清洁。

间歇性投影仪关机最常见的原因是过热保护。

重点关注至少六到十二英寸的气流净空、在多尘环境中每三到六个月清洁一次过滤器，并避免在三十五到四十摄氏度附近的高温房间中运行。

如果问题仍然存在，应怀疑内部积尘或风扇故障，并升级寻求服务，而不是反复重启投影仪。

英文原文

Intermittent projector shutdown is a common symptom where the projector powers off during use,sometimes restarting after a short cooling period and sometimes requiring manual restart.

In most cases,this behavior is a protective response to overheating.

Projectors generate substantial heat and when cooling performance drops,the device will shut down to prevent damage to the lamp and internal components.

Projectors use internal temperature sensors and if internal temperatures exceed safe limits,the projector will shut down automatically.

A typical shutdown range is around 70 to 80 degrees Celsius.

After the projector cools,often for roughly 5 to 10 minutes,it may allow restart.

If the projector shuts down and a temperature or lamp indicator light shows a warning pattern,treat it as an overheating event and move directly to airflow and maintenance checks rather than repeatedly powering it back on.

The most common cause of overheating shutdown is restricted airflow.

Projectors rely on intake vents to pull cool air in and exhaust vents to push hot air out.

If vents are blocked by a wall,placed inside a cabinet or surrounded by objects such as paper,fabric or bags,heat builds rapidly.

A practical rule is to maintain a clearance of at least 6 to 12 inches around all vents so air can circulate without resistance.

Many projectors use air filters to prevent dust from entering the internal cooling path.

When filters clog,airflow drops and overheating becomes likely.

Filters are often accessible behind a small panel on the side or bottom and may be washable or replaceable depending on the model.

In dusty environments,a reasonable maintenance interval is cleaning or replacing filters every 3 to 6 months to maintain stable airflow and prevent repeated shutdowns.

Even with filters,dust can accumulate inside the projector on cooling fins,fan blades and internal airflow channels.

This reduces cooling efficiency and can cause shutdowns in older projectors.

A practical age indicator is a projector that has been in service for more than three years with little or no internal cleaning.

Internal cleaning may require professional service and opening the unit yourself may create warranty or damage risks.

So treat this as a decision point based on environment and support policy.

Cooling fans are critical and if a fan fails or slows down significantly,overheating can occur quickly.

During operation,you should be able to hear airflow and fan activity and many projectors ramp fan speed higher under load.

If the projector is unusually quiet,or if shutdown happens rapidly after powering on,suspect fan failure.

Some models provide fan status or fan speed indicators in the menu,and a confirmed fan fault typically requires repair or replacement rather than standard user troubleshooting.

Room conditions matter because projectors can only cool down to the surrounding air temperature.

Many projectors have maximum recommended operating temperatures in a range around 35 to 40 degrees Celsius,which corresponds roughly to 95 to 104 degrees Fahrenheit.

In hot rooms such as small server rooms,attics or poorly ventilated spaces,a projector may overheat even if vents are clear and filters are clean.

In those cases,the corrective action is environmental.

Improve ventilation,add cooling,or relocate the projector.

Once you suspect overheating,confirm the airflow path is unobstructed from intake to exhaust.Ensure the projector is not placed on soft surfaces that block vents and that it is not enclosed without airflow.

Confirm filters are clean,the room temperature is reasonable and the projector has adequate clearance.

This step reduces repeat incidents and prevents shutdown during presentation scenarios that are operationally disruptive.

If shutdowns continue after clearing vents,cleaning filters and confirming normal room temperature,the likely causes include internal dust buildup,failing fans or other internal thermal management issues.

At that point,continued operation can shorten lamp life and increase risk of component damage.

The correct next step is escalation to service for inspection,fan replacement if needed,and internal cleaning using safe procedures.

Intermittent projector shutdown is most often caused by overheating protection.

Focus on airflow clearance of at least 6 to 12 inches,filter cleaning every 3 to 6 months in dusty environments and avoiding hot room operation near 35 to 40 degrees Celsius.

If the issue persists,suspect internal dust buildup or fan failure and escalate for service rather than repeatedly restarting the projector.

235. 显示尺寸与失真问题

显示尺寸和失真问题包括图像边缘被裁剪、图像过小带有边框、比例被拉伸或压缩，以及投影呈梯形。

这些问题通常与配置有关，而非硬件故障。

故障排除的目标是校正宽高比处理、分辨率选择、缩放行为以及投影仪几何形状，使图像能正确适配显示器且无失真。

宽高比描述了宽度与高度之间的关系。

常见比例包括大多数现代显示器和电视的十六比九、某些生产力显示器的十六比十、超宽显示器的二十一比九，以及旧内容的四比三。

当内容与显示器的宽高比不匹配时，您会看到黑条或拉伸现象。

正确的目标是保持预期的宽高比，并在必要时接受黑条，而不是扭曲图像。

如果人物看起来异常宽或高，说明显示器正在拉伸内容以填满屏幕。

许多显示器和电视提供缩放模式，如填充、宽高比和一对一像素映射。

填充模式通常会拉伸并导致失真，而宽高比模式能保持正确的比例，并在必要时添加黑条。

选择保留宽高比的模式是解决比例失真的最佳通用方案。

选择与显示器原生宽高比不匹配的分辨率可能会强制进行异常缩放并导致失真。

例如，为不同宽高比设计的分辨率在宽屏面板上可能显得拉伸。

最佳实践是为该显示器选择操作系统推荐的原始分辨率。

这通常能同时产生正确的宽高比和清晰度。

过扫描是电视上常见的一种行为，图像会被略微放大，从而裁剪掉任务栏或窗口边框等边缘。

这在历史上曾用于隐藏旧广播内容的边缘伪影。

现代设备在用于计算机时通常不需要过扫描。

纠正措施是禁用过扫描，并启用诸如点对点扫描、屏幕适配或一对一映射等模式，以便整个桌面可见。

欠扫描则是相反的问题，图像无法填满屏幕，四周出现边框。

这可能是由于显示器或显卡驱动程序控制面板中的缩放设置导致的。

通过将显示器上的缩放设置为全尺寸，并验证显卡缩放配置未缩小活动图像区域来进行校正。

显卡驱动程序通常包含可以覆盖显示器行为的缩放控制。

这些设置决定缩放是由显卡执行还是由显示器执行，以及缩放是保持宽高比还是强制全屏拉伸。

如果显示器的内置设置有限或令人困惑，显卡缩放控制可以提供一种一致的方法来强制保持宽高比并校正图像尺寸。

当投影仪未与屏幕正对时，投影失真通常表现为梯形。

梯形校正可调整几何形状，使图像变为矩形。

许多投影仪提供垂直梯形校正，有些还提供水平或自动梯形校正。

梯形校正可以改善适配效果，但过度校正会降低图像清晰度，因此应将其用作微调，而非替代正确放置的手段。

如果投影图像过大或过小，首先使用物理放置和变焦控制进行校正。

如果可用，镜头移位优于重度数字校正，因为它能保持图像质量。

最佳实践是正确放置投影仪，调整变焦以控制大小，在可用时使用镜头移位进行对齐，然后仅在必要时应用最小的梯形校正。

尺寸和失真问题最常通过匹配正确的宽高比、选择显示器推荐的原始分辨率、禁用过扫描、校正欠扫描以及在需要时使用显卡缩放控制来解决。

对于投影仪，首先校正放置和对焦，然后使用镜头移位和最小的梯形校正来优化几何形状。

下一步。

在初始设置期间应用这些尺寸检查，以防止反复出现图像不适配的投诉，而不是反复进行故障排除。

英文原文

Display sizing and distortion problems include images that are cut off at the edges,images that are too small with borders,stretched or squished proportions,or trapezoid-shaped projection.

These issues are usually configuration-related rather than hardware failures.

The troubleshooting objective is to correct aspect ratio handling,resolution selection,scaling behavior,and projector geometry so the image fits the display correctly without distortion.

Aspect ratio describes the relationship between width and height.

Common ratios include 16 by 9 for most modern monitors and televisions,16 by 10 for some productivity displays,21 by 9 for ultra-wide monitors,and 4 by 3 for older content.

When content and display aspect ratios do not match,you will see black bars or stretching.

The correct goal is maintaining the intended aspect ratio and accepting black bars when required rather than distorting the image.

If people look unusually wide or tall,the display is stretching the content to fill the screen.

Many monitors and televisions offer scaling modes such as fill,aspect and one-to-one pixel mapping.

Fill often stretches and causes distortion,while aspect preserves correct proportions and adds black bars when necessary.

Selecting an aspect preserving mode is the best general purpose fix for distorted proportions.

Choosing a resolution that does not match the display's native aspect ratio can force unusual scaling and lead to distortion.

For example,a resolution intended for a different aspect ratio may appear stretched on a widescreen panel.

The best practice is to select the recommended native resolution provided by the operating system for that display.

This typically produces correct aspect ratio and sharpness simultaneously.

Overscan is a behavior commonly found on televisions where the image is slightly zoomed,cutting off edges such as the taskbar or window borders.

This was historically used to hide edge artifacts on older broadcast content.

Modern devices typically do not require overscan for computer use.

The corrective action is disabling overscan and enabling modes such as just scan,screen fit or one-to-one mapping so the entire desktop is visible.

Under scan is the opposite problem where the image does not fill the screen and borders appear on all four sides.

This can happen due to scaling settings on the display or within the GPU driver control panel.

Correct by setting scaling to full size on the display and verifying the GPU scaling configuration is not shrinking the active image area.

Graphics drivers often include scaling controls that can override display behavior.

These settings determine whether scaling is performed by the GPU or by the display,and whether scaling preserves aspect ratio or forces full screen stretch.

If the monitor's built-in settings are limited or confusing,GPU scaling controls can provide a consistent way to enforce aspect ratio preservation and correct image sizing.

Projector distortion often appears as a trapezoid shape when the projector is not aligned squarely with the screen.

Keystone correction adjusts the geometry so the image becomes rectangular.

Many projectors provide vertical keystone and some provide horizontal or automatic keystone.

Keystone can improve fit but excessive correction can reduce image clarity so it should be used as a fine adjustment rather than a substitute for proper placement.

If the projected image is too large or too small,correct it first using physical placement and zoom controls.

If available,lens shift is preferable to heavy digital correction because it preserves image quality.

The best practice is to position the projector correctly,adjust zoom for size,use lens shift for alignment when available and then apply minimal keystone only if necessary.

Sizing and distortion issues are most often resolved by matching the correct aspect ratio,selecting the display's recommended native resolution,disabling over scan,correcting under scan and using GPU scaling controls when needed.

For projectors,correct placement and focus first,then use lens shift and minimal keystone to refine geometry.

Next steps.

Apply these sizing checks during initial setup so recurring image does not fit complaints are prevented rather than repeatedly troubleshot.

236. 电池健康度差

欢迎回来。

在本节中，我们将专注于移动设备的故障排除。

我们首先讨论电池健康状况不佳，这是手机、平板电脑和笔记本电脑最常见的长期问题。

曾经能续航一整天但现在刚到午餐时间就没电的设备，通常正经历正常的电池老化。

我们的目标是了解其发生原因、如何测量以及如何决定何时更换是最佳解决方案。

锂离子电池会随着使用而老化，主要的磨损单位是充电周期。

一个充电周期大致相当于使用了电池百分之百的容量，例如从百分之百用到零，或者两次从百分之五十用到零。

许多电池的额定寿命约为三百到五百个周期，之后容量损失才会变得明显。

一个常见的参考点是大约五百个周期后剩余容量约为百分之八十，随着时间进一步老化，在大约八百到一千个周期时容量可能降至百分之六十到七十。

在iPhone上，电池健康信息内置于设置中，这使得故障排除变得简单直接。

关键数值是最大容量，它表示电池当前能持有的电量与其全新状态相比的比例。

例如，百分之九十的最大容量意味着电池能持有其原始电量的百分之九十。

常见的更换阈值是低于百分之八十。

iPhone还会报告峰值性能容量，如果电池老化，设备可能会降低性能以防止意外关机，这就是旧手机即使软件是最新的也可能感觉变慢的原因之一。

Android的电池健康报告因制造商而异。

有些Android设备在设置中包含电池健康指示器，而另一些则需要通过诊断屏幕或第三方应用程序进行估算，这些应用程序根据充放电行为推断容量。

由于这些方法并不总是精确，最佳实践是将工具报告的内容与实际症状结合起来，如快速耗电、意外关机和充电不一致。

当健康估算显示显著损失且症状一致时，更换是最可靠的解决方案。

电池健康状况不佳通常表现为运行时间缩短，例如在类似使用情况下的手机续航从十二小时或更久缩短至六小时。

另一个典型症状是在电量较高时意外关机，例如在百分之二十到三十时，这是由于负载下电压下降所致。

其他指标包括异常缓慢或不一致的充电、充电过程中过度发热，以及电池使用多年后出现的系统性能节流。

关键的诊断见解是电池磨损可能模仿软件问题，因此必须考虑使用年限和循环历史。

热量是加速电池老化的最大因素之一，包括将设备留在炎热的汽车中、持续玩游戏或在充电时长时间高负载使用。

快充也会增加热量，与较凉爽、较慢的充电习惯相比，这可能会略微缩短长期寿命。

深度放电至百分之零以及长时间将设备保持在百分之百电量会增加压力，因此许多最佳实践旨在切实可行时将电量保持在百分之二十到百分之八十之间。

最后，年限本身也很重要，因为即使使用量很少，电池也会随时间发生化学老化。

通常建议在最大容量降至约百分之八十以下、运行时间无法满足用户需求或关机行为变得不可预测时更换电池。

一个实用的年限指导原则是，大约两到三年后，许多重度使用的手机会出现明显的老化。

电池更换费用通常在五十到一百美元之间，具体取决于设备和服务选项，它可以为原本健康的手机延长大约一到两年的使用寿命。

有些设备适合使用信誉良好的套件和指南进行自行更换电池，而许多现代设备由于粘合剂密封、易损线缆和防水考虑而难以自行更换。

在新设计上，屏幕损坏和丧失防水性的风险会增加。

对于大多数用户来说，通过制造商计划或信誉良好的维修店进行专业更换更安全、更可靠，特别是对于维修错误代价高昂的新设备。

虽然老化无法停止，但可以减缓。

实际措施包括避免高温暴露、仅在需要时使用快充、尽可能将电量保持在适中范围、启用省电模式以及最小化不必要的后台活动。

这些习惯可减少热应力，并能改善日常运行时间和长期电池健康。

电池健康状况不佳是正常的磨损，主要由充电周期、热量和年限驱动。

许多电池在大约三百到五百个周期后开始出现明显的容量损失，通常在约五百个周期时达到百分之八十的容量，并在大约八百到一千个周期时可能降至百分之六十到七十。

在可用时使用内置健康工具，评估症状，并在容量和稳定性不再满足需求时更换电池。

下一个主题见，电池膨胀，这是一种需要立即采取行动的严重安全状况。

英文原文

Welcome back.

In this section we'll focus on troubleshooting mobile devices.

We are starting with poor battery health which is the most common long term complaint on phones,tablets and laptops.

A device that used to last all day but now dies by lunchtime is typically experiencing normal battery degradation.

The goal is to understand why it happens,how to measure it and how to decide when replacement is the best fix.

Lithium-ion batteries degrade with use and the main unit of wear is the charge cycle.

One charge cycle is roughly the equivalent of using 100%of the battery's capacity such as going from 100%down to 0 or going from 50%down to 0 twice.

Many batteries are rated for roughly 300 to 500 cycles before capacity loss becomes noticeable.

A common reference point is around 80%capacity remaining by about 500 cycles and further degradation over time can reduce capacity to around 60 to 70%by roughly 800 to 1000 cycles.

On iPhone,battery health is built into settings which makes troubleshooting straightforward.

The key value is maximum capacity which indicates how much charge the battery can hold compared to when it was new.

For example,90%maximum capacity means the battery holds about 90%of its original charge.

A common replacement threshold is below 80%.

iPhone also reports peak performance capability and if the battery is degraded the device may reduce performance to prevent unexpected shutdowns which is one reason older phones can feel slower even when software is current.

Android battery health reporting varies by manufacturer.

Some Android devices include battery health indicators in settings while others require estimation through diagnostic screens or third-party apps that infer capacity from charge and discharge behavior.

Because these methods are not always precise,the best practice is to combine what the tools report with real symptoms such as rapid drain,unexpected shutdowns and inconsistent charging.

When health estimates indicate significant loss and symptoms are consistent,replacement becomes the most reliable resolution.

Poor battery health often presents as shortened runtime such as a phone lasting 6 hours instead of 12 or more under similar usage.

Another classic symptom is unexpected shutdown at higher percentages such as 20 to 30 percent due to voltage dropping under load.

Additional indicators include unusually slow or inconsistent charging,excessive heat during charging and system performance throttling that appears after the battery has aged for multiple years.

The key diagnostic insight is that battery wear can mimic software problems so age and cycle history must be considered.

Heat is one of the biggest accelerators of battery degradation,including leaving devices in hot cars,sustained gaming or prolonged high load use while charging.

Fast charging can also increase heat,which may slightly reduce long-term lifespan compared to cooler,slower charging habits.

Deep discharges to zero percent and keeping a device at one hundred percent for long periods can add stress,so many best practices aim to keep charge roughly between twenty percent and eighty percent when practical.

Finally,age alone matters because batteries degrade chemically over time even if usage is light.

Battery replacement is generally recommended when maximum capacity drops below about eighty percent,when runtime becomes unacceptable for the user's needs,or when shutdown behavior becomes unpredictable.

A practical age guideline is that after roughly two to three years,many heavy use phones show noticeable degradation.

Battery replacement commonly costs roughly fifty to one hundred dollars depending on device and service option,and it can extend the useful life of an otherwise healthy phone by roughly one to two additional years.

Some devices are suitable for do-it-yourself battery replacement using reputable kits and guides,while many modern devices are difficult due to adhesive seals,fragile cables,and water resistance considerations.

The risk of screen damage and loss of water resistance increases on newer designs.

For most users,professional replacement through a manufacturer program or reputable repair shop is safer and more consistent,particularly for newer devices where repair errors are expensive.

Although degradation cannot be stopped,it can be slowed.

Practical steps include avoiding high heat exposure,using fast charging only when needed,keeping battery level in a moderate range when possible,enabling battery saver modes,and minimizing unnecessary background activity.

These habits reduce thermal stress and can improve both daily runtime and long-term battery health.

Poor battery health is normal wear driven primarily by charge cycles,heat and age.

Many batteries begin noticeable capacity loss after roughly 300 to 500 cycles,often reaching around 80%capacity by about 500 cycles and potentially 60 to 70%by roughly 800 to 1000 cycles.

Use built-in health tools where available,evaluate symptoms,and replace batteries when capacity and stability no longer meet needs.

237. 电池鼓包

电池膨胀是一个安全问题，而不仅仅是性能问题。

屏幕鼓起、后盖翘起或设备看起来变厚或不平整等迹象，应被视为即时危险。

主要目标是通过停止使用、防止额外压力以及安排安全处置或专业服务，来降低火灾或受伤的风险。

当锂离子电池内部因化学分解而产生气体积聚时，可能会发生膨胀。

促成因素包括使用劣质充电器导致的过充、跌落造成的物理损坏、制造缺陷、高温暴露以及严重老化。

随着电池结构退化，其产生气体的速度可能超过容纳能力，导致电池组膨胀。

常见迹象包括屏幕与边框之间出现缝隙、后盖分离或翘起、设备在平坦表面上摇晃，以及因内部压力挤压显示组件而导致的触摸问题。

任何可见的分离都是严重的警告信号。

最安全的做法是，如果设备外壳发生变形，即使设备仍能开机，也要假定存在膨胀问题。

如果怀疑有膨胀，请立即停止使用该设备。

不要充电，也不要继续正常操作。

如果安全的话，请关闭设备电源，并轻柔handling以避免挤压或弯曲电池。

当电池受到压力、刺穿或加热时，风险会增加，因此首要任务是稳定状况，而非继续使用。

切勿尝试刺穿电池、按压鼓包、弯曲设备或用力合上外壳。

膨胀的电池处于压力之下，刺穿可能会释放易燃物质并引发火灾。

将该设备视为危险物品，避免任何会增加机械压力的操作。

将设备移离纸张、织物、床上用品和软垫家具等易燃物品。

将其放置在瓷砖、混凝土或金属等不可燃表面上，并远离儿童和宠物。

如果膨胀严重，请在尽快安排适当处置或服务的同时，优先确保安全放置。

如果设备冷却、稳定且没有发热、冒烟或异常气味的迹象，您可以快速将数据备份到云存储或计算机。

但是，如果设备过热或不稳定，请跳过备份并优先考虑安全。

数据恢复不值得冒受伤或财产损失的风险。

膨胀的电池绝不能扔进家庭垃圾中。

请使用制造商回收计划、经认证的电子废品回收中心或市政危险废物收集服务。

小心运输设备，并遵循当地关于锂电池处置的指导方针。

如果可用，在运输过程中使用防火容器或电池运输袋可降低风险。

当存在膨胀时，切勿尝试自行更换电池。

拆卸会增加刺穿的风险，因为膨胀的电池可能紧紧压在内部组件和粘合剂上。

专业维修提供商拥有针对这种情况设计的程序和安全设备。

明确告知电池已膨胀，以便设备得到适当处理。

电池膨胀是一个严重危害，需要立即降低风险。

停止使用，不要充电，避免压缩或刺穿设备，将其与易燃材料隔离，仅在安全时备份数据，并通过批准的回收或危险废物渠道处置设备。

下一个主题见，屏幕破碎，包括触控层与显示屏损坏的区别、维修决策和更换选项。

英文原文

Swollen batteries are a safety issue,not just a performance issue.

Signs such as a bulging screen,a lifting back cover,or a device that appears thicker or uneven should be treated as an immediate hazard.

The main objective is to reduce risk of fire or injury by stopping use,preventing additional stress,and arranging safe disposal or professional service.

Lithium-ion batteries can swell when gases build up inside the battery due to internal chemical breakdown.

Contributing factors include overcharging with poor quality charges,physical damage from drops,manufacturing defects,heat exposure,and advanced age.

As the battery structure degrades,it may generate gas faster than it can be contained,causing the battery pack to expand.

Common indicators include gaps between the screen and the frame,separation or lifting of the back cover,a device that rocks on a flat surface,and touch issues caused by internal pressure against the display assembly.

Any visible separation is a serious warning sign.

The safest approach is to assume swelling is present if the device casing is deforming,even if the device still powers on.

If swelling is suspected,stop using the device right away.

Do not charge it and do not continue normal operation.

Power the device off if it is safe to do so and handle it gently to avoid squeezing or bending the battery.

The risk increases when batteries are stressed,punctured,or heated,so the priority is stabilization,not continued use.

Never attempt to puncture the battery,press down on the bulge,bend the device,or apply force to close the case.

A swollen battery is under pressure,and puncture can release flammable material and lead to fire.

Treat the device as a hazardous object and avoid actions that increase mechanical stress.

Move the device away from flammable items such as paper,fabric,bedding,and upholstery.

Place it on a non-flammable surface,such as tile,concrete,or metal,and keep it away from children and pets.

If the swelling is severe,prioritize safe placement while arranging proper disposal or service as soon as possible.

If the device is cool,stable and shows no signs of heat,smoke,or unusual odor,you may perform a quick backup to cloud storage or a computer.

However,if the device is hot or unstable,skip the backup and prioritize safety.

Data recovery is not worth risking injury or property damage.

Swollen batteries must not be thrown in household trash.

Use manufacturer take back programs,approved electronics recycling centers or municipal hazardous waste collection services.

Transport the device carefully and follow local guidance for lithium battery disposal.

If available,using a fire resistant container or battery transport bag during transit reduces risk.

Do not attempt do it yourself battery replacement when swelling is present.

Removal increases the chance of puncture because swollen batteries may be tightly pressed against internal components and adhesive.

A professional repair provider has procedures and safety equipment designed for this situation.

Clearly communicate that the battery is swollen so the device is handled appropriately.

Swollen batteries are a serious hazard and require immediate risk reduction.

Stop use,do not charge,avoid compressing or puncturing the device,isolate it from flammable materials,back up data only if safe,and dispose of the device through approved recycling or hazardous waste channels.

238. 屏幕碎裂

屏幕破碎是移动设备最常见的损坏形式之一。

屏幕裂纹的程度不一，从功能完好仅影响美观的裂纹，到完全丧失显示或触摸输入功能。

故障排除的重点是确定屏幕组件中哪一部分受损，评估碎玻璃带来的安全风险，并决定与更换设备相比维修是否具有成本效益。

移动屏幕通常至少涉及两个功能层。

触控层通过玻璃层检测触摸输入，而显示层（如LCD或OLED）负责生成图像。

设备可能出现玻璃破裂但图像正常，或者触控层正常但下方显示层损坏的情况。

许多现代设备将这些层融合在一起，因此维修时通常需要更换整个组件，而非单层。

首先通过检查是否有线条、黑点、变色或屏幕无法点亮，来验证显示图像是否完好。

接下来验证整个表面（包括角落和边缘）的触摸响应，因为部分触控层故障可能仅影响特定区域。

还要评估裂纹是否暴露了尖锐的玻璃，因为这会增加用户安全隐患，即使设备仍能工作也需提高处理优先级。

维修决策应基于设备价值、维修成本和机龄。

屏幕更换成本因型号而异，根据设备类型以及屏幕是否为OLED，费用大致在一百到四百美元之间。

对于较旧的入门级设备，维修成本可能超过设备的市场价值，此时更换是更实际的选择。

对于较新或高端设备，维修通常是合理的，特别是当设备其他方面运行稳定时。

如果重要数据尚未备份，即使是较旧的设备，维修也可能是值得的，因为恢复访问权限的成本通常低于专业数据恢复。

如果屏幕部分功能正常，请在损坏恶化之前优先备份照片、联系人和文档。

屏幕裂纹会随时间扩展，在承受额外压力后，触摸或显示性能可能会进一步退化。

在某些设备上，使用信誉良好的套件和分步指南可以进行自行屏幕维修，但难度差异很大。

现代设备通常使用强力粘合剂、易损排线和防水密封件，增加了内部损坏的风险。

自行维修常见的失败模式是弄坏替换屏幕或损坏内部连接器。

自行维修最适合拥有适当工具和经验的用户。

专业维修通常能提供更高的可靠性和更低的风险，特别是对于新设备。

制造商授权的维修能保持质量并可能维持设备保修状态，而信誉良好的第三方维修店则能提供更快的周转时间和更低的成本。

权衡之处在于，第三方维修可能使用售后市场屏幕，其亮度、色彩准确度和耐用性可能参差不齐。

选择信誉良好的提供商可减少重复出现的问题。

如果无法立即维修，可通过贴上钢化玻璃屏幕保护膜或保护薄膜来降低碎玻璃的风险，以防止割伤并减少进一步开裂。

避免对屏幕施加压力，并将设备放入保护壳中。

这不是永久性的修复措施，但可以在您安排维修或更换期间稳定设备状况。

维修后，请确认整个屏幕的触摸输入，验证显示均匀性和亮度，并在适用时测试前置传感器和摄像头对齐情况。

还要确认指纹识别器和面部识别等功能是否仍能正常工作。

如果设备此前具备防水功能，请注意除非正确重新密封，否则维修可能会降低这种防护能力。

处理屏幕破碎问题需要将其分解为触控层功能、显示图像功能和物理安全风险三个方面。

评估显示质量和触摸响应，权衡维修成本与设备价值，并在可能时优先备份数据。

临时保护措施可以降低风险，但通常需要完全更换屏幕组件。

英文原文

Broken screens are one of the most common forms of mobile device damage.

A cracked screen can range from cosmetic cracks with full functionality to complete loss of display or touch input.

Troubleshooting focuses on identifying which part of the screen assembly is damaged,assessing safety risks from broken glass and deciding whether repair is cost effective compared to device replacement.

Mobile screens generally involve at least two functional layers.

The digitizer detects touch input through the glass layer while the display layer such as L C D or O L E D produces the image.

A device can have cracked glass with a working image or a working touch layer with a damaged display underneath.

Many modern devices fuse these layers so repair often replaces the full assembly rather than a single layer.

First verify whether the display image is intact by checking for lines,black spots,discoloration or a screen that does not turn on.

Next verify touch responsiveness across the entire surface including corners and edges because partial digitizer failure can affect only certain regions.

Also assess whether the crack exposes sharp glass since that adds a user safety concern and increases urgency even if the device still functions.

The repair decision should be based on the device value,repair cost and age.

Screen replacement cost varies widely by model and can range from roughly$100 to$400 depending on device type and whether the screen is OLED.

For older budget devices,repair may cost more than the device's market value,making replacement the practical choice.

For newer or higher end devices,repair is often justified,especially when the device is otherwise stable.

If important data is not backed up,repair may be worthwhile even on older devices because restoring access can be cheaper than professional data recovery.

If the screen is partially functional,prioritize backing up photos,contacts and documents before the damage worsens.

Screen cracks can expand over time and touch or display performance can degrade further after additional stress.

Do-it-yourself screen repair is possible on some devices using reputable kits and step-by-step guides,but difficulty varies widely.

Modern devices often use strong adhesives,fragile ribbon cables and water resistant seals,increasing risk of internal damage.

A common failure mode in DIY repair is breaking the replacement screen or damaging internal connectors.

DIY repair is best reserved for users with proper tools and experience.

Professional repair generally provides better reliability and lower risk,especially for newer devices.

Manufacturer authorized repair preserves quality and may maintain device warranty status,while reputable third party repair shops can offer faster turnaround and lower cost.

The trade-off is that third-party repairs may use aftermarket screens which can vary in brightness,color accuracy,and durability.

Choosing a reputable provider reduces repeat issues.

If immediate repair is not possible,reduce risk from broken glass by applying a tempered glass screen protector or protective film to prevent cuts and reduce further cracking.

Avoid pressure on the screen and keep the device in a protective case.

This is not a permanent fix,but it can stabilize the device while you schedule repair or replacement.

After repair,confirm touch input across the entire screen,verify display uniformity and brightness,and test front sensors and camera alignment if applicable.

Also confirm features such as fingerprint readers and face recognition still operate correctly.

If the device previously had water resistance,understand that repair can reduce that protection unless resealing is performed correctly.

Broken screens require separating the problem into touch digitizer function,display image function and physical safety risk.

Assess display quality and touch response,weigh repair cost against device value,and prioritize data backup when possible.

Temporary protection can reduce risk,but full replacement of the screen assembly is often required.

Next topic:improper charging issues,including charger compatibility,dirty ports,damaged connectors,and safe troubleshooting steps.

239. 充电异常问题

充电异常问题包括手机完全无法充电、充电速度极慢或仅间歇性充电。

大多数情况可归结为少数几个原因：线缆或充电器故障、充电端口内有碎屑、充电端口磨损、无线充电对齐问题，或水分检测等保护性软件行为。

正确的故障排除方法是先从最简单的外部检查开始，然后逐步排查端口和设备层面的原因。

最快的初步测试是换上一根已知良好的充电器和线缆。

充电线缆常因反复弯折而在连接器附近损坏，劣质充电器也可能发生故障或提供不稳定的电力。

如果更换充电器和线缆后手机正常充电，则说明手机本身没有问题，更换配件是正确的解决方案。

此步骤可避免不必要的端口清洁和设备拆解。

充电速度取决于充电器能否提供设备设计所需的功率。

旧式充电器可能仅提供约五瓦的功率，而现代快充充电器通常提供十八瓦到六十五瓦不等的功率，具体取决于标准和设备。

在现代手机上使用低功率充电器可能仍能充电，但可能需要数小时，而非一到两小时。

实际的解决方案是使用制造商推荐的充电器，或支持相同快充标准的等效充电器。

充电端口常会积聚来自口袋和包袋的绒毛及碎屑，导致线缆无法完全插入。

这可能导致连接松动感，或仅在特定角度下才能充电。

用灯光检查端口，如果存在碎屑，请使用非金属工具（如木制牙签或塑料挑针）小心清理。

避免使用金属工具，因为短路引脚可能会损坏设备。

清洁后，重新插入线缆并确认连接器发出咔哒声或牢固贴合。

充电端口会因反复插拔而磨损，内部引脚可能弯曲或松动。

典型症状包括间歇性充电、线缆过度晃动，或仅在将线缆保持在特定角度时才能充电。

这是一个硬件问题，通常需要专业维修。

如果设备支持无线充电，在决定端口维修是否具有成本效益时，可将无线充电作为临时替代方案。

USB-C设计为可正反插，但劣质线缆和连接器可能表现不一致。

如果充电间歇性中断，请测试更高质量的线缆，并验证连接器是否完全插入端口。

如果手机在不同线缆上表现反复无常，这种模式表明问题在于线缆质量或端口磨损，而非电池健康问题。

无线充电失败通常是由充电板对齐不当、厚手机壳阻挡线圈或充电板功率不足引起的。

仔细将手机居中放置，测试时取下厚手机壳，并确保充电板使用适当的适配器供电。

无线充电对位置非常敏感，因此需要一致的放置和稳定的电源才能实现可靠充电。

充电可能受到优化充电、电池保护模式以及产生热量的后台进程等软件功能的影响。

基本的纠正步骤是重启设备以清除临时故障，并安装可能解决充电相关错误的系统更新。

如果在Android的安全模式下充电正常，则可能是第三方应用程序造成了干扰。

软件问题比线缆和端口问题少见，但当硬件检查无法解释问题时，应对其进行评估。

许多现代手机会检测充电端口中的水分，并禁用充电以防止腐蚀和短路。

如果设备报告检测到水分或液体，请勿忽略该警告。

让端口自然干燥，根据环境不同，这可能需要一到四小时。

如果需要紧急充电且设备支持，可在端口干燥期间使用无线充电。

充电异常通常由故障线缆或充电器、充电端口内的碎屑、端口磨损、无线充电对齐问题或保护性软件行为引起。

首先更换充电器和线缆，然后清洁并检查端口，确认充电器功率适当，并在可用时使用无线充电作为诊断和替代方案。

下一个主题见：连接信号差或无连接，涵盖Wi-Fi、蜂窝网络和蓝牙的故障排除步骤。

英文原文

Improper charging issues include a phone that will not charge at all,charges very slowly or only charges intermittently.

Most cases come down to a small set of causes a bad cable or charger,debris in the charging port,a worn charging port,wireless charging alignment problems or protective software behavior such as moisture detection.

The correct troubleshooting approach is to start with the simplest external checks and then move toward port and device level causes.

The fastest first test is swapping in a known good charger and cable.

Charging cables commonly fail near the connector due to repeated bending and low quality chargers can also fail or deliver unstable power.

If the phone charges normally with a different charger and cable,the phone is not the problem and replacement of the accessory is the correct fix.

This step prevents unnecessary port cleaning and device disassembly.

Charging speed depends on whether the charger can supply the power the device is designed to accept.

Older chargers may provide about 5 watts while modern fast chargers commonly provide ranges such as 18 watts up to 65 watts depending on the standard and device.

Using a low power charger on a modern phone may still charge the phone but it can take several hours instead of 1 to 2 hours.

The practical solution is to use the manufacturer recommended charger or an equivalent charger that supports the same fast charging standard.

Charging ports often collect lint and debris from pockets and bags which prevents the cable from fully seating.

This can cause a loose feeling connection or charging that works only at certain angles.

Inspect the port with a light and if debris is present,clean it carefully using a non-metal tool such as a wooden toothpick or plastic pick.

Avoid metal tools because shorting pins can damage the device.

After cleaning,reseat the cable and confirm the connector clicks or fits firmly.

Charging ports wear out over time due to repeated insertion and removal and internal pins can bend or loosen.

Typical symptoms include intermittent charging,a cable that wiggles excessively or charging only when the cable is held at a specific angle.

This is a hardware issue and usually requires professional repair.

If the device supports wireless charging,wireless charging can be used as a temporary workaround while deciding whether port repair is cost effective.

USPC is designed to be reversible but low quality cables and connectors can behave inconsistently.

If charging is intermittent,test a higher quality cable and verify the connector fully seats in the port.

If a phone repeatedly behaves differently across cables,the pattern points toward cable quality or port wear rather than a battery health issue.

Wireless charging failures are often caused by misalignment on the charging pad,thick cases that block the coil,or an underpowered charging pad.

Center the phone carefully,remove thick cases for testing,and ensure the charging pad is powered with an appropriate adapter.

Wireless charging is sensitive to positioning,so consistent placement and stable power are required for reliable charging.

Charging can be impacted by software features such as optimized charging,battery protection modes,and background processes that generate heat.

A basic corrective step is restarting the device to clear temporary faults and installing system updates that may resolve charging-related bugs.

If charging works in safe mode on Android,a third-party app may be interfering.

Software is less common than cable and port causes,but it should be evaluated when hardware checks do not explain the issue.

Many modern phones detect moisture in the charging port and disable charging to prevent corrosion and short circuits.

If the device reports moisture or liquid detection,do not override the warning.

Allow the port to dry naturally,which may take 1 to 4 hours depending on conditions.

If urgent charging is needed and the device supports it,wireless charging can be used while the port dries.

Improper charging is usually caused by a faulty cable or charger,debris in the charging port,port wear,wireless charging alignment issues,or protective software behaviors.

Start by swapping charger and cable,then clean and inspect the port,confirm charger power is appropriate,and use wireless charging as a diagnostic and workaround when available.

Cat you in the next topic:Poor or No Connectivity,covering Wi-Fi,Cellular,and Bluetooth troubleshooting steps.

240. 连接不良或无连接

连接问题包括无法连接Wi-Fi、蜂窝信号问题、移动数据故障以及蓝牙配对失败。

这些问题通常由设置错误、临时无线电故障、网络站点问题或天线等硬件损坏引起。

正确的故障排除策略是隔离问题，确定是手机、网络还是配件的问题。

然后首先应用最小的纠正措施。如果无法连接Wi-Fi，请确认飞行模式已关闭且Wi-Fi已启用。

然后使用忽略网络的方法，通过重新输入密码进行重连，因为保存的网络配置文件可能会损坏。

还要验证其他设备是否可以连接到同一个Wi-Fi网络。

如果其他设备也无法连接，则路由器或互联网服务可能是原因所在，重启路由器或联系互联网服务提供商进行故障排除是正确的下一步。

由于路由器问题、DNS问题或临时网络栈故障，手机可能显示已连接Wi-Fi但无法访问互联网。

常见的纠正步骤包括切换飞行模式以重置无线电、重启手机以及重启路由器。

如果多个设备都出现此问题，则很可能是网络端而非手机端的问题。

如果仅在一部手机上出现，重置Wi-Fi连接配置文件通常有效。

如果蜂窝信号微弱或丢失，首先切换飞行模式以强制手机重新注册附近的基站。

确认您不在已知的低信号环境中，例如地下室或屏蔽严重的建筑物内。

如果可能，请在不同位置进行测试。

如果设备使用SIM卡，还请重新插拔SIM卡，因为接触不良可能导致间歇性注册失败。

网络中断确实会发生，因此请考虑运营商是否正经历临时服务问题。

如果有语音信号但移动数据无法使用，请确认已启用蜂窝数据且未激活数据限制。

如果在旅行中，请验证漫游设置。

如果手机最近更换了运营商或重置了设置，接入点名称配置可能不正确，从而阻止数据会话建立。

还要考虑套餐限制、数据上限或账户问题，这些问题即使在信号强度看起来正常时也可能阻止数据传输。

蓝牙配对问题通常是由配件未处于配对模式、过时的配对记录或先前连接的干扰引起的。

最快的纠正措施是在蓝牙设置中忽略该配件，重启蓝牙，然后从头开始重新配对。

还要验证该配件是否可以与另一部手机配对，这有助于隔离故障是在手机端还是配件端。

由于切换、睡眠周期和软件故障，Wi-Fi、蜂窝和蓝牙无线电可能会进入不稳定状态。

切换飞行模式和重启手机是有效的重置操作，因为它们会重新加载无线电服务并重新协商连接。

这些步骤风险较低，通常无需更深层次的更改即可解决临时故障。

如果多次重连尝试均失败，重置网络设置是一种更强烈的纠正措施，它会清除保存的Wi-Fi网络、蓝牙配对和蜂窝配置。

这可以解决由损坏的配置数据引起的持久性问题。

由于这会带来干扰，应在尝试基本步骤后使用，并且用户应准备好重新输入Wi-Fi密码并重新配对配件。

如果在多个网络上连接持续失败且在重置后仍无效，则硬件问题的可能性更大。

跌落可能会损坏天线连接，进水可能会影响无线电组件。

迹象包括Wi-Fi和蓝牙同时失效、反复无法检测到网络，或设备无法识别任何SIM卡。

在这些情况下，可能需要专业诊断或更换设备。

大多数连接问题可通过确认设置、忽略并重新连接网络、重启路由器和手机、切换飞行模式以重置无线电以及正确重新配对蓝牙设备来解决。

当怀疑配置损坏时使用网络设置重置，当故障在不同环境中持续存在且在重置后仍未解决时考虑硬件损坏。

下一个主题见，液体损坏，包括即时安全步骤、干燥指南以及为避免永久性腐蚀而应避免的事项。

英文原文

Connectivity problems include Wi-Fi that will not connect,cellular signal issues,mobile data failures and Bluetooth pairing failures.

These issues are often caused by settings,temporary radio faults,network site problems or damaged hardware such as antennas.

The correct troubleshooting strategy is to isolate whether the problem is the phone,the network or the accessory.

Then apply the smallest corrective action first.If Wi-Fi will not connect,confirm airplane mode is off and Wi-Fi is enabled.

Then use the forget network approach and reconnect by entering the password again because saved network profiles can become corrupted.

Also verify whether other devices can connect to the same Wi-Fi network.

If other devices also fail,the router or internet service is likely the cause and router restart or ISP troubleshooting becomes the correct next step.

A phone may show Wi-Fi connected while internet access does not work due to router issues,DNS issues or temporary network stack faults.

Common corrective steps include toggling airplane mode to reset radios,restarting the phone and rebooting the router.

If the issue appears on multiple devices,it is likely network side rather than phone side.

If it appears only on one phone,resetting the Wi-Fi connection profile is often effective.

If cellular signal is weak or missing,first toggle airplane mode to force the phone to re-register with nearby tars.

Verify you are not in a known low signal environment such as basements or buildings with heavy shielding.

If possible,test in a different location.

Also reseed the SIM card if the device uses one since poor contact can cause intermittent registration.

Network outages do occur so consider whether the carrier is experiencing a temporary service problem.

If voice signal is present but mobile data does not function,confirm cellular data is enabled and that data restrictions are not active.

If traveling,verify roaming settings.

If the phone recently changed carriers or settings were reset,access point name configuration can be incorrect which prevents data sessions from establishing.

Also consider plan limitations,data caps or account issues which can block data even when signal strength looks normal.

Bluetooth pairing issues are frequently caused by the accessory not being in pairing mode,stale pairings or interference from previous connections.

The fastest corrective action is to forget the accessory in Bluetooth settings,reboot Bluetooth and repair from scratch.

Also verify the accessory can pair to another phone which helps isolate whether the fault is on the phone side or the accessory side.

Wi-Fi,cellular and Bluetooth radios can enter unstable states due to handoffs,sleep cycles and software faults.

Toggling airplane mode and restarting the phone are effective reset actions because they reload radio services and renegotiate connections.

These steps are low risk and often resolve temporary faults without deeper changes.

If repeated reconnection attempts fail,a network settings reset is a stronger corrective action that clears saved Wi-Fi networks,Bluetooth pairings,and cellular configuration.

This can resolve persistent problems caused by corrupted configuration data.

Because it is disruptive,it should be used after basic steps have been attempted and users should be prepared to re-enter Wi-Fi passwords and repair accessories.

If connectivity fails consistently across multiple networks and after resets,hardware becomes more likely.

Drops can damage antenna connections and water exposure can affect radio components.

Signs include Wi-Fi and Bluetooth failing together,repeated inability to detect networks or a device that cannot see any SIM.

In these cases,professional diagnosis or device replacement may be necessary.

Most connectivity issues are resolved by confirming settings,forgetting and reconnecting networks,restarting routers and phones,toggling airplane mode to reset radios and repairing Bluetooth devices properly.

Use network settings reset when configuration corruption is suspected and consider hardware damage when failures persist across environments and after resets.

242. 移动设备过热

移动设备过热是指手机变得烫手、电池异常快速耗电，以及因热节流导致性能下降。

热量有害，因为它会加速电池老化并给内部组件带来压力。

故障排除的目标是确定热量是由正常的高负载工作、充电行为、软件问题、环境条件、恶意软件还是电池故障引起的。

在充电、玩游戏、导航、录像和长时间通话期间，产生一些温热是正常的。

正常的温热感明显但仍可舒适握持。

过热是指设备烫到无法舒适握持、显示温度警告、限制功能或为自我保护而关机。

重度使用期间偶尔发热可能是正常的，但在轻度使用期间频繁发热，或停止使用后热量持续不退，则表明存在需要调查的问题。

游戏、增强现实、视频编辑和其他图形密集型应用会大力推动CPU和GPU，从而按设计产生热量。

关键指标是关闭应用后设备是否冷却。

实际的缓解措施包括在长时间使用中休息、降低图形设置、降低屏幕亮度，以及移除trapping热量的厚保护壳。

如果关闭应用很久后手机仍然发热，应将重点转向后台活动、软件故障或电池状况。

后台应用即使手机看似空闲也持续运行处理任务，可能导致持续发热。

查看各应用的电池使用情况，寻找异常高的百分比，例如您未主动使用时某个应用消耗了百分之二十或更多的电量。

如果某个应用持续偏高，请强制关闭它，如果支持则禁用其后台活动，或将其卸载。

持续的后台CPU活动是导致过热和意外电池耗电的常见原因。

过热有时会在操作系统更新后开始，这是由于错误、索引任务或后台行为变化引起的。

第一步是重启以清除临时故障并强制处理器干净地重新启动。

如果问题是在更新后立即开始的，请安装任何后续的补丁版本，并观察发热模式是否改善。

如果更新后多天过热持续且与重度使用无关，则有必要进行额外的故障排除，例如检查电池使用情况和移除有问题的应用。

充电会产生热量，而快充会产生更多热量，因为更高的功率流增加了热负荷。

如果在充电时重度使用手机（如玩游戏或流媒体视频），情况会更糟，因为设备负载和充电热量会叠加。

建议的步骤包括使用高质量充电器、充电时避免重度使用、在凉爽开放区域充电而非在床上或阳光直射下，并暂时移除保护壳以改善散热。

如果手机在充电时变得极热，应将其视为安全隐患，并评估充电器和电池状况。

炎热的环境会降低手机的散热能力。

一个关键阈值约为三十五摄氏度（大致相当于九十五华氏度），许多设备在此温度下负载运行时开始变得困难。

一个关键风险场景是将手机留在炎热的汽车中，车内温度可达约六十到七十摄氏度（大致相当于一百四十到一百六十华氏度）。

这种程度的热量会永久损坏电池。

正确的应对措施是将设备移至较凉爽的区域，使其远离阳光直射，并在继续使用前让其冷却。

恶意软件会导致过热，因为它会使CPU持续运行，即使手机看似空闲。

常见的伴随症状包括电池快速耗电、意外的数据使用量，以及手机未使用时发热。

在Android上，使用可信的移动安全工具进行扫描，并审查最近安装的应用。

在iOS上，恶意软件较少见，但用户应审查未知的配置描述文件并移除任何可疑内容。

关键的诊断线索是空闲期间的发热加电池耗电。

老旧或损坏的电池会产生过多热量，特别是在负载下或充电期间，因为内部电阻随年限增加。

一个实用的指导原则是，使用年限超过大约两到三年的电池更可能出现明显磨损，而健康度低于约百分之八十的电池通常表现出性能下降。

如果在轻度使用或充电期间发生过热，且设备已使用数年，应检查电池健康状况并考虑更换。

如果存在膨胀，应将其视为安全事件并立即停止使用该设备。

过热故障排除始于区分正常工作负载产生的热量与空闲或轻度使用期间的异常热量。

减少高负载活动、控制后台应用、保持软件更新、安全充电以最小化热量、避免高于约三十五摄氏度的炎热环境，并在存在空闲发热时扫描恶意软件。

如果设备较旧且热量持续，应怀疑电池老化并计划更换。

下一个主题：触控层问题，包括触摸无响应、幽灵触摸和死区。

英文原文

Mobile device overheating is when a phone becomes uncomfortably hot,battery drains unusually fast and performance slows down due to thermal throttling.

Heat is harmful because it accelerates battery degradation and can stress internal components.

The troubleshooting goal is to identify whether heat is caused by normal high workload,charging behavior,software problems,environmental conditions,malware or a failing battery.

Some warmth is expected during charging,gaming,navigation,video recording,and long calls.

Normal warmth is noticeable but still comfortable to hold.

Overheating is when the device is too hot to hold comfortably,displays temperature warnings,limits features or shuts down to protect itself.

Occasional heat during heavy use can be normal but frequent heat during light use or heat that persists after you stop using the device indicates a problem that should be investigated.

Games,augmented reality,video editing and other graphics heavy apps push the CPU and GPU hard which produces heat by design.

The key indicator is whether the device cools down after the app is closed.

Practical mitigation steps include taking breaks during long sessions,lowering graphic settings,reducing screen brightness and removing thick cases that trap heat.

If the phone remains hot long after the app is closed,shift focus to background activity,software faults or battery condition.

Background apps can cause persistent heat by running constant processing even when the phone appears idle.

Review battery usage by app and look for unusually high percentages such as an app consuming 20%or more when you did not actively use it.

If an app is consistently high,force close it,disable background activity if supported or uninstall it.

Persistent background CPU activity is a common cause of both overheating and unexpected battery drain.

Overheating sometimes starts after an operating system update due to bugs,indexing tasks or changes in background behavior.

The first step is a restart to clear temporary faults and force processors to restart cleanly.

If the issue began immediately after an update,install any subsequent patch releases and monitor whether the heat pattern improves.

If overheating persists for multiple days after an update and is not tied to heavy use,additional troubleshooting such as checking battery usage and removing problematic apps becomes necessary.

Charging generates heat and fast charging generates more heat because higher power flow increases thermal load.

This is worsened if the phone is used heavily while charging such as gaming or video streaming because device load and charging heat combine.

Recommended steps include using a high quality charger,avoiding heavy use while charging,charging in a cool open area rather than on bedding or in direct sunlight,and temporarily removing cases to improve heat dissipation.

If the phone becomes extremely hot while charging,treat it as a safety concern and evaluate the charger and battery condition.

Hot environments reduce a phone's ability to shed heat.

A key threshold is around 35 degrees Celsius which is roughly 95 degrees Fahrenheit where many devices begin struggling under load.

A critical risk scenario is leaving a phone in a hot car where interior temperatures can reach roughly 60 to 70 degrees Celsius which is roughly 140 to 160 degrees Fahrenheit.

That level of heat can permanently damage batteries.

The correct response is moving the device to a cooler area,removing it from direct sunlight and allowing it to cool before continued use.

Malware can cause overheating by keeping the CPU running continuously even when the phone appears idle.

Common accompanying symptoms include rapid battery drain,unexpected data usage and heat when the phone is not being used.

On Android,scan with trusted mobile security tools and review recently installed apps.

On iOS,malware is less common but users should review unknown configuration profiles and remove anything suspicious.

The key diagnostic clue is heat plus battery drain during idle periods.

Older or damaged batteries can generate excess heat specially under load or during charging because internal resistance increases with age.

A practical guideline is that a battery older than roughly 2 to 3 years is more likely to show noticeable wear and batteries below about 80%health commonly show degraded performance.

If overheating occurs during light use or charging and the device is several years old,battery health should be checked and replacement considered.

If swelling is present,treat it as a safety event and stop using the device immediately.

Overheating troubleshooting begins by separating normal workload heat from abnormal heat during idle or light use.

Reduce high load activity,control background apps,keep software updated,charge safely to minimize heat,avoid hot environments above about 35 degrees Celsius and scan for malware if idle heat is present.

If the device is older and heat is persistent,suspect battery degradation and plan replacement.

Next topic,digitizer issues including unresponsive touch,phantom touches and dead zones.

243. 数字化仪问题

触控层问题是指设备的触摸层无法正确响应。

症状包括触摸未注册、触摸注册位置错误、幽灵或幻触，以及屏幕部分区域无响应。

故障排除的目标是确定问题是由表面污染、屏幕保护膜等配件、软件故障、潮湿还是触控层物理损坏引起的。

首先检查基本的表面状况。

油脂、灰尘、湿气和残留物会干扰电容式触摸感应。

使用超细纤维布清洁屏幕，并确保屏幕完全干燥。

如果安装了屏幕保护膜，尤其是质量低劣或安装不当（带有气泡或边缘翘起）的保护膜，请将其移除以进行测试。

许多看似触控层的问题是由物理干扰而非内部组件故障引起的。

重启是排除可能影响触摸输入的临时驱动程序或内存问题的有效方法。

如果重启后触摸恢复正常，则问题可能是暂时的软件故障。

如果问题很快再次出现，请审查最近安装的应用和系统更新，将它们视为潜在诱因。

此步骤可快速区分持续性硬件故障和暂时性软件行为。

幻触是指屏幕注册了并未发生的触摸，导致随机打开应用、不受控制的输入或erratic滚动。

常见原因包括屏幕破裂、潮湿、劣质屏幕保护膜以及触控层的硬件损坏。

移除屏幕保护膜，彻底擦干设备并重新测试。如果幻触继续存在，应将触控层视为已损坏，并计划更换整个屏幕组件。

死区是指触摸在某些区域正常，但在特定区域（如沿边缘的条带或某个角落）持续失效。

这通常表明触控层因撞击或屏幕裂纹而受损，即使是不明显的发丝状裂纹也是如此。

在大多数现代手机中，触控层与显示组件粘合在一起，因此维修通常需要更换整个屏幕组件，而不是单独修复触控层。

现代手机通常不提供手动触摸校准工具。

它们会自动校准，通常没有可靠的用户界面调整功能来校正真正的偏移或死区。

如果整个系统的触摸准确度持续错误，可能的原因是触控层损坏、配件引起的严重干扰，或与硬件损坏相比极为罕见的软件级故障。

在Android上，安全模式有助于识别是否有第三方应用干扰系统行为。

启动到安全模式会禁用第三方应用，仅保留核心系统应用处于活动状态。

如果在安全模式下触摸表现正常，则最近安装的应用可能是导致问题的原因，逐一卸载应用是合理的方法。

如果在安全模式下触摸仍然失效，则问题更可能与硬件有关。

电容式触摸屏在潮湿或高湿度环境下可能表现不可预测，因为水分会改变表面的电气特性。

如果触摸问题主要发生在运动、下雨或高湿度期间，请擦干设备，并考虑使用旨在减少湿气暴露的保护壳。

这种模式有助于区分暂时性的环境影响和永久性的触控层故障。

如果在清洁、移除屏幕保护膜、重启和安全模式测试后触摸问题仍然存在，最可能的原因是物理性触控层损坏。

此时，继续故障排除很少能带来改善，更换屏幕组件是标准的解决方案。

当存在死区或持续的幻触时，情况尤其如此。

触控层故障排除始于通过清洁和移除屏幕保护膜来消除外部干扰，然后重启以排除临时故障，接着在Android上使用安全模式隔离应用干扰。

持续的幻触和死区强烈表明触控层损坏，通常需要更换屏幕。

下一个主题见：物理损坏的端口，包括磨损的充电端口、弯曲的引脚以及具有成本效益的维修决策。

英文原文

Digitizer issues occur when the touch layer of a device does not respond correctly.

Symptoms include touch not registering,touch registering in the wrong location,ghost or phantom touches and sections of the screen that do not respond.

The troubleshooting goal is to determine whether the issue is caused by surface contamination,accessories such as screen protectors,software faults,moisture or physical damage to the digitizer.

Start with basic surface conditions.

Oils,dirt,moisture,and residue can interfere with capacitive touch sensing.

Clean the screen using a microfiber cloth and ensure the screen is fully dry.

If a screen protector is installed,especially a low quality or poorly installed one with bubbles or lifted edges,remove it for testing.

Many apparent digitizer problems are caused by physical interference rather than internal component failure.

A restart is an effective way to rule out temporary driver or memory issues that can affect touch input.

If touch works normally after reboot,the issue was likely a transient software fault.

If the issue returns quickly,review recent app installs and system updates as potential triggers.

This step provides a fast separation between persistent hardware faults and temporary software behavior.

Phantom touches are when the screen registers touches that did not occur,causing random app openings,uncontrolled typing or erratic scrolling.

Common causes include cracked screens,moisture,poor screen protectors and hardware damage to the digitizer layer.

Remove the screen protector,dry the device thoroughly and retest.If phantom touches continue,treat the digitizer as damaged and plan for screen assembly replacement.

Dead zones occur when touch works in some areas but fails consistently in specific regions such as a strip along an edge or one corner.

This often indicates digitizer damage from impact or screen cracks,even hairline cracks that are not obvious.

In most modern phones,the digitizer is bonded to the display assembly,so repair typically requires replacing the full screen assembly rather than repairing the digitizer separately.

Modern phones generally do not provide manual touch calibration tools.

They auto-calibrate and there is typically no reliable user-facing adjustment that corrects true offset or dead zones.

If touch accuracy is consistently wrong across the system,the likely causes are digitizer damage,poor interference from accessories or software level faults that are rare compared to hardware damage.

On Android,safe mode can help identify whether a third-party app is interfering with system behavior.

Booting into safe mode disables third party apps and leaves only core system apps active.

If Touch behaves normally in safe mode,a recently installed app may be contributing to the problem,and uninstalling apps one by one is a reasonable approach.

If touch is still broken in safe mode,the issue is more likely hardware related.

Capacitive touch screens can behave unpredictably when wet or in high humidity because water changes electrical characteristics at the surface.

If touch issues occur primarily during exercise,rain or high humidity,dry the device and consider using a case designed to reduce moisture exposure.

This pattern helps separate temporary environmental effects from permanent digitizer failure.

If touch issues persist after cleaning,removing screen protectors,restarting and safe mode testing,the most likely cause is physical digitizer damage.

At that point,continued troubleshooting rarely produces improvement and replacement of the screen assembly is the standard resolution.

This is especially true when dead zones or persistent phantom touches are present.

Digitizer troubleshooting starts with eliminating external interference through cleaning and removing screen protectors,then rebooting to rule out temporary faults,then using safe mode on Android to isolate app interference.

Persistent phantom touches and dead zones strongly indicate digitizer damage and typically require screen replacement.

Cat you in the next topic,physically damaged ports including worn charging ports,bent pins and cost effective repair decisions.

244. 端口物理损坏

充电端口和配件端口属于高磨损组件，因为它们每天都会承受反复的机械应力。

随着时间的推移，端口可能会变得松动、接触不良或完全失效。

故障排除的目标是确定问题是由碎屑、线缆质量、引脚弯曲还是需要维修的真正端口损坏引起的。

端口松动通常表现为仅在特定角度下才能充电、线缆无法牢固卡入，或轻微移动就会导致充电断开。

常见原因包括长期磨损、每天多次插拔，以及在连接线缆时跌落造成的物理应力。

在断定端口损坏之前，请确认线缆完好无损，并检查是否有阻碍完全插入的碎屑。

使用灯光检查端口是否有可见损坏。

弯曲或断裂的引脚会阻碍可靠的电力和数据接触。

虽然轻微的引脚对齐有时可以校正，但尝试操作风险很高，因为引脚很脆弱，短路可能会损坏设备。

在大多数情况下，可见的引脚损坏应被视为需要维修的问题，而非用户级可修复的问题。

对于仍包含三点五毫米耳机插孔的设备，常见故障包括绒毛积聚、接触不良和内部磨损。

使用多根已知良好的耳机进行测试，用非金属工具小心清洁插孔，并确认音频设置正确。

如果插孔仍然不可靠，可能需要维修，但许多用户可以切换到蓝牙音频作为实际的替代方案。

端口维修成本取决于设备型号和内部设计的复杂程度。

充电端口更换费用通常在五十到一百五十美元之间，具体取决于端口是模块化设计还是集成在更大的组件中。

由于许多手机需要大量拆解，除非用户拥有适当的工具和经验，否则专业维修通常比自行维修更可靠。

维修决策应考虑设备价值、机龄以及其他老化组件（如电池和屏幕）的存在情况。

对于近期的旗舰设备，端口维修通常具有成本效益。

对于电池健康状况不佳且存在其他问题的旧款入门级设备，综合维修成本可能超过更换设备的价值。

正确的决策应基于总成本和预期的剩余设备寿命。

如果充电端口发生故障但设备支持无线充电，无线充电可以完全绕过该端口。

对于音频，蓝牙配件可避免依赖耳机插孔。

对于某些设备，适配器可以通过充电端口传输音频，但这仅在端口仍能正常进行电气工作时才有效。

替代方案并非永久性修复措施，但它们可以在安排维修期间减少停机时间。

预防措施包括使用优质线缆、避免侧向加载连接器、通过握住连接器而非拉扯线缆来拔出，以及避免在连接状态下移动或跌落。

在手机用于车内或充电时使用的环境中，angled连接器或应力消除线缆可减少端口应力。

如果尽管进行了清洁并使用已知良好的配件，端口仍反复断开连接，或者引脚明显损坏，则应升级寻求专业维修。

继续强行插入线缆可能会加剧损坏并增加维修成本。清晰记录症状和已尝试的步骤可提高维修效率。

物理损坏的端口通常通过持续松动、间歇性接触或可见的引脚损坏来识别。

首先尝试替换线缆和清除碎屑。

然后根据设备机龄和价值评估专业维修是否具有成本效益。

在可用时，使用无线充电和蓝牙作为临时替代方案。

下一个主题见：移动设备上的恶意软件，包括常见症状和安全移除实践。

英文原文

Charging ports and accessory ports are high wear components because they experience repeated mechanical stress every day.

Over time,ports may become loose,intermittent or fail completely.

The troubleshooting goal is to determine whether the issue is debris,cable quality,bent pins or true port damage that requires repair.

A loose port often presents as charging only at certain angles,a cable that does not click in firmly or charging that disconnects with minor movement.

Common causes include long-term wear,plugging and unplugging multiple times per day,and physical stress from drops while a cable is connected.

Before concluding the port is damaged,confirm the cable is known good and check for debris that prevents full seating.

Use a light to inspect the port for visible damage.

Bent or broken pins can prevent reliable power and data contact.

While minor pin alignment can sometimes be corrected,attempts are high risk because pins are fragile and shorting can damage the device.

In most cases,visible pin damage should be treated as a repair requirement rather than a user level fix.

On devices that still include a 3.5mm headphone jack,common failures include lint buildup,poor contact and internal wear.

Test with multiple known good headphones,clean the jack carefully with non-metal tools and confirm audio settings are correct.

If the jack remains unreliable,repair may be required,but many users can switch to Bluetooth audio as a practical workaround.

Port repair cost depends on device model and internal design complexity.

Charging port replacement commonly falls in a range around$50 to$150 depending on whether the port is modular or integrated into a larger assembly.

Because many phones require significant disassembly,professional repair is usually more reliable than do-it-yourself repair unless the user has appropriate tools and experience.

The repair decision should consider device value,age and the presence of other aging components such as batteries and screens.

On a recent flagship device,port repair is usually cost effective.

On an older budget device with poor battery health and other issues,the combined repair cost may exceed the value of replacement.

The correct decision is based on total cost and expected remaining device life.

If a charging port is failing but the device supports wireless charging,wireless charging can bypass the port entirely.

For audio,Bluetooth accessories avoid reliance on a headphone jack.

For some devices,adapters can redirect audio through the charging port,but that is only helpful if the port still functions electrically.

Workarounds are not permanent fixes,but they can reduce downtime while repair is scheduled.

Preventive practices include using quality cables,avoiding side-loading the connector,unplugging by the connector rather than pulling the cable,and avoiding movement or drops while connected.

In environments where phones are used in vehicles or while charging,angled connectors or strain relief cables can reduce port stress.
